import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Filter, X, PlusCircle, CheckCheck, Trash2, ArrowDownToLine } from 'lucide-react';

const toEn = (n) => {
    if (n === undefined || n === null || n === '') return '-';
    const bnToEn = { '০': '0', '১': '1', '২': '2', '৩': '3', '৪': '4', '৫': '5', '৬': '6', '৭': '7', '৮': '8', '৯': '9' };
    return String(n).replace(/[০-৯]/g, d => bnToEn[d] || d);
};

const classOrderMap = { "প্লে": 1, "নার্সারি": 2, "কেজি": 3, "১ম": 4, "২য়": 5, "৩য়": 6, "৪র্থ": 7, "৫ম": 8, "৬ষ্ঠ": 9, "৭ম": 10, "৮ম": 11, "৯ম": 12, "১০ম": 13 };
const classOptions = ['প্লে', 'নার্সারি', 'কেজি', '১ম', '২য়', '৩য়', '৪র্থ', '৫ম', '৬ষ্ঠ', '৭ম', '৮ম', '৯ম', '১০ম'];

// বয়স বের করার ফাংশন
const calculateAge = (dob) => {
    if (!dob) return null;
    const birthDate = new Date(dob);
    if (isNaN(birthDate)) return null;
    const diffMs = Date.now() - birthDate.getTime();
    const ageDt = new Date(diffMs);
    return Math.abs(ageDt.getUTCFullYear() - 1970);
};

export default function AdvancedFilter({ isOpen, onClose, originalData, onApplyFilter }) {
    const [rules, setRules] = useState([]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (isOpen && rules.length === 0) {
            addRule();
        }
    }, [isOpen]);

    const createNewRule = () => ({
        id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
        connector: '&&',
        field: 'Roll',
        operator: '==',
        value: '',
        min: '',
        max: ''
    });

    const addRule = () => setRules([...rules, createNewRule()]);

    const insertRuleAfter = (index) => {
        const newRules = [...rules];
        newRules.splice(index + 1, 0, createNewRule());
        setRules(newRules);
    };

    const removeRule = (id) => setRules(rules.filter(rule => rule.id !== id));

    const updateRule = (id, key, val) => {
        setRules(rules.map(rule => rule.id === id ? { ...rule, [key]: val } : rule));
    };

    const resetFilter = () => {
        setRules([createNewRule()]);
        onApplyFilter([...originalData]); 
        onClose();
    };

    const applyAdvancedFilter = () => {
        if (!originalData || originalData.length === 0) return;

        const validRules = rules.filter(rule => {
            if (rule.operator === 'empty' || rule.operator === 'not_empty') return true;
            if (rule.operator === 'between') return rule.min.trim() !== '' && rule.max.trim() !== '';
            return rule.value.trim() !== '';
        });

        if (validRules.length === 0) {
            onApplyFilter([...originalData]);
            onClose();
            return;
        }

        const filtered = originalData.filter(st => {
            let finalResult = false;
            let currentGroupResult = true;

            validRules.forEach((rule, index) => {
                let stVal = st[rule.field];
                
                // বয়সের জন্য স্পেশাল লজিক (কারন বয়স সেভ করা থাকে না, DOB থাকে)
                if (rule.field === 'Age') {
                    stVal = calculateAge(st.DOB);
                }

                if (stVal === undefined || stVal === null) stVal = "";

                let conditionMet = false;
                let numStVal = parseFloat(toEn(String(stVal)));
                let strStVal = String(stVal).toLowerCase();

                if (rule.operator === 'empty') { conditionMet = (strStVal === ""); }
                else if (rule.operator === 'not_empty') { conditionMet = (strStVal !== ""); }
                else if (rule.operator === 'between') {
                    if (rule.field === 'ClassBn') {
                        let stRank = classOrderMap[stVal] || 99;
                        let minRank = classOrderMap[rule.min] || 0;
                        let maxRank = classOrderMap[rule.max] || 99;
                        conditionMet = (stRank >= minRank && stRank <= maxRank);
                    } else {
                        let min = parseFloat(toEn(rule.min)); let max = parseFloat(toEn(rule.max));
                        if (!isNaN(numStVal) && !isNaN(min) && !isNaN(max)) { conditionMet = (numStVal >= min && numStVal <= max); }
                    }
                }
                else if (rule.operator === 'in_list') {
                    let listArr = rule.value.split(',').map(s => String(toEn(s)).trim().toLowerCase());
                    let targetVal = String(toEn(stVal)).trim().toLowerCase();
                    conditionMet = listArr.includes(targetVal);
                }
                else if (rule.operator === 'not_in_list') {
                    let listArr = rule.value.split(',').map(s => String(toEn(s)).trim().toLowerCase());
                    let targetVal = String(toEn(stVal)).trim().toLowerCase();
                    conditionMet = !listArr.includes(targetVal);
                }
                else {
                    let isClassCmp = rule.field === 'ClassBn';
                    let isNum = !isNaN(numStVal) && !isNaN(parseFloat(toEn(rule.value))) && !isClassCmp && rule.field !== 'StudentNameBn' && rule.field !== 'Gender' && rule.field !== 'BloodGroup';

                    let val1 = isClassCmp ? (classOrderMap[stVal] || 99) : (isNum ? numStVal : strStVal);
                    let val2 = isClassCmp ? (classOrderMap[rule.value] || 99) : (isNum ? parseFloat(toEn(rule.value)) : rule.value.toLowerCase());

                    // রক্তের গ্রুপ খালি থাকলে "n/a" হিসেবে মিলাও, যাতে N/A সিলেক্ট করে খালিগুলো খোঁজা যায়
                    if (rule.field === 'BloodGroup') {
                        val1 = strStVal === "" ? "n/a" : strStVal;
                        val2 = rule.value.toLowerCase();
                    }

                    switch (rule.operator) {
                        case '==': conditionMet = (val1 === val2); break;
                        case '!=': conditionMet = (val1 !== val2); break;
                        case '<': conditionMet = (val1 < val2); break;
                        case '>': conditionMet = (val1 > val2); break;
                        case '<=': conditionMet = (val1 <= val2); break;
                        case '>=': conditionMet = (val1 >= val2); break;
                        case 'contains': conditionMet = String(val1).includes(String(val2)); break;
                        case 'not_contains': conditionMet = !String(val1).includes(String(val2)); break;
                        default: break;
                    }
                }

                if (index === 0) { currentGroupResult = conditionMet; }
                else {
                    if (rule.connector === '||') {
                        finalResult = finalResult || currentGroupResult;
                        currentGroupResult = conditionMet;
                    } else {
                        currentGroupResult = currentGroupResult && conditionMet;
                    }
                }
            });
            return finalResult || currentGroupResult;
        });

        onApplyFilter(filtered);
        onClose();
    };

    const renderValueInput = (rule) => {
        if (rule.operator === 'empty' || rule.operator === 'not_empty') return null;

        if (rule.operator === 'between') {
            if (rule.field === 'ClassBn') {
                return (
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <select className="w-1/2 border rounded p-1.5 text-sm outline-none" value={rule.min} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'min', e.target.value)}>
                            <option value="">Min</option>
                            {classOptions.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
                        </select>
                        <select className="w-1/2 border rounded p-1.5 text-sm outline-none" value={rule.max} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'max', e.target.value)}>
                            <option value="">Max</option>
                            {classOptions.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
                        </select>
                    </div>
                );
            }
            return (
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <input type="text" className="w-1/2 border rounded p-1.5 text-sm outline-none" placeholder="Min" value={rule.min} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'min', e.target.value)} />
                    <input type="text" className="w-1/2 border rounded p-1.5 text-sm outline-none" placeholder="Max" value={rule.max} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'max', e.target.value)} />
                </div>
            );
        }

        if (rule.field === 'ClassBn' && ['==', '!=', '<', '>', '<=', '>='].includes(rule.operator)) {
            return (
                <select className="w-full border rounded p-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-[#005A34] outline-none" value={rule.value} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'value', e.target.value)}>
                    <option value="">সিলেক্ট করুন</option>
                    {classOptions.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
                </select>
            );
        }

        if (rule.field === 'Gender' && ['==', '!='].includes(rule.operator)) {
            return (
                <select className="w-full border rounded p-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-[#005A34] outline-none" value={rule.value} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'value', e.target.value)}>
                    <option value="">সিলেক্ট করুন</option>
                    <option value="Male">ছেলে (Male)</option>
                    <option value="Female">মেয়ে (Female)</option>
                </select>
            );
        }
        
        if (rule.field === 'BloodGroup' && ['==', '!='].includes(rule.operator)) {
            return (
                <select className="w-full border rounded p-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-[#b91c1c] outline-none" value={rule.value} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'value', e.target.value)}>
                    <option value="">সিলেক্ট করুন</option>
                    <option value="N/A" style={{ color: '#6b7280', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>N/A (নেই)</option>
                    {['A+', 'B+', 'O+', 'AB+', 'A-', 'B-', 'O-', 'AB-'].map(bg => <option key={bg} value={bg}>{bg}</option>)}
                </select>
            );
        }

        let placeholder = (rule.operator === 'in_list' || rule.operator === 'not_in_list') ? "১, ২, ৩ (কমা দিয়ে)" : "Value...";
        let type = (rule.field === 'WhatsApp' || rule.field === 'EmergencyNo' || rule.field === 'BRN' || rule.field === 'Age') ? "number" : "text";

        return (
            <input type={type} className="w-full border rounded p-1.5 text-sm outline-none" placeholder={placeholder} value={rule.value} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'value', e.target.value)} />
        );
    };

    if (!isOpen) return null;

    return (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 z-[10000] flex justify-center items-center">
            <div className="bg-white w-11/12 max-w-lg rounded-xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] shadow-2xl">
                <div className="bg-[#005A34] text-white p-3 flex justify-between items-center">
                    <h3 className="font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><Filter className="w-4 h-4" /> মেইল মার্জ ফিল্টারিং রুলস</h3>
                    <button onClick={onClose} className="text-white hover:text-gray-200 transition-colors">
                        <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                    </button>
                </div>
                
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 bg-gray-50 space-y-3 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-gray-300">
                    {rules.map((rule, index) => (
                        <div key={rule.id} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 sm:items-center bg-white p-3 sm:p-2 border rounded-lg shadow-sm relative">
                            <div className={`w-full sm:w-24 ${index === 0 ? 'invisible hidden sm:block' : ''}`}>
                                <label className="block sm:hidden text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1">লজিক</label>
                                <select className="w-full border rounded p-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 outline-none" value={rule.connector} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'connector', e.target.value)}>
                                    <option value="&&">AND (এবং)</option>
                                    <option value="||">OR (অথবা)</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div className="w-full sm:w-1/4">
                                <label className="block sm:hidden text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1">Field (ডাটা)</label>
                                <select className="w-full border rounded p-1.5 text-sm font-bold text-[#005A34] outline-none" value={rule.field} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'field', e.target.value)}>
                                    {/* ----- এখানে নতুন ফিল্ডগুলো যোগ করা হয়েছে ----- */}
                                    <option value="Roll">রোল (Roll)</option>
                                    <option value="ClassBn">শ্রেণি (Class)</option>
                                    <option value="StudentNameBn">নাম (Name)</option>
                                    <option value="ID">আইডি (ID)</option>
                                    <option value="Gender">লিঙ্গ (Gender)</option>
                                    <option value="Session">সেশন (Session)</option>
                                    <option value="Age" style={{color: 'purple'}}>বয়স (Age)</option>
                                    <option value="BloodGroup" style={{color: 'red'}}>রক্তের গ্রুপ (Blood)</option>
                                    <option value="WhatsApp" style={{color: 'green'}}>মোবাইল (Mobile)</option>
                                    <option value="EmergencyNo">জরুরি নম্বর</option>
                                    <option value="BRN">জন্ম নিবন্ধন (BRN)</option>
                                    <option value="VillageBn">গ্রাম (Village)</option>
                                    <option value="UnionBn">ইউনিয়ন (Union)</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div className="w-full sm:w-1/4">
                                <label className="block sm:hidden text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1">Condition (শর্ত)</label>
                                <select className="w-full border rounded p-1.5 text-sm outline-none" value={rule.operator} onChange={(e) => updateRule(rule.id, 'operator', e.target.value)}>
                                    <option value="==">Equal to (=)</option>
                                    <option value="!=">Not equal to (≠)</option>
                                    <option value="<">Less than (&lt;)</option>
                                    <option value=">">Greater than (&gt;)</option>
                                    <option value="<=">Less or equal (&lt;=)</option>
                                    <option value=">=">Greater or equal (&gt;=)</option>
                                    <option value="contains">Contains</option>
                                    <option value="not_contains">Not contains</option>
                                    <option value="in_list" style={{ color: 'blue', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>লিস্টে আছে (১,২,৩)</option>
                                    <option value="not_in_list" style={{ color: 'orange', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>লিস্টে নেই (১,২,৩)</option>
                                    <option value="between" style={{ color: 'green', fontWeight: 'bold' }}>মাঝামাঝি (১০-২০)</option>
                                    <option value="empty">Is blank</option>
                                    <option value="not_empty">Is not blank</option>
                                </select>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div className="w-full sm:flex-1">
                                <label className="block sm:hidden text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500 mb-1">Value (মান)</label>
                                {renderValueInput(rule)}
                            </div>
                            
                            <div className="w-full sm:w-16 flex justify-end gap-1 mt-2 sm:mt-0">
                                <button onClick={() => insertRuleAfter(index)} className="text-blue-500 hover:text-white bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-500 p-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors" title="নিচে রুল যোগ করুন">
                                    <ArrowDownToLine className="w-4 h-4" />
                                </button>
                                <button onClick={() => removeRule(rule.id)} className="text-red-500 hover:text-white bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-500 p-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors" title="মুছে ফেলুন">
                                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                                </button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    ))}
                </div>

                <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-50 border-t flex justify-between items-center">
                    <button onClick={addRule} className="text-[#005A34] font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-[#1e40af] transition-colors">
                        <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" /> নতুন রুল যোগ করুন
                    </button>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 bg-gray-200 px-2 py-1 rounded">প্রাপক: <span className="text-[#005A34]">{originalData?.length || 0}</span></span>
                </div>
                
                <div className="p-3 border-t bg-white flex gap-2">
                    <button onClick={resetFilter} className="w-1/3 bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 font-bold py-2 rounded-lg text-sm">রিসেট</button>
                    <button onClick={applyAdvancedFilter} className="w-2/3 bg-[#1e40af] text-white font-bold py-2 rounded-lg flex justify-center items-center gap-2 text-sm">
                        <CheckCheck className="w-4 h-4" /> ফিল্টার এপ্লাই করুন
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { FileText, X, CheckCircle, Table, List, Plus, Trash2, Printer, Type, Columns, Layers, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

// ==============================================
// ADVANCED PDF EXPORT COMPONENT (Blank PDF Fixed)
// ==============================================
const AdvancedPdfExport = ({ isOpen, onClose, dataToExport }) => {
  const [format, setFormat] = useState('table');
  const [pdfTitle, setPdfTitle] = useState('');
  const [pdfSubtitle, setPdfSubtitle] = useState('');
  const [rowHeight, setRowHeight] = useState('py-2');
  const [groupBy, setGroupBy] = useState('');
  const [plainCols, setPlainCols] = useState(3);
  const [separator, setSeparator] = useState(' - ');
  
  const [plainFieldsOrder, setPlainFieldsOrder] = useState([
    { field: 'roll', prefix: '' },
    { field: 'nameBn', prefix: '' }
  ]);
  
  const [isPreparing, setIsPreparing] = useState(false);

  const [tableColumns, setTableColumns] = useState([
    { id: 'col1', type: 'data', field: 'serial', label: 'ক্র.নং', width: '10', default: '' },
    { id: 'col2', type: 'data', field: 'nameBn', label: 'শিক্ষার্থীর নাম', width: '40', default: '' },
    { id: 'col3', type: 'data', field: 'roll', label: 'রোল', width: '15', default: '' },
    { id: 'col4', type: 'data', field: 'id', label: 'আইডি', width: '35', default: '' }
  ]);

  const e2b = (num) => String(num).replace(/\d/g, d => '০১২৩৪৫৬৭৮৯'[d] || d);

  const guessGender = (student) => {
    const g = student.Gender || student.gender || student.Sex || student.sex || student.লিঙ্গ || '';
    const str = g.toString().toLowerCase().trim();
    if (str === 'male' || str === 'm' || str === 'ছেলে' || str === 'ছাত্র' || str === 'বালক') return 'ছাত্র';
    if (str === 'female' || str === 'f' || str === 'মেয়ে' || str === 'ছাত্রী' || str === 'বালিকা') return 'ছাত্রী';
    return 'অজানা';
  };

  const calculateAge = (dobStr) => {
    if (!dobStr) return null;
    const dob = new Date(dobStr);
    if (isNaN(dob.getTime())) return null;
    const ageDifMs = Date.now() - dob.getTime();
    const ageDate = new Date(ageDifMs);
    return Math.abs(ageDate.getUTCFullYear() - 1970);
  };

  const fieldOptions = [
    { val: 'serial', text: 'ক্রমিক নং (১. ২.)' },
    { val: 'nameBn', text: 'নাম (বাংলা)' },
    { val: 'id', text: 'আইডি (ID)' },
    { val: 'roll', text: 'রোল (Roll)' },
    { val: 'classBn', text: 'শ্রেণি' },
    { val: 'FatherNameBn', text: 'পিতার নাম (বাংলা)' },
    { val: 'MotherNameBn', text: 'মাতার নাম (বাংলা)' },
    { val: 'address', text: 'ঠিকানা (সম্পূর্ণ)' },
    { val: 'WhatsApp', text: 'মোবাইল নম্বর' },
    { val: 'age', text: 'বয়স' },
    { val: 'DOB', text: 'জন্ম তারিখ' },
    { val: 'BRN', text: 'জন্ম নিবন্ধন (BRN)' },
    { val: 'gender', text: 'লিঙ্গ' },
    { val: 'BloodGroup', text: 'রক্তের গ্রুপ' },
    { val: 'Session', text: 'সেশন' },
    { val: 'nameEn', text: 'নাম (ইংরেজি)' },
    { val: 'FatherNameEn', text: 'পিতার নাম (ইংরেজি)' },
    { val: 'MotherNameEn', text: 'মাতার নাম (ইংরেজি)' },
    { val: 'EmergencyNo', text: 'জরুরি নম্বর' }
  ];

  const plainFieldLabels = fieldOptions.reduce((acc, curr) => {
    acc[curr.val] = curr.text.split(' ')[0];
    return acc;
  }, {});

  const updateCol = (index, key, value) => {
    const newCols = [...tableColumns];
    newCols[index][key] = value;
    setTableColumns(newCols);
  };

  const addPdfColumn = (type) => {
    setTableColumns([...tableColumns, {
      id: 'col' + Date.now(),
      type: type,
      field: type === 'data' ? 'nameBn' : '',
      label: type === 'data' ? 'নতুন কলাম' : 'ফাঁকা কলাম',
      width: '15',
      default: ''
    }]);
  };

  const removePdfColumn = (index) => {
    const newCols = [...tableColumns];
    newCols.splice(index, 1);
    setTableColumns(newCols);
  };

  const totalWidth = tableColumns.reduce((acc, col) => acc + (parseInt(col.width) || 0), 0);
  let colorClass = totalWidth === 100 ? 'text-emerald-600' : (totalWidth > 100 ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-orange-500');

  const addPlainField = (val) => {
    if (!val) return;
    if (!plainFieldsOrder.find(item => item.field === val)) {
      setPlainFieldsOrder([...plainFieldsOrder, { field: val, prefix: '' }]);
    }
  };

  const updatePlainFieldPrefix = (index, newPrefix) => {
    const newOrder = [...plainFieldsOrder];
    newOrder[index].prefix = newPrefix;
    setPlainFieldsOrder(newOrder);
  };

  const removePlainField = (index) => {
    const newOrder = [...plainFieldsOrder];
    newOrder.splice(index, 1);
    setPlainFieldsOrder(newOrder);
  };

  const generateSuperPDF = () => {
    setIsPreparing(true);

    if (!dataToExport || dataToExport.length === 0) {
      alert('পিডিএফ করার মতো কোনো ডাটা খুঁজে পাওয়া যায়নি।');
      setIsPreparing(false);
      return;
    }

    const title = e2b(pdfTitle).replace(/(\/n|\\n)/g, '<br>');
    const subtitle = e2b(pdfSubtitle).replace(/(\/n|\\n)/g, '<br>');

    let htmlContent = `
        <style>
            @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anek+Bangla:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Noto+Serif+Bengali:wght@500;600;700&display=swap');
            .pdf-body { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', serif; padding: 0; color: #000; background: white; }
            .hp-header { text-align: center; padding-bottom: 20px; padding-top: 5px; }
            .hp-hall-no { font-family: 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; color: #000; margin: 0; line-height: 1; }
            .hp-exam { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #222; margin-top: 10px; }
            .hp-class-section { margin-bottom: 20px; }
            .hp-class-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; page-break-after: avoid; }
            .hp-class-name { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #000; }
            .hp-class-stats { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #222; }
            
            .hp-grid { column-gap: 10px; }
            .hp-item { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 0; font-size: 16px; page-break-inside: avoid; }
            .hp-serial { flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 35px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', monospace; }
            .hp-roll { flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 35px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', monospace; }
            .hp-name { flex-grow: 1; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; white-space: normal; word-wrap: break-word; }
            
            .hp-footer-summary { margin-top: 25px; border-top: 2px solid #000; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding: 10px; text-align: center; page-break-inside: avoid; }
            .hp-total-text { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #000; margin-bottom: 2px; }
            .hp-total-sub { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #333; }
            .official-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 20px; font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', serif; }
            .official-table th { background-color: #f1f5f9 !important; border: 1.5px solid #000; padding: 10px 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #000; text-align: center; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
            .official-table td { border: 1.5px solid #000; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #111; vertical-align: middle; }
            .official-table tr:nth-child(even) td { background-color: #f8fafc !important; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
        </style>
        <div class="pdf-body">
    `;

    if (format === 'table') {
      htmlContent += `
            ${title ? `<h1 style="text-align: center; font-size: 26px; font-family: 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: ${subtitle ? '5px' : '20px'}; color: #000;">${title}</h1>` : ''}
            ${subtitle ? `<h2 style="text-align: center; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', serif; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 25px; color: #333;">${subtitle}</h2>` : ''}
        `;

      const pd = rowHeight === 'py-1' ? '6px 8px' : rowHeight === 'py-4' ? '14px 8px' : '10px 8px';

      let totalBoysAll = 0; let totalGirlsAll = 0;
      dataToExport.forEach(s => {
        const g = guessGender(s);
        if (g === 'ছাত্র') totalBoysAll++;
        if (g === 'ছাত্রী') totalGirlsAll++;
      });

      htmlContent += `<table class="official-table"><thead><tr>`;
      tableColumns.forEach(col => {
        let align = (col.field === 'serial' || col.field === 'roll' || col.type === 'blank') ? 'center' : 'left';
        htmlContent += `<th style="width: ${col.width}%; text-align: ${align};">${e2b(col.label)}</th>`;
      });
      htmlContent += `</tr></thead><tbody>`;

      dataToExport.forEach((s, index) => {
        htmlContent += `<tr>`;
        tableColumns.forEach(col => {
          let cellData = '';
          let align = (col.field === 'serial' || col.field === 'roll' || col.type === 'blank') ? 'center' : 'left';

          if (col.type === 'blank') {
            cellData = e2b(col.default || '');
          } else if (col.field === 'serial') {
            cellData = e2b(index + 1);
          } else {
            let fieldKey = col.field;
            let rawVal = '';

            if (fieldKey === 'nameBn') rawVal = s.StudentNameBn || s.nameBn || '-';
            else if (fieldKey === 'nameEn') rawVal = s.StudentNameEn || s.nameEn || '-';
            else if (fieldKey === 'classBn') rawVal = s.ClassBn || s.classBn || '-';
            else if (fieldKey === 'roll') rawVal = s.Roll || s.roll || '-';
            else if (fieldKey === 'id') rawVal = s.ID || s.id || '-';
            else if (fieldKey === 'gender') rawVal = guessGender(s);
            else if (fieldKey === 'address') {
              rawVal = [s.HouseNameBn, s.VillageBn, s.WardNo ? 'ওয়ার্ড: ' + e2b(s.WardNo) : '', s.UnionBn, s.UpazilaBn, s.DistrictBn].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
              if (!rawVal) rawVal = '-';
            }
            else if (fieldKey === 'age') {
              let a = calculateAge(s.DOB || s.dob);
              rawVal = a !== null ? a + ' বছর' : '-';
            }
            else if (fieldKey === 'DOB') {
              if (s.DOB || s.dob) rawVal = new Date(s.DOB || s.dob).toLocaleDateString('bn-BD');
              else rawVal = '-';
            }
            else {
              rawVal = s[fieldKey] || s[fieldKey.toLowerCase()] || s[fieldKey.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + fieldKey.slice(1)] || '-';
            }

            cellData = e2b(rawVal);
          }

          htmlContent += `<td style="padding: ${pd}; text-align: ${align};">${cellData}</td>`;
        });
        htmlContent += `</tr>`;
      });

      htmlContent += `</tbody></table>
            <div class="hp-footer-summary">
                <div class="hp-total-text">সর্বমোট শিক্ষার্থী: ${e2b(dataToExport.length)} জন</div>
                <div class="hp-total-sub">মোট ছাত্র: ${e2b(totalBoysAll)} জন | মোট ছাত্রী: ${e2b(totalGirlsAll)} জন</div>
            </div>`;
    } else {
      // --- Plain View ---
      if (title || subtitle) {
        htmlContent += `<div class="hp-header">`;
        if (title) htmlContent += `<div class="hp-hall-no">${title}</div>`;
        if (subtitle) htmlContent += `<div class="hp-exam">${subtitle}</div>`;
        htmlContent += `</div>`;
      }

      let groupedData = {};
      if (groupBy) {
        dataToExport.forEach(s => {
          let keyVal = 'অন্যান্য';
          if (groupBy === 'age') {
            const age = calculateAge(s.DOB || s.dob);
            keyVal = age !== null ? age : 'অজানা';
          } else if (groupBy === 'gender') {
            keyVal = guessGender(s);
          } else {
            let actualField = groupBy === 'classBn' ? 'ClassBn' : groupBy;
            let val = s[actualField];
            if (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') {
              keyVal = (groupBy === 'BloodGroup') ? 'গ্রুপ অজানা' : 'অন্যান্য';
            } else {
              keyVal = val;
            }
          }

          if (!groupedData[keyVal]) groupedData[keyVal] = [];
          groupedData[keyVal].push(s);
        });
      } else {
        groupedData['All'] = dataToExport;
      }

      let sortedKeys = Object.keys(groupedData);
      if (groupBy === 'age') {
        sortedKeys.sort((a, b) => {
          if (a === 'অজানা') return 1;
          if (b === 'অজানা') return -1;
          return parseInt(a) - parseInt(b);
        });
      }

      for (const groupName of sortedKeys) {
        const groupStudents = groupedData[groupName];

        htmlContent += `<div class="hp-class-section">`;

        if (groupBy) {
          let boysCount = 0; let girlsCount = 0;
          groupStudents.forEach(s => {
            const g = guessGender(s);
            if (g === 'ছাত্র') boysCount++;
            if (g === 'ছাত্রী') girlsCount++;
          });

          let genderText = (boysCount > 0 || girlsCount > 0) ? `(ছাত্র: ${e2b(boysCount)} জন | ছাত্রী: ${e2b(girlsCount)} জন)` : '';
          let displayGroupName = e2b(groupName);
          if (groupBy === 'classBn') displayGroupName += ' শ্রেণি';
          else if (groupBy === 'age' && groupName !== 'অজানা') displayGroupName = `বয়স ${displayGroupName}`;

          htmlContent += `
                    <div class="hp-class-header">
                        <div class="hp-class-name">${displayGroupName} - ${e2b(groupStudents.length)} জন</div>
                        <div class="hp-class-stats">${genderText}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
        }

        htmlContent += `<div class="hp-grid" style="column-count: ${plainCols};">`;

        let serialCount = 1;
        const hasSerial = plainFieldsOrder.some(item => item.field === 'serial');

        groupStudents.forEach(s => {
          let prefixHtml = "";
          let mainParts = [];

          plainFieldsOrder.forEach(item => {
            let f = item.field;
            let val = '';
            
            if (f === 'serial') val = e2b(serialCount) + '.';
            else if (f === 'gender') val = guessGender(s);
            else if (f === 'address') {
              val = [s.HouseNameBn, s.VillageBn, s.WardNo ? 'ওয়ার্ড: ' + e2b(s.WardNo) : '', s.UnionBn, s.UpazilaBn, s.DistrictBn].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
            }
            else if (f === 'age') {
              let a = calculateAge(s.DOB || s.dob);
              val = a !== null ? e2b(a) + ' বছর' : '';
            }
            else if (f === 'DOB') {
              let d = s.DOB || s.dob;
              val = d ? e2b(new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('bn-BD')) : '';
            }
            else if (f === 'nameBn') val = s.StudentNameBn || s.nameBn || '';
            else if (f === 'nameEn') val = s.StudentNameEn || s.nameEn || '';
            else if (f === 'classBn') val = s.ClassBn || s.classBn || '';
            else if (f === 'roll') val = s.Roll || s.roll || '';
            else if (f === 'id') val = s.ID || s.id || '';
            else val = s[f] || s[f.toLowerCase()] || '';

            if (val) {
              val = (f !== 'serial') ? e2b(val) : val;

              // Custom Prefix যুক্ত করার লজিক
              let displayVal = item.prefix ? item.prefix + val : val;

              if (f === 'serial') {
                prefixHtml += `<span class="hp-serial">${displayVal}</span>`;
              } else if (f === 'roll' && !mainParts.length && !hasSerial) {
                prefixHtml += `<span class="hp-roll">${displayVal}${separator}</span>`;
              } else {
                mainParts.push(displayVal);
              }
            }
          });

          let mainHtml = mainParts.join(separator);

          htmlContent += `
                    <div class="hp-item">
                        ${prefixHtml}
                        <span class="hp-name">${mainHtml}</span>
                    </div>
                `;
          serialCount++;
        });
        htmlContent += `</div></div>`;
      }

      let totalBoysAll = 0; let totalGirlsAll = 0;
      dataToExport.forEach(s => {
        const g = guessGender(s);
        if (g === 'ছাত্র') totalBoysAll++;
        if (g === 'ছাত্রী') totalGirlsAll++;
      });

      htmlContent += `
            <div class="hp-footer-summary">
                <div class="hp-total-text">এই লিস্টে মোট শিক্ষার্থী: ${e2b(dataToExport.length)} জন</div>
                <div class="hp-total-sub">মোট ছাত্র: ${e2b(totalBoysAll)} জন | মোট ছাত্রী: ${e2b(totalGirlsAll)} জন</div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    htmlContent += `</div>`;

    // React Root Hiding Issue Fixed Here
    let printContainer = document.getElementById('advanced-print-engine');
    if (!printContainer) {
      printContainer = document.createElement('div');
      printContainer.id = 'advanced-print-engine';
      document.body.appendChild(printContainer);
    }
    printContainer.innerHTML = htmlContent;

    setTimeout(() => {
      const originalTitle = document.title;
      let fileName = pdfSubtitle.trim();
      if (!fileName) fileName = pdfTitle.trim();

      if (fileName) {
        fileName = fileName.replace(/(\/n|\\n)/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      } else {
        fileName = 'Student_Report';
      }

      document.title = fileName;
      window.print();
      document.title = originalTitle;
      
      setIsPreparing(false);
      onClose();
    }, 500);
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        /* PDF Engine hidden normally */
        #advanced-print-engine { display: none; }
        
        /* Magic CSS to hide React root and only show the PDF container */
        @media print {
          html, body { background: white !important; margin: 0; padding: 0; height: auto; overflow: visible; }
          body > *:not(#advanced-print-engine) { display: none !important; }
          #advanced-print-engine { display: block !important; position: static; width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; page-break-inside: avoid; }
          @page { margin: 15mm; size: A4; }
          * { -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important; print-color-adjust: exact !important; box-sizing: border-box; }
        }
      `}</style>

      {isOpen && (
        <div id="pdf-export-modal" className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md transition-opacity duration-300">
          <div id="pdf-modal-card" className="bg-slate-50 rounded-[24px] w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl transition-transform duration-300 relative animate-in zoom-in-95">

            <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-white rounded-t-[24px] border-b border-slate-200 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <FileText className="text-red-500" size={24} /> অ্যাডভান্সড PDF এক্সপোর্ট
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium mt-1">A4 পেজ সাইজে কাস্টমাইজড রিপোর্ট তৈরি করুন</p>
              </div>
              <button onClick={onClose} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-slate-200 active:scale-90 transition-all">
                <X size={16} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar flex-1 space-y-6">

              <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Type size={16} /> হেডলাইন্স (ঐচ্ছিক)
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <input type="text" id="pdf-title" placeholder="প্রধান শিরোনাম (যেমন: বার্ষিক পরীক্ষার ফলাফল)" className="w-full bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 text-sm rounded-xl py-2.5 px-4 border border-slate-200 focus:border-indigo-400 focus:bg-white transition-all outline-none font-bold" value={pdfTitle} onChange={e => setPdfTitle(e.target.value)} />
                  <input type="text" id="pdf-subtitle" placeholder="সাব-টাইটেল (যেমন: শ্রেণি: ৬ষ্ঠ, বিষয়: গণিত)" className="w-full bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 text-sm rounded-xl py-2.5 px-4 border border-slate-200 focus:border-indigo-400 focus:bg-white transition-all outline-none" value={pdfSubtitle} onChange={e => setPdfSubtitle(e.target.value)} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-3">রিপোর্টের ধরন নির্বাচন করুন:</h3>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <button onClick={() => setFormat('table')} id="btn-fmt-table" className={format === 'table' ? "border-2 border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center transition-all relative overflow-hidden" : "border-2 border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 text-center hover:border-indigo-300 transition-all relative overflow-hidden"}>
                    <div className={format === 'table' ? "absolute top-2 right-2 text-indigo-600" : "absolute top-2 right-2 text-transparent"}>
                      <CheckCircle size={18} />
                    </div>
                    <Table size={32} className={format === 'table' ? "text-indigo-500 mx-auto mb-2" : "text-slate-400 mx-auto mb-2"} />
                    <h4 className={format === 'table' ? "font-bold text-slate-800" : "font-bold text-slate-600"}>টেবিল ভিউ</h4>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">কাস্টম কলাম ও রো-হাইট</p>
                  </button>

                  <button onClick={() => setFormat('plain')} id="btn-fmt-plain" className={format === 'plain' ? "border-2 border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center transition-all relative overflow-hidden" : "border-2 border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 text-center hover:border-indigo-300 transition-all relative overflow-hidden"}>
                    <div className={format === 'plain' ? "absolute top-2 right-2 text-indigo-600" : "absolute top-2 right-2 text-transparent"}>
                      <CheckCircle size={18} />
                    </div>
                    <List size={32} className={format === 'plain' ? "text-indigo-500 mx-auto mb-2" : "text-slate-400 mx-auto mb-2"} />
                    <h4 className={format === 'plain' ? "font-bold text-slate-800" : "font-bold text-slate-600"}>প্লেন ভিউ</h4>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1">গ্রুপিং ও কলাম অপশন</p>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {format === 'table' ? (
                <div id="settings-table" className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Columns size={16} /> কলাম সেটিং (<span className={colorClass}>{e2b(totalWidth)}%</span> - ১০০%)
                    </h3>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <button onClick={() => addPdfColumn('data')} className="text-xs bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-indigo-100 active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Plus size={12} /> ডেটা কলাম
                      </button>
                      <button onClick={() => addPdfColumn('blank')} className="text-xs bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-slate-200 active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Plus size={12} /> ফাঁকা কলাম
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div id="pdf-columns-container" className="space-y-2 mb-4 max-h-[200px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-1">
                    {tableColumns.map((col, index) => (
                      <div key={col.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                        <div className="flex-1">
                          <input type="text" value={col.label} onChange={(e) => updateCol(index, 'label', e.target.value)} placeholder="কলামের নাম (প্রিন্টে যা দেখাবে)" className="w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded text-xs px-2 py-1.5 outline-none font-bold text-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500" />
                          {col.type === 'data' ? (
                            <select value={col.field} onChange={(e) => updateCol(index, 'field', e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-100 text-[11px] text-indigo-700 mt-1 px-2 py-1.5 rounded outline-none font-bold cursor-pointer">
                              {fieldOptions.map(opt => <option key={opt.val} value={opt.val}>{opt.text}</option>)}
                            </select>
                          ) : (
                            <input type="text" value={col.default} onChange={(e) => updateCol(index, 'default', e.target.value)} placeholder="ডিফল্ট ভ্যালু (যেমন: স্বাক্ষর)" className="w-full bg-white border border-slate-200 mt-1 rounded text-[11px] px-2 py-1.5 outline-none text-slate-500" />
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="w-16">
                          <div className="relative">
                            <input type="number" value={col.width} onChange={(e) => updateCol(index, 'width', e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded text-xs px-2 py-1.5 outline-none pr-5 text-center font-bold focus:border-indigo-500" />
                            <span className="absolute right-1.5 top-1.5 text-xs text-slate-400">%</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <button onClick={() => removePdfColumn(index)} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-500 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white transition-colors shadow-sm">
                          <Trash2 size={14} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600">রো (Row) এর সাইজ:</span>
                    <select id="pdf-row-height" value={rowHeight} onChange={(e) => setRowHeight(e.target.value)} className="bg-white border border-slate-300 text-xs rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 outline-none text-slate-700 font-medium">
                      <option value="py-1">চিকন (Small)</option>
                      <option value="py-2">মাঝারি (Medium)</option>
                      <option value="py-4">চওড়া (Large)</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div id="settings-plain" className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 space-y-4">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Layers size={16} /> স্মার্ট গ্রুপিং
                    </h3>
                    <select id="pdf-group-by" value={groupBy} onChange={(e) => setGroupBy(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-sm rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 font-medium">
                      <option value="">কোনো গ্রুপ নয় (সব একসাথে)</option>
                      <option value="classBn">শ্রেণী (Class) অনুযায়ী</option>
                      <option value="gender">লিঙ্গ (Gender) অনুযায়ী</option>
                      <option value="age">বয়স অনুযায়ী</option>
                      <option value="BloodGroup">ব্লাড গ্রুপ অনুযায়ী</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">কলাম সংখ্যা</h3>
                      <input type="number" id="pdf-plain-cols" value={plainCols} min="1" max="6" onChange={(e) => setPlainCols(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 outline-none text-center font-bold" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">তথ্য বিভাজন (Separator)</h3>
                      <input type="text" id="pdf-separator" value={separator} onChange={(e) => setSeparator(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 outline-none text-center font-bold" />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 mb-2">কী কী তথ্য দেখাবেন? (পছন্দমতো সাজান)</h3>
                    
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-3" id="dynamic-plain-fields">
                      {plainFieldsOrder.map((item, index) => (
                        <div key={index} className="bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 pl-3 pr-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-2 shadow-sm">
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-700">{e2b(index + 1)}. {plainFieldLabels[item.field] || item.field}</span>
                          
                          <div className="flex items-center bg-white rounded border border-indigo-200 overflow-hidden h-6">
                            <input 
                              type="text" 
                              placeholder="উপসর্গ (যেমন: নাম: )" 
                              value={item.prefix}
                              onChange={(e) => updatePlainFieldPrefix(index, e.target.value)}
                              className="w-28 text-[11px] px-2 py-1 outline-none text-slate-700 font-bold placeholder-slate-300"
                            />
                          </div>

                          <button onClick={() => removePlainField(index)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 ml-1 outline-none">
                            <X size={14} />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    <select id="plain-field-selector" value="" onChange={(e) => addPlainField(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-sm rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 outline-none font-bold focus:border-indigo-400 text-slate-700">
                      <option value="">+ নতুন তথ্য যুক্ত করুন</option>
                      {fieldOptions.map(opt => (
                        <option key={opt.val} value={opt.val}>{opt.text}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-white rounded-b-[24px] border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-end gap-3 shrink-0">
              <button onClick={onClose} className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 transition-all">বাতিল</button>
              <button onClick={generateSuperPDF} id="btn-generate-pdf" disabled={isPreparing} className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-white bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 shadow-md shadow-indigo-200 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-2">
                {isPreparing ? <><Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> প্রস্তুত হচ্ছে...</> : <><Printer size={16} /> পিডিএফ তৈরি করুন</>}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default AdvancedPdfExport;

export default function DeveloperModal({ isOpen, onClose }) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [ripple, setRipple]   = useState(null);
  const cardRef = useRef(null);
  const buttons = makeButtons(DEV_INFO);

  // Mount → animate in
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setMounted(true);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => setVisible(true)));
      document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    } else {
      setVisible(false);
      const t = setTimeout(() => { setMounted(false); }, 450);
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // ESC key close
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") onClose(); };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
  }, [onClose]);

  // Tilt effect on card
  const handleMouseMove = (e) => {
    if (!cardRef.current) return;
    const rect = cardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width  - 0.5) * 14;
    const y = ((e.clientY - rect.top)  / rect.height - 0.5) * -14;
    cardRef.current.style.transform = `perspective(900px) rotateX(${y}deg) rotateY(${x}deg) scale(1.01)`;
  };
  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    if (!cardRef.current) return;
    cardRef.current.style.transform = "perspective(900px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0) scale(1)";
  };

  // Button press ripple
  const handleButtonClick = (href, e) => {
    const btn = e.currentTarget;
    const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    setRipple({ x: e.clientX - rect.left, y: e.clientY - rect.top, id: Date.now() });
    setTimeout(() => setRipple(null), 600);
    setTimeout(() => window.open(href, "_blank"), 180);
  };

  if (!mounted) return null;

  return (
    <>
      {/* ── CSS injected ── */}
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: STYLES }} />

      {/* ── Backdrop ── */}
      <div
        className="dm-backdrop"
        style={{ opacity: visible ? 1 : 0 }}
        onClick={onClose}
      />

      {/* ── Modal Shell ── */}
      <div className="dm-shell" style={{ opacity: visible ? 1 : 0, pointerEvents: visible ? "auto" : "none" }}>

        {/* Floating particles */}
        <div className="dm-particles" aria-hidden>
          {PARTICLES.map(p => (
            <span key={p.id} className="dm-particle" style={{
              width:  p.size, height: p.size,
              left:   `${p.x}%`, top: `${p.y}%`,
              opacity: p.opacity,
              animationDuration:  `${p.dur}s`,
              animationDelay:     `${p.delay}s`,
            }} />
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* ── Card ── */}
        <div
          ref={cardRef}
          className="dm-card"
          style={{ transform: visible ? "translateY(0) scale(1)" : "translateY(60px) scale(0.88)", opacity: visible ? 1 : 0 }}
          onMouseMove={handleMouseMove}
          onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
          onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
        >

          {/* Card inner glow */}
          <div className="dm-card-glow" aria-hidden />

          {/* ── Close button ── */}
          <button className="dm-close" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" width="18" height="18">
              <line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/>
            </svg>
          </button>

          {/* ── HEADER HERO ── */}
          <div className="dm-hero">
            {/* Animated mesh background */}
            <div className="dm-hero-mesh" aria-hidden />

            {/* Avatar ring */}
            <div className="dm-avatar-ring" aria-hidden>
              <div className="dm-avatar-ring2" />
            </div>

            {/* Avatar */}
            <div className="dm-avatar">
              {DEV_INFO.photo
                ? <img src={DEV_INFO.photo} alt={DEV_INFO.nameEn} className="dm-avatar-img" />
                : <span className="dm-avatar-initials">{DEV_INFO.initials}</span>
              }
              <span className="dm-online-dot" title="Available" />
            </div>

            {/* Name & Title */}
            <h2 className="dm-name-en">{DEV_INFO.nameEn}</h2>
            <h3 className="dm-name-bn">{DEV_INFO.nameBn}</h3>

            <div className="dm-badge">
              <span className="dm-badge-dot" />
              {DEV_INFO.titleBn} · {DEV_INFO.titleEn}
            </div>

            <p className="dm-tagline">"{DEV_INFO.tagline}"</p>
          </div>

          

          <div className="dm-divider" />

          
          {/* ── CONTACT BUTTONS ── */}
          <div className="dm-btns">
            {buttons.map((btn, i) => (
              <a
                key={btn.id}
                href={btn.href}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="dm-btn"
                style={{
                  background: btn.gradient,
                  boxShadow: `0 8px 28px ${btn.shadow}`,
                  animationDelay: `${0.08 * i}s`,
                }}
                onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleButtonClick(btn.href, e); }}
              >
                <span className="dm-btn-icon">{btn.icon}</span>
                <span className="dm-btn-text">
                  <strong>{btn.label}</strong>
                  <small>{btn.sublabel}</small>
                </span>
                {/* Ripple */}
                {ripple && (
                  <span className="dm-ripple" style={{ left: ripple.x, top: ripple.y }} />
                )}
              </a>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* ── FOOTER ── */}
          
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

==================== D:\ardm_teacher\student_client\src\ImageViewer.jsx ====================

// ============================================================
// ImageViewer.jsx — Premium Fullscreen Image Viewer
// WhatsApp-style • Next-level animations • Download support
// ============================================================
// 
// USAGE:
// 1. Import করুন:  import ImageViewer from './ImageViewer';
// 2. State যোগ করুন (Index component এ):
//      const [viewerImg, setViewerImg] = useState(null);
// 3. PremiumStudentCard এর img tag এ onClick যোগ করুন:
//      onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setViewerImg(data.ImageURL || DEFAULT_IMAGE); }}
// 4. DetailView এর profile img tag এ onClick যোগ করুন:
//      onClick={() => setViewerImg(data.ImageURL || DEFAULT_IMAGE)}
// 5. Return JSX এর যেকোনো জায়গায় (toast এর আগে) যোগ করুন:
//      <ImageViewer src={viewerImg} onClose={() => setViewerImg(null)} />
// ============================================================

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Download, X, ZoomIn, ZoomOut } from 'lucide-react';

const ImageViewer = ({ src, onClose }) => {
  const [visible, setVisible]     = useState(false);
  const [closing, setClosing]     = useState(false);
  const [scale, setScale]         = useState(1);
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);
  const [downloaded, setDownloaded]   = useState(false);

  // touch / drag state
  const touchStart  = useRef(null);
  const dragY       = useRef(0);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState(0);
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);

  // ── mount / open ──
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!src) return;
    setVisible(false);
    setClosing(false);
    setScale(1);
    setDragOffset(0);
    setDownloaded(false);
    // micro-delay so the CSS transition fires from the start state
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => setVisible(true)));
  }, [src]);

  // ── back-button support ──
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!src) return;
    window.history.pushState({ page: 'imageViewer' }, '');

    const handlePop = () => triggerClose();
    window.addEventListener('popstate', handlePop);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('popstate', handlePop);
  }, [src]);

  // ── body scroll lock ──
  useEffect(() => {
    if (src) {
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
    return () => { document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
  }, [src]);

  const triggerClose = useCallback(() => {
    setClosing(true);
    setVisible(false);
    setDragOffset(0);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setClosing(false);
      onClose();
    }, 380);
  }, [onClose]);

  // ── download ──
  const handleDownload = async () => {
    if (downloading || downloaded) return;
    setDownloading(true);
    try {
      const res  = await fetch(src);
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const url  = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a    = document.createElement('a');
      a.href     = url;
      a.download = `student_photo_${Date.now()}.jpg`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      setDownloaded(true);
      setTimeout(() => setDownloaded(false), 3000);
    } catch {
      // fallback: direct link
      const a    = document.createElement('a');
      a.href     = src;
      a.target   = '_blank';
      a.download = 'student_photo.jpg';
      a.click();
      setDownloaded(true);
      setTimeout(() => setDownloaded(false), 3000);
    } finally {
      setDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  // ── touch drag-to-dismiss ──
  const onTouchStart = (e) => {
    if (scale > 1) return; // don't drag while zoomed
    touchStart.current = e.touches[0].clientY;
    dragY.current      = 0;
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  const onTouchMove = (e) => {
    if (scale > 1 || touchStart.current === null) return;
    const delta = e.touches[0].clientY - touchStart.current;
    if (Math.abs(delta) > 8) setIsDragging(true);
    dragY.current = delta;
    setDragOffset(delta);
  };

  const onTouchEnd = () => {
    if (Math.abs(dragY.current) > 120) {
      triggerClose();
    } else {
      setDragOffset(0);
    }
    touchStart.current = null;
    setIsDragging(false);
  };

  if (!src && !closing) return null;

  // ── derived styles ──
  const absDrag    = Math.abs(dragOffset);
  const backdropOp = visible && !closing
    ? Math.max(0.1, 1 - absDrag / 350)
    : 0;

  const imgTransform = [
    `translateY(${dragOffset}px)`,
    `scale(${visible && !closing
        ? Math.max(0.75, 1 - absDrag / 700) * scale
        : closing ? 0.55 : 0.72
    })`,
  ].join(' ');

  const imgOpacity = visible && !closing
    ? Math.max(0.25, 1 - absDrag / 280)
    : 0;

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @keyframes iv-fade-in {
          from { opacity: 0; }
          to   { opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes iv-slide-up {
          from { transform: translateY(60px) scale(0.72); opacity: 0; }
          to   { transform: translateY(0)    scale(1);    opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes iv-btn-pop {
          0%   { transform: scale(0) rotate(-20deg); opacity: 0; }
          65%  { transform: scale(1.18) rotate(3deg); }
          100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes iv-checkmark {
          0%   { stroke-dashoffset: 40; }
          100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0;  }
        }
        @keyframes iv-ring-pulse {
          0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0px rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
          50%       { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,0);    }
        }
        @keyframes iv-shimmer {
          0%   { background-position: -200% center; }
          100% { background-position:  200% center; }
        }
        .iv-backdrop {
          position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9000;
          background: rgba(0,0,0,${backdropOp});
          backdrop-filter: blur(${Math.max(0, 28 * backdropOp)}px);
          -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(${Math.max(0, 28 * backdropOp)}px);
          transition: background 0.06s ease, backdrop-filter 0.06s ease;
        }
        .iv-image {
          max-width: 96vw;
          max-height: 80vh;
          width: auto;
          height: auto;
          border-radius: 18px;
          object-fit: contain;
          transform: ${imgTransform};
          opacity: ${imgOpacity};
          transition: ${isDragging ? 'none' : 'transform 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), opacity 0.38s ease, border-radius 0.2s ease'};
          will-change: transform, opacity;
          box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
          user-select: none;
          -webkit-user-drag: none;
          touch-action: none;
        }
        .iv-close-btn {
          animation: iv-btn-pop 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.12s both;
          animation-play-state: ${visible ? 'running' : 'paused'};
        }
        .iv-dl-btn {
          animation: iv-btn-pop 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.22s both;
          animation-play-state: ${visible ? 'running' : 'paused'};
        }
        .iv-hint {
          animation: iv-btn-pop 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) 0.35s both;
          animation-play-state: ${visible ? 'running' : 'paused'};
          opacity: ${visible && !closing ? 1 : 0};
          transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }
        .iv-dl-shimmer {
          background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffffff22 0%, #ffffff55 40%, #ffffff22 60%);
          background-size: 200% 100%;
          animation: iv-shimmer 1.1s linear infinite;
        }
        .iv-checkmark-path {
          stroke-dasharray: 40;
          stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          animation: iv-checkmark 0.4s ease 0.05s both;
        }
        .iv-ring-pulse {
          animation: iv-ring-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
      `}</style>

      {/* ── BACKDROP ── */}
      <div
        className="iv-backdrop flex flex-col items-center justify-center"
        onClick={(e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) triggerClose(); }}
        onTouchStart={onTouchStart}
        onTouchMove={onTouchMove}
        onTouchEnd={onTouchEnd}
      >

        {/* ── TOP BAR: CLOSE ── */}
        <div
          className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 flex justify-end px-4 pt-12 pb-4 z-10"
          style={{ opacity: visible && !closing ? Math.max(0, 1 - absDrag / 120) : 0, transition: 'opacity 0.2s ease' }}
        >
          <button
            className="iv-close-btn w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 flex items-center justify-center active:scale-90 transition-transform"
            onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); triggerClose(); }}
            style={{ boxShadow: '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)' }}
          >
            <X size={20} color="white" strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* ── IMAGE ── */}
        <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center w-full flex-1">
          <img
            src={src}
            className="iv-image"
            alt="Student"
            draggable={false}
            onDoubleClick={() => setScale(s => s === 1 ? 2 : 1)}
          />

          {/* drag-to-dismiss hint pill */}
          {absDrag > 40 && scale === 1 && (
            <div
              className="absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-md text-white text-xs font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-full border border-white/20"
              style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}
            >
              ছেড়ে দিন বন্ধ হবে
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ── BOTTOM BAR: DOWNLOAD ── */}
        <div
          className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 flex flex-col items-center gap-4 pb-14 pt-6 z-10"
          style={{ opacity: visible && !closing ? Math.max(0, 1 - absDrag / 100) : 0, transition: 'opacity 0.2s ease' }}
        >
          {/* Download button */}
          <button
            className="iv-dl-btn iv-ring-pulse relative overflow-hidden flex items-center gap-3 px-8 py-4 rounded-2xl active:scale-95 transition-transform"
            style={{
              background: downloaded
                ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981, #059669)'
                : 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.25), rgba(255,255,255,0.12))',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3)',
              boxShadow: '0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.35)',
              transition: 'background 0.35s ease',
              minWidth: 160,
              justifyContent: 'center',
            }}
            onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleDownload(); }}
            disabled={downloading}
          >
            {/* shimmer while downloading */}
            {downloading && <div className="iv-dl-shimmer absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl" />}

            <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-3">
              {downloading ? (
                <div
                  className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2 border-white/40 border-t-white animate-spin"
                />
              ) : downloaded ? (
                <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none">
                  <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="white" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeOpacity="0.4"/>
                  <path
                    className="iv-checkmark-path"
                    d="M7 12.5l3.5 3.5L17 9"
                    stroke="white"
                    strokeWidth="2.2"
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    fill="none"
                  />
                </svg>
              ) : (
                <Download size={20} color="white" strokeWidth={2.2} />
              )}
              <span className="text-white font-black text-sm">
                {downloading ? 'Downloading…' : downloaded ? 'Downloaded!' : 'ছবি ডাউনলোড'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </button>

          {/* hint */}
          <p className="iv-hint text-white/40 text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider">
            উপরে ← সোয়াইপ করুন বন্ধ করতে
          </p>
        </div>

      </div>
    </>
  );
};

export default ImageViewer;

  // RBAC: টিচার তখনই যোগ/এডিট করতে পারবে যখন সার্ভার প্রোফাইলে canEditAssignedClass = true

const formatDate = (dateString) => {
  if (!dateString) return "-";
  return new Date(dateString).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
    day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric'
  });
};

export default function Info() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [searchId, setSearchId] = useState('');
  const [student, setStudent] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [currentUrl, setCurrentUrl] = useState('');

useEffect(() => {
  const pathId = window.location.pathname.substring(1);

  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const queryId = params.get('id');

  const idFromUrl = pathId || queryId;
  setCurrentUrl(window.location.href);

  // 🔒 Only numeric ID allowed
  if (idFromUrl && /^\d{10}$/.test(idFromUrl)) {
    setSearchId(idFromUrl);
    fetchStudentData(idFromUrl);
  }
}, []);


  const fetchStudentData = async (id) => {
  if (!id) return;

  setLoading(true);
  setError('');

  try {
    // 🔒 পাবলিক QR ভেরিফিকেশন (লগইন ছাড়া) — সার্ভার শুধু নিরাপদ ফিল্ডগুলো পাঠায়
    const doc = await studentApi.publicVerify(id);
    if (doc) {
      setStudent(toUiStudent(doc));

      const newUrl = `${window.location.origin}/${id}`;
      window.history.pushState({ path: newUrl }, '', newUrl);
      setCurrentUrl(newUrl);
    } else {
      setStudent(null);
      setError('শিক্ষার্থীর তথ্য পাওয়া যায়নি');
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    setStudent(null);
    setError(extractApiErrorMessage(err, "সার্ভার সংযোগ সমস্যা"));
  } finally {
    setLoading(false);
  }
};


  const handleSearch = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!/^\d{10}$/.test(String(searchId).trim())) {
      setError('স্টুডেন্ট আইডি অবশ্যই ১০ ডিজিটের সংখ্যা হতে হবে');
      return;
    }
    fetchStudentData(String(searchId).trim());
  };

  const handleReset = () => {
    setStudent(null);
    setSearchId('');
    setError('');
    // Reset URL to root path /
    window.history.pushState({}, '', '/');
  };

  // --- LOADING VIEW ---
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-emerald-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
        <div className="relative">
          <div className="w-20 h-20 border-4 border-emerald-200 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
          <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-20 h-20 border-4 border-emerald-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
          <School className="absolute inset-0 m-auto text-emerald-700 w-8 h-8" />
        </div>
        <p className="mt-6 text-emerald-800 font-bold animate-pulse">তথ্য লোড হচ্ছে...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // --- SEARCH VIEW ---
  if (!student) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F0FDF4] relative overflow-hidden font-sans">
        {/* Decorative Background Pattern (Islamic Motif Concept) */}

        {/* Top Header */}
        <header className="absolute top-0 w-full py-6 px-4 flex justify-between items-center z-10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
             <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-emerald-700 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg text-white">
               <School size={20} />
             </div>
             <span className="font-bold text-emerald-900 hidden sm:block">{INSTITUTE_NAME}</span>
          </div>
        </header>

        <main className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-screen px-4 relative z-10">
          
          <div className="w-full max-w-xl bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white p-8 md:p-12 rounded-3xl shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(0,128,96,0.15)] text-center">
            
            <div className="mb-8">
              <div className="inline-block p-4 bg-emerald-100 rounded-full mb-4 animate-bounce-slow">
                <BookOpen className="w-12 h-12 text-emerald-700" />
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold text-emerald-950 mb-2">{INSTITUTE_NAME}</h1>
              <p className="text-emerald-600 font-medium">{INSTITUTE_TAGLINE}</p>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="relative group">
              <div className="absolute -inset-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-teal-400 rounded-xl blur opacity-20 group-hover:opacity-40 transition duration-500"></div>
              <div className="relative flex items-center bg-white border border-emerald-100 rounded-xl p-2 shadow-lg">
                <Search className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-400 ml-3" />
                <input
                  type="number"

                  onChange={(e) => setSearchId(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="শিক্ষার্থীর আইডি নম্বর লিখুন..."

// মাউস পজিশন হুক (প্যারালাক্স ইফেক্টের জন্য)
const useMousePosition = () => {
  const [mousePosition, setMousePosition] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateMousePosition = (ev) => {
      setMousePosition({ x: ev.clientX, y: ev.clientY });
    };
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', updateMousePosition);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('mousemove', updateMousePosition);
  }, []);

  return mousePosition;
};

// টাইপরাইটার ইফেক্ট হুক (টার্মিনাল লগের জন্য)
const useTypewriter = (text, speed = 50) => {
  const [displayText, setDisplayText] = useState('');
  
  useEffect(() => {
    let i = 0;
    setDisplayText('');
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (i < text.length) {
        setDisplayText((prev) => prev + text.charAt(i));
        i++;
      } else {
        clearInterval(timer);
      }
    }, speed);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [text, speed]);

  return displayText;
};

 * ==========================================
 * SUB-COMPONENTS

// 1. Interactive Starfield Background (Canvas based)
const StarfieldBackground = () => {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    let width = window.innerWidth;
    let height = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;

    let particles = [];
    const particleCount = 100;

    class Particle {
      constructor() {
        this.x = Math.random() * width;
        this.y = Math.random() * height;
        this.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
        this.vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
        this.size = Math.random() * 2;
        this.color = `rgba(${Math.random() * 100 + 155}, ${Math.random() * 100 + 155}, 255, ${Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1})`;
      }

      update() {
        this.x += this.vx;
        this.y += this.vy;

        if (this.x < 0 || this.x > width) this.vx *= -1;
        if (this.y < 0 || this.y > height) this.vy *= -1;
      }

      draw() {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // Initialize particles
    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
      particles.push(new Particle());
    }

    const animate = () => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
      
      // Draw connecting lines
      for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        particles[i].update();
        particles[i].draw();
        
        for (let j = i; j < particles.length; j++) {
          const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
          const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
          const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

          if (distance < 100) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(100, 200, 255, ${1 - distance / 100})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
            ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
            ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    };

    animate();

    const handleResize = () => {
      width = window.innerWidth;
      height = window.innerHeight;
      canvas.width = width;
      canvas.height = height;
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, []);

  return <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="fixed inset-0 z-0 bg-[#0f172a]" />;
};

// 2. System Status Terminal
const SystemTerminal = () => {
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([
    { id: 1, text: "> সিস্টেম ইনিশিয়ালাইজেশন শুরু হয়েছে...", type: "info" },
    { id: 2, text: "> সার্ভার সংযোগ স্থাপন করা হচ্ছে [192.168.x.x]", type: "warning" },
    { id: 3, text: "> ডেটাবেস অপ্টিমাইজেশন চলছে (৮৫%)", type: "success" },
  ]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const messages = [
      { text: "> সিকিউরিটি প্রোটোকল চেক করা হচ্ছে...", type: "info" },
      { text: "> ফ্রন্টএন্ড অ্যাসেট কম্পাইল হচ্ছে...", type: "warning" },
      { text: "> CDN ক্যাশ ক্লিয়ার করা হয়েছে...", type: "success" },
      { text: "> ইউজার ডেটা এনক্রিপশন ভেরিফাইড।", type: "success" },
      { text: "> নতুন ফিচার ডিপ্লয়মেন্ট প্রসেস শুরু...", type: "info" }
    ];

    let msgIndex = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (msgIndex < messages.length) {
        setLogs(prev => [...prev.slice(-4), { ...messages[msgIndex], id: Date.now() }]);
        msgIndex++;
      } else {
        msgIndex = 0; // Loop messages
      }
    }, 2500);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md rounded-lg border border-slate-700 p-4 font-mono text-xs md:text-sm h-48 overflow-hidden relative shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
        <Terminal size={14} className="text-green-500" />
        <span className="text-slate-400">root@server:~# updates</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {logs.map((log) => (
