const Mantainance = () => {
  const { x, y } = useMousePosition();
  const [rotateX, setRotateX] = useState(0);
  const [rotateY, setRotateY] = useState(0);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [subscribeStatus, setSubscribeStatus] = useState('idle'); // idle, loading, success
  
  // Countdown State
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState({ d: 0, h: 0, m: 0, s: 0 });

  // 3D Tilt Logic
  useEffect(() => {
    const box = document.getElementById('main-card');
    if (!box) return;

    const rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
    const centerX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
    const centerY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;

    const rotateXValue = ((y - centerY) / (window.innerHeight / 2)) * -5; // Max 5 deg tilt
    const rotateYValue = ((x - centerX) / (window.innerWidth / 2)) * 5;

    setRotateX(rotateXValue);
    setRotateY(rotateYValue);
  }, [x, y]);

  // Countdown Timer Logic
  useEffect(() => {
    const target = new Date();
    target.setDate(target.getDate() + 5); // 5 days from now
    
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const now = new Date();
      const diff = target - now;

      if (diff > 0) {
        setTimeLeft({
          d: Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)),
          h: Math.floor((diff / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24),
          m: Math.floor((diff / 1000 / 60) % 60),
          s: Math.floor((diff / 1000) % 60),
        });
      }
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const handleSubscribe = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!email) return;
    setSubscribeStatus('loading');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setSubscribeStatus('success');
      setEmail('');
    }, 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative min-h-screen overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center font-sans text-slate-200 selection:bg-cyan-500 selection:text-black">
      
      {/* 1. Background Layer */}
      <StarfieldBackground />
      
      {/* 2. Ambient Glows */}
      <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full overflow-hidden pointer-events-none z-0">
        <div className="absolute top-[-10%] left-[20%] w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-purple-600/20 rounded-full blur-[120px] mix-blend-screen animate-pulse-slow"></div>
        <div className="absolute bottom-[-10%] right-[20%] w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-cyan-600/20 rounded-full blur-[120px] mix-blend-screen animate-pulse-slow delay-1000"></div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Main 3D Card Container */}
      <div 
        id="main-card"
        className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-6xl mx-auto p-4 md:p-8 perspective-1000"
        style={{
          transform: `perspective(1000px) rotateX(${rotateX}deg) rotateY(${rotateY}deg)`,
          transition: 'transform 0.1s ease-out'
        }}
      >
        <div className="bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden relative group">
          
          {/* Decorative Top Bar */}
          <div className="h-1 w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 via-purple-500 to-pink-500"></div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-0">
            
            {/* Left Column: Information */}
            <div className="p-8 md:p-12 flex flex-col justify-center relative">
              {/* Badge */}
              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider w-max mb-6">
                <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2">
                  <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-cyan-400 opacity-75"></span>

import { useState } from 'react';

// ── HELPERS (হুবহু মূল HTML অ্যাপের লজিক অনুযায়ী) ──
const e2b = (num) => String(num).replace(/\d/g, d => '০১২৩৪৫৬৭৮৯'[d]);

const guessGender = (student) => {
  const g = student.Gender || student.gender || '';
  const str = g.toString().toLowerCase().trim();
  if (['male', 'm', 'ছেলে', 'ছাত্র', 'বালক'].includes(str)) return 'ছাত্র';
  if (['female', 'f', 'মেয়ে', 'ছাত্রী', 'বালিকা'].includes(str)) return 'ছাত্রী';
  return 'অজানা';
};

const calculateAge = (dobStr) => {
  if (!dobStr) return null;
  const dob = new Date(dobStr);
  if (isNaN(dob.getTime())) return null;
  const ageDifMs = Date.now() - dob.getTime();
  const ageDate = new Date(ageDifMs);
  return Math.abs(ageDate.getUTCFullYear() - 1970);
};

// টেবিল কলাম সিলেক্টর অপশন (মূল fieldOptions অনুযায়ী, ফিল্ড-নেম React অ্যাপের ডাটা অনুযায়ী)

/**

const PdfExportModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, data, appName }) => {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [subtitle, setSubtitle] = useState('');
  const [format, setFormat] = useState('table');
  const [tableColumns, setTableColumns] = useState([
    { id: 'col1', type: 'data', field: 'serial', label: 'ক্র.নং', width: '10', default: '' },
    { id: 'col2', type: 'data', field: 'StudentNameBn', label: 'শিক্ষার্থীর নাম', width: '40', default: '' },
    { id: 'col3', type: 'data', field: 'Roll', label: 'রোল', width: '15', default: '' },
    { id: 'col4', type: 'data', field: 'ID', label: 'আইডি', width: '35', default: '' },
  ]);
  const [rowHeight, setRowHeight] = useState('py-2');
  const [groupBy, setGroupBy] = useState('');
  const [plainCols, setPlainCols] = useState(3);
  const [separator, setSeparator] = useState(' - ');
  // প্রতিটা আইটেম: { id, field, prefix } — prefix হলো কাস্টম লেবেল, যেমন "রোল: "
  const [plainFieldsOrder, setPlainFieldsOrder] = useState([
    { id: 'pf1', field: 'Roll', prefix: '' },
    { id: 'pf2', field: 'StudentNameBn', prefix: '' },
  ]);
  const [showFooter, setShowFooter] = useState(true);
  const [titleHistory, setTitleHistory] = useState(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(TITLE_HISTORY_KEY)) || []; } catch { return []; }
  });
  const [subtitleHistory, setSubtitleHistory] = useState(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SUBTITLE_HISTORY_KEY)) || []; } catch { return []; }
  });
  const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);

  const saveToHistory = (key, value, historyArr, setHistoryArr) => {
    const v = (value || '').trim();
    if (!v) return;
    const updated = [v, ...historyArr.filter(h => h !== v)].slice(0, 12);
    setHistoryArr(updated);
    try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(updated)); } catch {}
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const totalWidth = tableColumns.reduce((sum, c) => sum + (parseInt(c.width) || 0), 0);
  const widthColor = totalWidth === 100 ? 'text-emerald-600' : totalWidth > 100 ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-orange-500';

  const updateCol = (index, key, value) => {
    setTableColumns(prev => prev.map((c, i) => (i === index ? { ...c, [key]: value } : c)));
  };

  const removeCol = (index) => setTableColumns(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));

  const addCol = (type) => {
    colIdCounter++;
    setTableColumns(prev => [...prev, {
      id: 'col' + colIdCounter,
      type,
      field: type === 'data' ? 'StudentNameBn' : '',
      label: type === 'data' ? 'নতুন কলাম' : 'ফাঁকা কলাম',
      width: '15',
      default: ''
    }]);
  };

  const addPlainField = (val) => {
    if (!val) return;
    setPlainFieldsOrder(prev => {
      if (prev.some(item => item.field === val)) return prev;
      plainFieldIdCounter++;
      return [...prev, { id: 'pf' + plainFieldIdCounter, field: val, prefix: '' }];
    });
  };
  const removePlainField = (index) => setPlainFieldsOrder(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  const updatePlainFieldPrefix = (index, prefix) => {
    setPlainFieldsOrder(prev => prev.map((item, i) => (i === index ? { ...item, prefix } : item)));
  };
  const moveField = (index, direction) => {
    setPlainFieldsOrder(prev => {
      const newIndex = index + direction;
      if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= prev.length) return prev;
      const arr = [...prev];
      [arr[index], arr[newIndex]] = [arr[newIndex], arr[index]];
      return arr;
    });
  };

  // ── টেবিল-ভিউ এর জন্য সেল ভ্যালু (মূল generateSuperPDF -> table branch অনুযায়ী) ──
  const getFieldValueForTable = (s, field, index) => {
    if (field === 'serial') return e2b(index + 1);
    if (field === 'gender') return e2b(guessGender(s));
    if (field === 'address') {
      const val = [s.HouseNameBn, s.VillageBn, s.WardNo ? 'ওয়ার্ড: ' + e2b(s.WardNo) : '', s.UnionBn, s.UpazilaBn, s.DistrictBn].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
      return e2b(val || '-');
    }
    if (field === 'age') {
      const a = calculateAge(s.DOB);
      return e2b(a !== null ? a + ' বছর' : '-');
    }
    if (field === 'DOB') {
      return e2b(s.DOB ? new Date(s.DOB).toLocaleDateString('bn-BD') : '-');
    }
    return e2b(s[field] || '-');
  };

  const generateSuperPDF = () => {
    if (!data || data.length === 0) return;
    setGenerating(true);

    saveToHistory(TITLE_HISTORY_KEY, title, titleHistory, setTitleHistory);
    saveToHistory(SUBTITLE_HISTORY_KEY, subtitle, subtitleHistory, setSubtitleHistory);

    const dataToExport = data;
    const finalTitle = e2b(title).replace(/(\/n|\\n)/g, '<br>');
    const finalSubtitle = e2b(subtitle).replace(/(\/n|\\n)/g, '<br>');

    let htmlContent = `
      <style>
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anek+Bangla:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Noto+Serif+Bengali:wght@500;600;700&display=swap');
        .pdf-body { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', serif; padding: 0; color: #000; background: white; }
        .hp-header { text-align: center; padding-bottom: 20px; padding-top: 5px; }
        .hp-hall-no { font-family: 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 800; color: #000; margin: 0; line-height: 1; }
        .hp-exam { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #222; margin-top: 10px; }
        .hp-class-section { margin-bottom: 20px; }
        .hp-class-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; page-break-after: avoid; }
        .hp-class-name { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #000; }
        .hp-class-stats { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #222; }
        .hp-grid { column-gap: 10px; }
        .hp-item { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 0; font-size: 16px; page-break-inside: avoid; }
        .hp-serial { flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 35px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', monospace; }
        .hp-roll { flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 35px; font-weight: 700; font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', monospace; }
        .hp-name { flex-grow: 1; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; white-space: normal; word-wrap: break-word; }
        .hp-footer-summary { margin-top: 25px; border-top: 2px solid #000; border-bottom: 2px solid #000; padding: 10px; text-align: center; page-break-inside: avoid; }
        .hp-total-text { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #000; margin-bottom: 2px; }
        .hp-total-sub { font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #333; }
        .official-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-bottom: 20px; font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', serif; }
        .official-table th { background-color: #f1f5f9 !important; border: 1.5px solid #000; padding: 10px 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #000; text-align: center; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
        .official-table td { border: 1.5px solid #000; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #111; vertical-align: middle; }
        .official-table tr:nth-child(even) td { background-color: #f8fafc !important; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
        @page { margin: 15mm; }
      </style>
      <div class="pdf-body">
    `;

    if (format === 'table') {
      htmlContent += `
        ${finalTitle ? `<h1 style="text-align: center; font-size: 26px; font-family: 'Anek Bangla', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: ${finalSubtitle ? '5px' : '10px'}; color: #000;">${finalTitle}</h1>` : ''}
        ${finalSubtitle ? `<h2 style="text-align: center; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'Noto Serif Bengali', serif; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 15px; color: #333;">${finalSubtitle}</h2>` : ''}
      `;

      const pd = rowHeight === 'py-1' ? '6px 8px' : rowHeight === 'py-4' ? '14px 8px' : '10px 8px';

      let totalBoysAll = 0, totalGirlsAll = 0;
      dataToExport.forEach(s => {
        const g = guessGender(s);
        if (g === 'ছাত্র') totalBoysAll++;
        if (g === 'ছাত্রী') totalGirlsAll++;
      });

      htmlContent += `<table class="official-table"><thead><tr>`;
      tableColumns.forEach(col => {
        const align = (col.field === 'serial' || col.field === 'Roll' || col.type === 'blank') ? 'center' : 'left';
        htmlContent += `<th style="width: ${col.width}%; text-align: ${align};">${e2b(col.label)}</th>`;
      });
      htmlContent += `</tr></thead><tbody>`;

      dataToExport.forEach((s, index) => {
        htmlContent += `<tr>`;
        tableColumns.forEach(col => {
          const align = (col.field === 'serial' || col.field === 'Roll' || col.type === 'blank') ? 'center' : 'left';
          let cellData = '';
          if (col.type === 'blank') {
            cellData = e2b(col.default || '');
          } else {
            cellData = getFieldValueForTable(s, col.field, index);
          }
          htmlContent += `<td style="padding: ${pd}; text-align: ${align};">${cellData}</td>`;
        });
        htmlContent += `</tr>`;
      });

      htmlContent += `</tbody></table>`;
      if (showFooter) {
        htmlContent += `
        <div class="hp-footer-summary">
          <div class="hp-total-text">সর্বমোট শিক্ষার্থী: ${e2b(dataToExport.length)} জন</div>
          <div class="hp-total-sub">মোট ছাত্র: ${e2b(totalBoysAll)} জন | মোট ছাত্রী: ${e2b(totalGirlsAll)} জন</div>
        </div>`;
      }
    } else {
      // ── প্লেন ভিউ (হুবহু মূল লজিক) ──
      const cols = parseInt(plainCols) || 3;

      if (finalTitle || finalSubtitle) {
        htmlContent += `<div class="hp-header">`;
        if (finalTitle) htmlContent += `<div class="hp-hall-no">${finalTitle}</div>`;
        if (finalSubtitle) htmlContent += `<div class="hp-exam">${finalSubtitle}</div>`;
        htmlContent += `</div>`;
      }

      let groupedData = {};
      if (groupBy) {
        dataToExport.forEach(s => {
          let keyVal = 'অন্যান্য';
          if (groupBy === 'age') {
            const age = calculateAge(s.DOB);
            keyVal = age !== null ? age : 'অজানা';
          } else if (groupBy === 'gender') {
            keyVal = guessGender(s);
          } else {
            const val = s[groupBy];
            keyVal = (val === undefined || val === null || val === '') ? (groupBy === 'BloodGroup' ? 'গ্রুপ অজানা' : 'অন্যান্য') : val;
          }
          if (!groupedData[keyVal]) groupedData[keyVal] = [];
          groupedData[keyVal].push(s);
        });
      } else {
        groupedData['All'] = dataToExport;
      }

      let sortedKeys = Object.keys(groupedData);
      if (groupBy === 'age') {
        sortedKeys.sort((a, b) => {
          if (a === 'অজানা') return 1;
          if (b === 'অজানা') return -1;
          return parseInt(a) - parseInt(b);
        });
      }

      const hasSerial = plainFieldsOrder.some(item => item.field === 'serial');

      sortedKeys.forEach(groupName => {
        const groupStudents = groupedData[groupName];
        htmlContent += `<div class="hp-class-section">`;

        if (groupBy) {
          let boysCount = 0, girlsCount = 0;
          groupStudents.forEach(s => {
            const g = guessGender(s);
            if (g === 'ছাত্র') boysCount++;
            if (g === 'ছাত্রী') girlsCount++;
          });
          const genderText = (boysCount > 0 || girlsCount > 0) ? `(ছাত্র: ${e2b(boysCount)} জন | ছাত্রী: ${e2b(girlsCount)} জন)` : '';
          let displayGroupName = e2b(groupName);
          if (groupBy === 'ClassBn') displayGroupName += ' শ্রেণি';
          else if (groupBy === 'age' && groupName !== 'অজানা') displayGroupName = `বয়স ${displayGroupName}`;

          htmlContent += `
            <div class="hp-class-header">
              <div class="hp-class-name">${displayGroupName} - ${e2b(groupStudents.length)} জন</div>
              <div class="hp-class-stats">${genderText}</div>
            </div>
          `;
        }

        htmlContent += `<div class="hp-grid" style="column-count: ${cols};">`;

        let serialCount = 1;
        groupStudents.forEach(s => {
          let prefixHtml = '';
          let mainParts = [];

          plainFieldsOrder.forEach(item => {
            const f = item.field;
            let val = '';
            if (f === 'serial') val = e2b(serialCount) + '.';
            else if (f === 'gender') val = guessGender(s);
            else if (f === 'address') {
              val = [s.HouseNameBn, s.VillageBn, s.WardNo ? 'ওয়ার্ড: ' + e2b(s.WardNo) : '', s.UnionBn, s.UpazilaBn, s.DistrictBn].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
            } else if (f === 'age') {
              const a = calculateAge(s.DOB);
              val = a !== null ? e2b(a) + ' বছর' : '';
            } else if (f === 'DOB') {
              val = s.DOB ? e2b(new Date(s.DOB).toLocaleDateString('bn-BD')) : '';
            } else {
              val = s[f] || '';
            }

            if (val) {
              val = (f !== 'serial') ? e2b(val) : val;
              const customPrefix = item.prefix ? e2b(item.prefix) : '';

              if (f === 'serial') {
                prefixHtml += `<span class="hp-serial">${customPrefix}${val}</span>`;
              } else if (!mainParts.length && !hasSerial && !prefixHtml) {
                // প্রথম ফিল্ড (যখন সিরিয়াল নেই) — বোল্ড প্রিফিক্স স্টাইলে দেখানো হবে
                prefixHtml += `<span class="hp-roll">${customPrefix}${val}${separator}</span>`;
              } else {
                mainParts.push(`${customPrefix}${val}`);
              }
            }
          });

          const mainHtml = mainParts.join(separator);
          htmlContent += `<div class="hp-item">${prefixHtml}<span class="hp-name">${mainHtml}</span></div>`;
          serialCount++;
        });

        htmlContent += `</div></div>`;
      });

      let totalBoysAll = 0, totalGirlsAll = 0;
      dataToExport.forEach(s => {
        const g = guessGender(s);
        if (g === 'ছাত্র') totalBoysAll++;
        if (g === 'ছাত্রী') totalGirlsAll++;
      });

      if (showFooter) {
        htmlContent += `
        <div class="hp-footer-summary">
          <div class="hp-total-text">এই লিস্টে মোট শিক্ষার্থী: ${e2b(dataToExport.length)} জন</div>
          <div class="hp-total-sub">মোট ছাত্র: ${e2b(totalBoysAll)} জন | মোট ছাত্রী: ${e2b(totalGirlsAll)} জন</div>
        </div>
      `;
      }
    }

    htmlContent += `</div>`;

    let fileName = subtitle.trim() || title.trim();
    fileName = fileName ? fileName.replace(/(\/n|\\n)/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : (appName ? `${appName}_Report` : 'Student_Report');

    const w = window.open('', '_blank');
    w.document.write(`
      <html>
        <head>
          <meta charset="UTF-8">
          <title>${fileName}</title>
        </head>
        <body>${htmlContent}</body>
      </html>
    `);
    w.document.close();

    setTimeout(() => {
      w.focus();
      w.print();
      setGenerating(false);
      onClose();
    }, 700);
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[99999] flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md"
      onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}
    >
      <div className="bg-slate-50 rounded-[24px] w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl relative">

        <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-white rounded-t-[24px] border-b border-slate-200 flex justify-between items-center shrink-0">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Printer size={20} className="text-red-500" /> অ্যাডভান্সড PDF এক্সপোর্ট
            </h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium mt-1">A4 পেজ সাইজে কাস্টমাইজড রিপোর্ট তৈরি করুন</p>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-slate-200 active:scale-90 transition-all">
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 space-y-6">

          <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 mb-3">হেডলাইন্স (ঐচ্ছিক)</h3>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <input
                type="text"
                list="pdf-title-suggestions"
                value={title}
                onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                onBlur={() => saveToHistory(TITLE_HISTORY_KEY, title, titleHistory, setTitleHistory)}
                placeholder="প্রধান শিরোনাম (যেমন: বার্ষিক পরীক্ষার ফলাফল)"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 text-sm rounded-xl py-2.5 px-4 border border-slate-200 focus:border-indigo-400 focus:bg-white transition-all outline-none font-bold"
              />
              <datalist id="pdf-title-suggestions">
                {titleHistory.map((t, i) => <option key={i} value={t} />)}
              </datalist>
              <input
                type="text"
                list="pdf-subtitle-suggestions"
                value={subtitle}
                onChange={e => setSubtitle(e.target.value)}
                onBlur={() => saveToHistory(SUBTITLE_HISTORY_KEY, subtitle, subtitleHistory, setSubtitleHistory)}
                placeholder="সাব-টাইটেল (যেমন: শ্রেণি: ৬ষ্ঠ, বিষয়: গণিত)"
                className="w-full bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 text-sm rounded-xl py-2.5 px-4 border border-slate-200 focus:border-indigo-400 focus:bg-white transition-all outline-none"
              />
              <datalist id="pdf-subtitle-suggestions">
                {subtitleHistory.map((t, i) => <option key={i} value={t} />)}
              </datalist>
              {(titleHistory.length > 0 || subtitleHistory.length > 0) && (
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-medium">💡 ইনপুট বক্সে ক্লিক করলে আগের লেখাগুলো সাজেশনে দেখাবে</p>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-3">রিপোর্টের ধরন নির্বাচন করুন:</h3>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <button
                onClick={() => setFormat('table')}
                className={`border-2 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center relative overflow-hidden ${format === 'table' ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50' : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-indigo-300'}`}
              >
                {format === 'table' && <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 text-indigo-600"><Check size={18} /></div>}
                <TableIcon size={30} className={`mx-auto mb-2 ${format === 'table' ? 'text-indigo-500' : 'text-slate-400'}`} />
                <h4 className={`font-bold ${format === 'table' ? 'text-slate-800' : 'text-slate-600'}`}>টেবিল ভিউ</h4>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">কাস্টম কলাম ও রো-হাইট</p>
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setFormat('plain')}
                className={`border-2 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center relative overflow-hidden ${format === 'plain' ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50' : 'border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-indigo-300'}`}
              >
                {format === 'plain' && <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 text-indigo-600"><Check size={18} /></div>}
                <List size={30} className={`mx-auto mb-2 ${format === 'plain' ? 'text-indigo-500' : 'text-slate-400'}`} />
                <h4 className={`font-bold ${format === 'plain' ? 'text-slate-800' : 'text-slate-600'}`}>প্লেন ভিউ</h4>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">গ্রুপিং ও কলাম অপশন</p>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">ফুটার সামারি দেখান</h3>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">মোট শিক্ষার্থী + ছাত্র/ছাত্রী সংখ্যা নিচে দেখাবে</p>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowFooter(v => !v)}
              className={`relative w-12 h-6 rounded-full shrink-0 transition-colors ${showFooter ? 'bg-indigo-600' : 'bg-slate-300'}`}
            >
              <span className={`absolute top-0.5 left-0.5 w-5 h-5 bg-white rounded-full shadow transition-transform ${showFooter ? 'translate-x-6' : ''}`} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {format === 'table' ? (
            <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600">
                  কলাম সেটিং (<span className={`${widthColor} font-extrabold`}>{e2b(totalWidth)}%</span> - ১০০%)
                </h3>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button onClick={() => addCol('data')} className="text-xs bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-indigo-100 active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Plus size={12} /> ডেটা কলাম
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={() => addCol('blank')} className="text-xs bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold hover:bg-slate-200 active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Plus size={12} /> ফাঁকা কলাম
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 mb-4 max-h-[200px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {tableColumns.map((col, index) => (
                  <div key={col.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={col.label}
                        onChange={e => updateCol(index, 'label', e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="কলামের নাম (প্রিন্টে যা দেখাবে)"
                        className="w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded text-xs px-2 py-1.5 outline-none font-bold text-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500"
                      />
                      {col.type === 'data' ? (
                        <select
                          value={col.field}
                          onChange={e => updateCol(index, 'field', e.target.value)}
                          className="w-full bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-100 text-[11px] text-indigo-700 mt-1 px-2 py-1.5 rounded outline-none font-bold cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          {FIELD_OPTIONS.map(opt => <option key={opt.val} value={opt.val}>{opt.text}</option>)}
                        </select>
                      ) : (
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={col.default}
                          onChange={e => updateCol(index, 'default', e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="ডিফল্ট ভ্যালু (যেমন: স্বাক্ষর)"
                          className="w-full bg-white border border-slate-200 mt-1 rounded text-[11px] px-2 py-1.5 outline-none text-slate-500"
                        />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-16">
                      <div className="relative">
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          value={col.width}
                          onChange={e => updateCol(index, 'width', e.target.value)}
                          className="w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded text-xs px-2 py-1.5 outline-none pr-5 text-center font-bold focus:border-indigo-500"
                        />
                        <span className="absolute right-1.5 top-1.5 text-xs text-slate-400">%</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={() => removeCol(index)} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-500 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white transition-colors shadow-sm shrink-0">
                      <Trash2 size={14} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600">রো (Row) এর সাইজ:</span>
                <select value={rowHeight} onChange={e => setRowHeight(e.target.value)} className="bg-white border border-slate-300 text-xs rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 outline-none text-slate-700 font-medium">
                  <option value="py-1">চিকন (Small)</option>
                  <option value="py-2">মাঝারি (Medium)</option>
                  <option value="py-4">চওড়া (Large)</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-100 space-y-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 mb-2">স্মার্ট গ্রুপিং</h3>
                <select value={groupBy} onChange={e => setGroupBy(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-sm rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 font-medium">
                  <option value="">কোনো গ্রুপ নয় (সব একসাথে)</option>
                  <option value="ClassBn">শ্রেণী (Class) অনুযায়ী</option>
                  <option value="gender">লিঙ্গ (Gender) অনুযায়ী</option>
                  <option value="age">বয়স অনুযায়ী</option>
                  <option value="BloodGroup">ব্লাড গ্রুপ অনুযায়ী</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 mb-1">কলাম সংখ্যা</h3>
                  <input type="number" value={plainCols} min="1" max="6" onChange={e => setPlainCols(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 outline-none text-center font-bold" />
                </div>
                <div>

                        {PLAIN_FIELD_LABELS[item.field] || item.field}
                      </span>

                        type="text"
                        value={item.prefix}
                        onChange={e => updatePlainFieldPrefix(index, e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="কাস্টম প্রিফিক্স... (যেমন: রোল: )"
                        className="flex-1 min-w-0 bg-white border border-indigo-100 rounded-lg text-xs px-2 py-1.5 outline-none font-bold text-slate-700 focus:border-indigo-400"
                      />
                      <button onClick={() => removePlainField(index)} className="shrink-0 text-red-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-red-500 w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-colors">
                        <X size={14} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <select
                  value=""
                  onChange={e => { addPlainField(e.target.value); e.target.value = ''; }}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-sm rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 outline-none font-bold focus:border-indigo-400 text-slate-700"
                >
                  <option value="">+ নতুন তথ্য যুক্ত করুন</option>

                  <option value="MotherNameBn">মাতার নাম (বাংলা)</option>
                  <option value="address">ঠিকানা (সম্পূর্ণ)</option>
                  <option value="WhatsApp">মোবাইল নম্বর</option>
                  <option value="age">বয়স</option>

                  <option value="BRN">জন্ম নিবন্ধন (BRN)</option>
                  <option value="gender">লিঙ্গ</option>
                  <option value="BloodGroup">রক্তের গ্রুপ</option>
                  <option value="Session">সেশন</option>
                  <option value="StudentNameEn">নাম (ইংরেজি)</option>
                  <option value="FatherNameEn">পিতার নাম (ইংরেজি)</option>
                  <option value="MotherNameEn">মাতার নাম (ইংরেজি)</option>
                  <option value="EmergencyNo">জরুরি নম্বর</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

        </div>

        <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-white rounded-b-[24px] border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-end gap-3 shrink-0">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 transition-all">বাতিল</button>
          <button
            onClick={generateSuperPDF}
            disabled={generating}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-white bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 shadow-md shadow-indigo-200 active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            <Printer size={16} /> {generating ? 'তৈরি হচ্ছে...' : 'পিডিএফ তৈরি করুন'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default PdfExportModal;

const toBn = (n) => {
  if (n === undefined || n === null || n === '') return '-';
  return String(n).replace(/\d/g, d => "০১২৩৪৫৬৭৮৯"[d]);
};

const toEnNum = (n) => {
  if (!n) return '';
  const bnToEn = { '০': '0', '১': '1', '২': '2', '৩': '3', '৪': '4', '৫': '5', '৬': '6', '৭': '7', '৮': '8', '৯': '9' };
  return String(n).replace(/[০-৯]/g, d => bnToEn[d]);
};

const MAX_SUBJECTS_FOR_REMARK = 20; // ১২ এর বেশি বিষয় হলে রিমার্ক হাইড হবে

const seededRandom = (seed) => {
  let x = Math.sin(seed) * 10000;
  return x - Math.floor(x);
};

const pickAI = (arr, seed) => {
  let randomVal = seededRandom(seed);
  return arr[Math.floor(randomVal * arr.length)];
};

const generateSmartRemark = (id, totalMarks, gpa, isPass, subjects) => {
  if (MAX_SUBJECTS_FOR_REMARK === 0 || subjects.length > MAX_SUBJECTS_FOR_REMARK) return "";

  // আইডি এবং মোট নম্বর দিয়ে ইউনিক সিড তৈরি (যাতে রিলোডেও একই স্টুডেন্টের রিমার্ক সেম থাকে)
  const seed = (Number(toEnNum(id)) || 1) + (Number(toEnNum(totalMarks)) || 1); 
  
  let bestSub = "", worstSub = "";
  let maxMark = -1, minMark = 999;
  let weakCount = 0;
  let failCount = 0;
  
  subjects.forEach((sub) => {
      let percent = (sub.mark / sub.full) * 100;
      if (percent > maxMark) { maxMark = percent; bestSub = sub.name; }
      if (percent < minMark) { minMark = percent; worstSub = sub.name; }
      if (percent < 45) { weakCount++; }
      if (percent < 33) { failCount++; }
  });

  let weakText = (weakCount > 1) ? `একাধিক বিষয়ে (বিশেষত '${worstSub}'-এ)` : `'${worstSub}' বিষয়ে`;
  let strongText = `'${bestSub}' বিষয়ে`;

  let remark = "";
  let numGpa = parseFloat(toEnNum(gpa));

  // ফেল লিমিটের বেশি হলে (২টির বেশি বিষয়ে ফেল)
  if (failCount > 2) {
      return "একাধিক বিষয়ে অকৃতকার্য হওয়া পড়াশোনায় চরম অমনোযোগের লক্ষণ। শিক্ষাজীবন নিয়ে উদ্বেগজনক এই পরিস্থিতি উত্তরণে অভিভাবকের নিবিড় তদারকি ও ত্বরিত পদক্ষেপ প্রয়োজন।";

          `খুবই চমৎকার রেজাল্ট! মেধা ও চেষ্টার সঠিক প্রতিফলন ঘটেছে এই ফলাফলে।`,
          `পড়াশোনায় একাগ্রতা ও অধ্যবসায়ের কারণেই এই অসামান্য ফলাফল অর্জন করা সম্ভব হয়েছে।`
      ];
      const middles = [
          `তার মতো একজন মেধাবী শিক্ষার্থীর কাছ থেকে ঠিক এমন একটি রেজাল্টই কাম্য।`,

  else if (isPass) {

          `ফলাফল চলনসই। তবে ক্লাসে তাকে আরও মনোযোগী হতে হবে এবং বাসায় পড়ার সময় বাড়াতে হবে।`,
          `পাস করলেও ফলাফলে পুরোপুরি সন্তুষ্ট হওয়ার সুযোগ নেই। তার আরও দায়িত্বশীল হওয়া প্রয়োজন।`
      ];

          `${weakText} দুর্বলতা কাটিয়ে উঠতে শিক্ষকদের পরামর্শ মেনে চলা অত্যন্ত জরুরি।`,
          `আশা করি আগামী পরীক্ষায় সে নিজের এই ঘাটতিগুলো কাটিয়ে উঠতে সক্ষম হবে।`
      ];
      remark = pickAI(intros, seed) + " " + pickAI(middles, seed+1);
  }
  else {
      const intros = [
          `অকৃতকার্য হওয়ার বিষয়টি হতাশাজনক। মূলত ${weakText} বেসিক ঘাটতির কারণেই এই ফলাফল।`,
          `পড়াশোনায় অমনোযোগিতার কারণেই আশানুরূপ ফলাফল হয়নি। তাকে আরও অনেক বেশি যত্নশীল হতে হবে।`,
          `আশা অনুযায়ী ফলাফল আসেনি। ভুল থেকে শিক্ষা নিয়ে তাকে শক্তভাবে ঘুরে দাঁড়াতে হবে।`

      ];
      remark = pickAI(intros, seed) + " " + pickAI(middles, seed+1);

  return remark;

// ==============================================
// ANIMATED NUMBER COMPONENT (Scroll Counter)
// ==============================================
const AnimatedNumber = ({ value, isVisible, isDecimal = false, isEnglish = false }) => {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isVisible) {
      setCount(0); 
      return;
    }
    const end = parseFloat(toEnNum(String(value))) || 0;
    if (end === 0) {
        setCount(0);
        return;
    }
    let start = 0;
    const duration = 1300; // 1.2 seconds animation
    const incrementTime = 20;
    const steps = duration / incrementTime;
    const stepValue = end / steps;

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      start += stepValue;
      if (start >= end) {
        setCount(end);
        clearInterval(timer);
      } else {
        setCount(start);
      }
    }, incrementTime);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [value, isVisible]);

  if (isNaN(parseFloat(toEnNum(String(value))))) return isEnglish ? value : toBn(value);
  
  const finalVal = isDecimal ? count.toFixed(2) : Math.floor(count);
  return isEnglish ? finalVal : toBn(finalVal);
};
// ==============================================
// TYPEWRITER ANIMATION COMPONENT (For Remark)
// ==============================================
const TypewriterText = ({ text }) => {
  const [displayedText, setDisplayedText] = useState('');
  const [isTyping, setIsTyping] = useState(false);
  const textRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    // নতুন সার্চ দিলে অটোমেটিক রিসেট হবে
    setDisplayedText('');
    setIsTyping(false);
  }, [text]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        // স্ক্রিনে আসলে এবং আগে টাইপ না হয়ে থাকলে শুরু হবে
        if (entry.isIntersecting && displayedText.length === 0 && !isTyping) {
          setIsTyping(true);
        }
      },
      { threshold: 0.1 }
    );

    if (textRef.current) observer.observe(textRef.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [displayedText, isTyping]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isTyping) return;
    
    let i = 0;
    // স্ক্রিনে আসার ৩০০ মিলি-সেকেন্ড পর টাইপিং শুরু হবে (ন্যাচারাল লুকের জন্য)
    const startDelay = setTimeout(() => {
        const timer = setInterval(() => {
          setDisplayedText(text.substring(0, i + 1));
          i++;
          if (i >= text.length) {
              clearInterval(timer);
              // টাইপ শেষ হওয়ার ২ সেকেন্ড পর কার্সরটি হাইড হয়ে যাবে
              setTimeout(() => setIsTyping(false), 2000); 
          }
        }, 25); // স্পিড (প্রতি অক্ষরে ২৫ মিলি-সেকেন্ড)
        return () => clearInterval(timer);
    }, 300); 

    return () => clearTimeout(startDelay);
  }, [text, isTyping]);

  return (
    <span ref={textRef} style={{ position: 'relative', display: 'block' }}>
      
      {/* ১. সম্পূর্ণ টেক্সটটিকে হাইড করে রাখা হলো যাতে বক্স শুরুতেই সঠিক সাইজ নিয়ে নেয় */}
      <span style={{ visibility: 'hidden' }}>{text}</span>

      {/* ২. টাইপিং হওয়া টেক্সটটিকে উপরে পজিশন করা হলো */}
      <span style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, left: 0, right: 0 }}>
        {displayedText}
        <span 
          style={{ 
              display: 'inline-block', 
              width: '2px', 
              height: '1.1em', 
              backgroundColor: '#0f766e', 
              verticalAlign: 'middle',
              marginLeft: '3px',
              animation: isTyping ? 'blinkCursor 0.8s infinite step-end' : 'none',
              opacity: isTyping ? 1 : 0,
              transition: 'opacity 0.4s ease-out'
          }}
        ></span>
      </span>
      
    </span>
  );
};

// ANIMATED SUBJECT CARD COMPONENT

const AnimatedSubjectCard = ({ sub }) => {
    const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
    const cardRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
            ([entry]) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    setIsVisible(true);
                    observer.disconnect();
                }
            },
            { threshold: 0.15 } // কার্ডটির ১৫% স্ক্রিনে আসলেই এনিমেশন শুরু হবে
        );

        if (cardRef.current) observer.observe(cardRef.current);
        return () => observer.disconnect();
    }, []);

    const gc = {
        'A+': { border: '#f59e0b', bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#fbbf24,#f59e0b)', badge: '#fef3c7', badgeText: '#92400e' },
        'A':  { border: '#22c55e', bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#4ade80,#16a34a)', badge: '#dcfce7', badgeText: '#14532d' },
        'A-': { border: '#14b8a6', bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#2dd4bf,#0f766e)', badge: '#ccfbf1', badgeText: '#134e4a' },
        'B':  { border: '#3b82f6', bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#60a5fa,#2563eb)', badge: '#dbeafe', badgeText: '#1e3a8a' },
        'C':  { border: '#f97316', bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#fb923c,#ea580c)', badge: '#ffedd5', badgeText: '#7c2d12' },
        'D':  { border: '#a855f7', bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#c084fc,#7c3aed)', badge: '#f3e8ff', badgeText: '#581c87' },
        'F':  { border: '#ef4444', bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#f87171,#dc2626)', badge: '#fee2e2', badgeText: '#7f1d1d' },
    }[sub.grade] || { border: '#ef4444', bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg,#f87171,#dc2626)', badge: '#fee2e2', badgeText: '#7f1d1d' };

    return (
        <div ref={cardRef} style={{
            background: '#fff', borderRadius: '18px',
            borderLeft: `4px solid ${gc.border}`,
            border: `1px solid #f1f5f9`,
            borderLeftWidth: '4px', borderLeftColor: gc.border,
            padding: '14px 16px',
            boxShadow: '0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)',
            opacity: isVisible ? 1 : 0,
            transform: isVisible ? 'translateY(0) scale(1)' : 'translateY(20px) scale(0.95)',
            transition: 'opacity 0.6s ease-out, transform 0.6s ease-out'
        }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <div style={{ flex: 1, paddingRight: '8px' }}>
                    <h4 style={{ fontSize: '15px', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a', margin: '0 0 5px', lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{sub.name}</h4>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '5px', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 700, color: '#94a3b8', background: '#f8fafc', padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: '20px', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0' }}>
                            পূর্ণমান {toBn(sub.full)}
                        </span>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '10px', fontWeight: 700, color: '#0d9488', background: '#f0fdfa', padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: '20px', border: '1px solid #ccfbf1' }}>
                            সর্বোচ্চ {toBn(sub.highest)}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ textAlign: 'right', flexShrink: 0 }}>
                    <p style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontSize: '9px', fontWeight: 700, margin: '0 0 3px', letterSpacing: '0.5px', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>প্রাপ্ত নম্বর</p>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: '5px', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                        <span style={{ fontSize: '30px', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', lineHeight: 1 }}>{toBn(sub.mark)}</span>
                        <span style={{
                            fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 800,
                            background: gc.badge, color: gc.badgeText,
                            padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: '7px',
                            border: `1px solid ${gc.border}40`
                        }}>{sub.grade}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            {/* Progress bar */}
            <div style={{ height: '5px', background: '#f1f5f9', borderRadius: '999px', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
                <div style={{
                    height: '100%', borderRadius: '999px',
                    background: gc.bar,
                    width: isVisible ? `${Math.min(sub.percent, 100).toFixed(1)}%` : '0%',
                    transition: 'width 1.3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) 0.3s'
                }}></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

const getGP = (percentage) => {
  if (percentage >= 80) return 5.00;
  if (percentage >= 70) return 4.00;
  if (percentage >= 60) return 3.50;
  if (percentage >= 50) return 3.00;
  if (percentage >= 40) return 2.00;
  if (percentage >= 33) return 1.00;
  return 0.00;
};

const getGradeFromGP = (gp) => {
  if (gp >= 5.00) return 'A+';
  if (gp >= 4.00) return 'A';
  if (gp >= 3.50) return 'A-';
  if (gp >= 3.00) return 'B';
  if (gp >= 2.00) return 'C';
  if (gp >= 1.00) return 'D';
  return 'F';
};

// Single-digit codes used inside the compact student ID (encodeShortId/decodeShortId below).
// Add new exam types here ONLY — both ID functions read from this single source of truth.
const EXAM_CODE_MAP = {
  '1st Terminal': '1',
  '2nd Terminal': '2',
  'Annual': '3',
  'Half Yearly': '4',
  'Final Result': '5'
};
const EXAM_CODE_REVERSE = {
  '1': '1st Terminal',
  '2': '2nd Terminal',
  '3': 'Annual',
  '4': 'Half Yearly',
  '5': 'Final Result'
};

// URL mapping helpers
const mapExamFromUrl = (exm) => {
  if(!exm) return '';
  const exmLower = exm.toString().toLowerCase();
  if (exmLower === '1') return '1st Terminal';
  if (exmLower === '2') return '2nd Terminal';
  if (exmLower === '3' || exmLower === 'annual') return 'Annual';
 if (exmLower === '4' || exmLower === 'half yearly' || exmLower === 'halfyearly') return 'Half Yearly';
  if (exmLower === '5' || exmLower === 'final result' || exmLower === 'finalresult') return 'Final Result';
  return exm;
  
};

const mapClassFromUrl = (cls) => {
  if(!cls) return '';
  const clsLower = cls.toString().toLowerCase();
  const map = {
    'play': 'Play', 'nursery': 'Nursery', 'kg': 'KG', 
    '1': 'Class One', 'one': 'Class One',
    '2': 'Class Two', 'two': 'Class Two',
    '3': 'Class Three', 'three': 'Class Three',
    '4': 'Class Four', 'four': 'Class Four',
    '5': 'Class Five', 'five': 'Class Five',
    '6': 'Class Six', 'six': 'Class Six',
    '7': 'Class Seven', 'seven': 'Class Seven',
    '8': 'Class Eight', 'eight': 'Class Eight',
    '9': 'Class Nine', 'nine': 'Class Nine',
    '10': 'Class Ten', 'ten': 'Class Ten'
  };
  return map[clsLower] || cls;
};


    
const encodeShortId = (year, exam, cls, roll) => {
const examCode = EXAM_CODE_MAP[exam] || '3';
  const classCodeMap = {
    'Play':'01','Nursery':'02','KG':'03',
    'Class One':'04','Class Two':'05','Class Three':'06','Class Four':'07',
    'Class Five':'08','Class Six':'09','Class Seven':'10',
    'Class Eight':'11','Class Nine':'12','Class Ten':'13'
  };
  const cc = classCodeMap[cls] || '00';
  const yy = String(year).slice(-2);
  const rr = String(toEnNum(roll)).padStart(4, '0');
  return `${yy}${examCode}${cc}${rr}`;
};

const decodeShortId = (id) => {
  if (!id || id.length < 8) return null;
  const yy = id.slice(0, 2);
  const e  = id.slice(2, 3);
  const cc = id.slice(3, 5);
  const rr = id.slice(5);
  const year = `20${yy}`;
  const exam = EXAM_CODE_REVERSE[e] || 'Annual';
  const classMap = {
    '01':'Play','02':'Nursery','03':'KG',
    '04':'Class One','05':'Class Two','06':'Class Three','07':'Class Four',
    '08':'Class Five','09':'Class Six','10':'Class Seven',
    '11':'Class Eight','12':'Class Nine','13':'Class Ten'
  };
  const cls = classMap[cc];
  const roll = String(parseInt(rr));
  if (!cls) return null;
  return { year, exam, cls, roll };
};

  // NEXT LEVEL PREMIUM SELECT FIELD
  // ==========================================
  const SelectField = ({ label, icon: Icon, value, onChange, options, disabled, placeholder, error, errorMessage }) => {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
    const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

    useEffect(() => {
      const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
        if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
          setIsOpen(false);
        }
      };
      document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
      return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    }, []);

    const selectedOption = options.find(opt => opt.val === value);

    return (
      <div className="relative w-full" ref={dropdownRef}>
        {/* Label */}
        <label className={`text-[12px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest pl-1 mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors duration-300  text-slate-500`}>
          <Icon className="w-4 h-4" /> {label}
        </label>
        
        {/* Main Box */}
        <div 
          onClick={() => !disabled && setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
          className={`w-full p-4 border rounded-xl font-bold flex justify-between items-center transition-all duration-300 ${
            disabled 
              ? 'opacity-70 bg-slate-100 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-200 text-slate-400' 
              : error
                ? 'bg-red-50/50 border-red-400 text-red-700 shadow-[0_0_0_4px_rgba(248,113,113,0.15)] cursor-pointer'
                : isOpen 
                  ? 'bg-teal-50/40 border-teal-500 shadow-[0_0_0_4px_rgba(20,184,166,0.15)] text-teal-800 cursor-pointer' 
                  : 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:shadow-sm cursor-pointer'
          }`}
        >
          <span className={`${!selectedOption ? (error ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-slate-400') : ''}`}>
            {selectedOption ? selectedOption.label : placeholder}
          </span>
          <ChevronRight className={`w-5 h-5 transition-transform duration-300 ${isOpen ? '-rotate-90 text-teal-600' : (error ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-slate-400')}`} />
        </div>

        {/* Error Message Below (Animated) */}
        <div className={`overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ${error ? 'max-h-10 opacity-100 mt-1.5' : 'max-h-0 opacity-0 mt-0'}`}>
           <div className="text-red-500 text-[12px] font-bold pl-1 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {errorMessage}
           </div>
        </div>

        {/* Dropdown Menu (Glassmorphism) */}
        <div 
          className={`absolute z-50 w-full mt-2 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_20px_50px_-10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)] overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 origin-top ${
            isOpen ? 'opacity-100 scale-y-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-0 scale-y-95 -translate-y-2 pointer-events-none'
          }`}
          style={{ top: '100%', left: 0 }}
        >
          <div className="max-h-[260px] overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-1 custom-scrollbar">
            {options.map((opt, i) => {
              const isSelected = value === opt.val;
              return (
                <div 
                  key={i}
                  onClick={() => {
                    onChange({ target: { value: opt.val } });
                    setIsOpen(false);
                  }}
                  className={`px-4 py-3.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 ${
                    isSelected 
                      ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-50 to-emerald-50/50 text-teal-800 shadow-sm border border-teal-100/50' 
                      : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>{opt.label}</span>
                  {isSelected && (
                    <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-teal-100 flex items-center justify-center animate-fade-in">
                      <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3 text-teal-700" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const parseCSV = (text) => {
    const rows = text.split(/\r?\n/).filter(row => row.trim() !== '');
    return rows.map(row => {
      let inQuotes = false;
      let currentWord = '';
      let columns = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
        let char = row[i];
        if (char === '"') inQuotes = !inQuotes;
        else if (char === ',' && !inQuotes) {
          columns.push(currentWord.trim());
          currentWord = '';
        } else {
          currentWord += char;
        }
      }
      columns.push(currentWord.trim());
      return columns.map(col => col.replace(/^"(.*)"$/, '$1'));
    });
  };

  const handleFileChange = (e) => {

    if (selectedFile && selectedFile.name.endsWith('.csv')) {

      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (event) => setCsvData(parseCSV(event.target.result));
      reader.readAsText(selectedFile);
    } else {
      alert("অনুগ্রহ করে একটি সঠিক CSV ফাইল সিলেক্ট করুন।");
      e.target.value = null;
    }

  return map[cls] || cls;
};

    if (!canManage) return;

    if (!file || !examName || !year || !finalClassName || !publishDate) {

      setUploadStatus('error');
      return;
    }

    setUploadStatus('loading');
        const timestamp = new Date(publishDate).getTime();
    
    // --- ফাইলের নাম থেকে ব্র্যাকেটের ভেতরের পারসেন্টেজ (%) বের করার ম্যাজিক লজিক ---
    let extraTag = "";
    if (examName === 'Final Result' && file) {
        // ఇది ফাইলের নামের ভেতর থেকে (গড় ২০% + ২০% + ৬০%) অংশটুকু খুঁজে বের করবে
        const match = file.name.match(/\(([^)]*%[^)]*)\)/); 
        if (match) {
            extraTag = `[${match[1].substring(0, 30)}]`; // শিটের নামের লিমিট ঠিক রাখতে ম্যাক্সিমাম ৩০ ক্যারেক্টার
        }

    const sheetName = `[${finalClassName}][${examName}][${year}][${formatDateTime(publishDate)}][${timestamp}]${extraTag}`;

  const handleDownloadCSV = () => {
    if (!selectedExam || !selectedExam.data) {
        showToast('কোনো ডাটা পাওয়া যায়নি', 'error');
        return;
    }

    // ডাটাকে CSV ফরম্যাটে কনভার্ট করা হচ্ছে (হুবহু আপলোডের মতো)
    const csvContent = selectedExam.data.map(row => {
      return row.map(cell => {
        let cellStr = String(cell);
        // কমা (,) বা কোটেশন (") থাকলে সেগুলোকে সেফ করা হচ্ছে
        if (cellStr.includes(',') || cellStr.includes('"') || cellStr.includes('\n')) {
          cellStr = `"${cellStr.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
        }
        return cellStr;
      }).join(',');
    }).join('\n');

    // BOM (\ufeff) যুক্ত করে ফাইল জেনারেট করা হচ্ছে, যাতে বাংলা ফন্ট ঠিক থাকে
    const blob = new Blob(["\ufeff" + csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `${selectedExam.sheetName}.csv`; // 👈 গুগল শিটের অরিজিনাল নাম
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
  };

const handleDelete = async (sheetName) => {
  if (!canManage) return;

  const sheetInfo = parseSheetName(sheetName);

  if (sheetInfo.timestamp && Date.now() > sheetInfo.timestamp) {
    showToast("পাবলিশ হওয়ার পর রেজাল্ট ডিলিট করা যাবে না!", "error");
    return;
  }

  if (!window.confirm('আপনি কি নিশ্চিত যে এই রেজাল্টটি ডিলিট করবেন?')) return;

  showToast("ডিলিট হচ্ছে...", "loading");

  try {
    const response = await fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
  action: 'delete',
  sheetName,
  key: ADMIN_SECRET
})

    });

    const result = await response.json();

  if (result.status === 'success') {
  hideToast();
  showToast("সফলভাবে ডিলিট করা হয়েছে!", "success");

  fetchAllExams();

  setTimeout(() => {
    if (selectedExam && selectedExam.sheetName === sheetName) {
      setSelectedExam(null);
    }
  }, 500); // half second delay
}
 else {
      throw new Error(result.message);
    }

  } catch (error) {
    hideToast();
    showToast("ডিলিট করতে সমস্যা হয়েছে!", "error");
  }
};
const performSearch = async (sClass, sExam, sYear, sId) => {
  setIsSearching(true);
  setSearchError('');
  setSearchResult(null);
setIsResultVisible(false);
  if (!sClass || !sExam || !sYear || !sId) {
    setSearchError('অনুগ্রহ করে সার্চের সবগুলো তথ্য দিন।');
    setIsSearching(false);
    return;
  }

  const prefix = `[${sClass}][${sExam}][${sYear}]`;

  const targetSheet = publishedExams.find(s =>
    s.sheetName.startsWith(prefix)
  );

  if (!targetSheet) {
    setSearchError(`রেজাল্ট এখনো পাবলিশ হয়নি। দয়া করে অপেক্ষা করুন।।`);
    setIsSearching(false);
    setIsAutoSearching(false);
    return;
  }
  // এখানে নতুন লজিকটি যোগ করতে হবে (টাইম লক)
  const targetSheetInfo = parseSheetName(targetSheet.sheetName);
  
  // যদি ইউজার এডমিন না হয় এবং বর্তমান সময় পাবলিশ টাইমের চেয়ে কম হয়
  if (!canManage && targetSheetInfo.timestamp && Date.now() < targetSheetInfo.timestamp) {
    const publishDateStr = new Date(targetSheetInfo.timestamp).toLocaleString('bn-BD');
    setSearchError(`রেজাল্ট এখনো পাবলিশ হয়নি। দয়া করে অপেক্ষা করুন।`);
    setIsSearching(false);
    setIsAutoSearching(false);
    return;
  }
  // 👆 ========================================== 👆
  try {
    let sheetData;

    // 👇 ক্যাশ (Cache) মেমোরি চেক করা হচ্ছে 👇
    if (cachedSheets && cachedSheets[targetSheet.sheetName]) {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
        // মেমোরিতে থাকলে সরাসরি সেখান থেকে ডাটা নিয়ে নিবে (সার্ভারে রিকোয়েস্ট যাবে না)
        sheetData = cachedSheets[targetSheet.sheetName];
    } else {
        // মেমোরিতে না থাকলে সার্ভার থেকে আনবে
        const response = await fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            action: 'search',
            sheetName: targetSheet.sheetName,
            key: canManage ? ADMIN_SECRET : ""  // 👈 এই লাইনটি যোগ করতে হবে
          })
        });

        const result = await response.json();

        if (result.status !== 'success') {
          throw new Error(result.message);
        }

        sheetData = result.data;
        // ভবিষ্যতে দ্রুত সার্চের জন্য মেমোরিতে সেভ করে রাখা হলো
        setCachedSheets(prev => ({ ...prev, [targetSheet.sheetName]: sheetData }));
    }
    // 👆 ক্যাশ লজিক শেষ 👆

    const headers = sheetData[0];

        const idIndex = headers.findIndex(h =>
      String(h).split(' [')[0].trim().toLowerCase() === 'id'
    );

    const rollIndex = headers.findIndex(h =>
      String(h).split(' [')[0].trim().toLowerCase() === 'roll'
    );


    const normalizedSearchId = toEnNum(sId).trim();

    const studentRow = sheetData.slice(1).find(row => {
      const matchId =
        idIndex !== -1 &&
        toEnNum(row[idIndex]).trim() === normalizedSearchId;

      const matchRoll =
        rollIndex !== -1 &&
        toEnNum(row[rollIndex]).trim() === normalizedSearchId;

      return matchId || matchRoll;
    });

    if (!studentRow) {
      setSearchError('রেজাল্ট পাওয়া যায়নি।');
      return;
    }
      // --- ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ড লগিং লজিক শুরু (একচুল পরিবর্তন ছাড়া) ---
    const targetId = getVal(headers, studentRow, 'id');
    const targetRoll = getVal(headers, studentRow, 'roll');
    const targetName = getVal(headers, studentRow, 'namebn') !== '-' 
                       ? getVal(headers, studentRow, 'namebn') 
                       : getVal(headers, studentRow, 'name');

    // ব্রাউজার থেকে সার্চকারীর পরিচয় বের করা হচ্ছে (সেশন ট্র্যাকিং)
    let searcherName = localStorage.getItem('ardm_searcher_name');
    let searcherId = localStorage.getItem('ardm_searcher_id');

    // প্রথমবার সার্চ করলে ওই ব্যক্তিকেই সার্চকারী হিসেবে ধরে নেওয়া হবে
    if (!searcherName || !searcherId) {
        const randomNum = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000); 
        
        searcherName = targetName;             // 👈 নাম আসলটাই থাকবে (যেটা সার্চ করেছে)
        searcherId = randomNum.toString();     // 👈 আইডি হিসেবে রেন্ডম নম্বর তৈরি হবে
        
        localStorage.setItem('ardm_searcher_name', searcherName);
        localStorage.setItem('ardm_searcher_id', searcherId);
    }

    // ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ডে ডাটা পাঠানো হচ্ছে (এটি রেজাল্ট লোডিং স্লো করবে না)
    fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        action: 'log_search',
        searcherName: searcherName, // যে সার্চ করছে তার নাম
        searcherId: searcherId,     // যে সার্চ করছে তার আইডি

                  .sig-line { border-top: 1px solid #222; padding-top: 5px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #222; }

                  .computer-credit { position: absolute; bottom: 8px; width: 100%; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #222; left: 0; }
                `}} />
            </div>
        </div>

      </>
    );
  }
  // ==========================================
  // VIEW 2: FULL PAGE TABLE FOR SELECTED EXAM
  // ==========================================
  if (selectedExam && canManage) {
    const info = parseSheetName(selectedExam.sheetName);
const isExpired = info.timestamp && Date.now() > info.timestamp;

    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex flex-col font-sans">
      {toast.show && (
  <div className="fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[9999]">
    <div className={`
      flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl font-bold text-white
      ${toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-green-600' : ''}
      ${toast.type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-600' : ''}
      ${toast.type === 'loading' ? 'bg-slate-800' : ''}
    `}>
      
      {toast.type === 'loading' && (
        <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white/40 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
      )}

      {toast.type === 'success' && "✔"}
      {toast.type === 'error' && "✖"}

      <span>{toast.message}</span>
    </div>
  </div>
)}

        <div className="bg-white shadow-sm border-b border-slate-200 px-4 md:px-6 py-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 sticky top-0 z-20">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <button 
              onClick={() => {
                setSelectedExam(null);
               
              }}
              className="p-2 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-full transition-colors"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-600" />
            </button>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800">
                {parseSheetName(selectedExam.sheetName).className} - {parseSheetName(selectedExam.sheetName).examName}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-teal-600 font-medium mt-0.5">
                সর্বমোট এন্ট্রি: {selectedExam.data.length > 1 ? selectedExam.data.length - 1 : 0} জন ছাত্র
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-auto mt-4 md:mt-0">
          <button 
            onClick={handleDownloadCSV}
            className="bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors border border-emerald-200 w-full md:w-auto"
          >
            <Download className="w-4 h-4" /> রেজাল্ট ডাউনলোড করুন
          </button>
          
          {!isExpired && (
            <button 
              onClick={() => handleDelete(selectedExam.sheetName)}
              className="bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-600 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors border border-red-200 w-full md:w-auto"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" /> এই রেজাল্টটি ডিলিট করুন
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-auto p-4 md:p-6">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-sm text-left whitespace-nowrap">
                <thead className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-b border-slate-200">
                  <tr>
                    {selectedExam.data[0]?.map((header, idx) => (
                      <th key={idx} className="p-4 font-bold tracking-wide">
                        {String(header)}
                      </th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {selectedExam.data.slice(1).map((row, rowIdx) => (
                    <tr key={rowIdx} className="border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0 hover:bg-teal-50/50 transition-colors">
                      {row.map((cell, cellIdx) => (
                        <td key={cellIdx} className="p-4 text-slate-700 font-medium">
                          {String(cell)}
                        </td>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ==========================================
  // VIEW 3: MAIN FULL PAGE DASHBOARD
  // ==========================================
  return (
    <div className={`w-full min-h-screen bg-slate-50 font-sans text-slate-800 overflow-x-hidden ${canManage ? 'pb-24 md:pb-0' : ''}`}>
{toast.show && (
  <div className="fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[9999] animate-fade-in">
    <div className={`
      flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl font-bold text-white
      ${toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-green-600' : ''}
      ${toast.type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-600' : ''}
      ${toast.type === 'loading' ? 'bg-slate-800' : ''}
    `}>
      
      {toast.type === 'loading' && (
        <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white/40 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
      )}

      {toast.type === 'success' && "✔"}
      {toast.type === 'error' && "✖"}

      <span>{toast.message}</span>
    </div>
  </div>
