function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const meta = STATUS_META[status] || STATUS_META.active;
  return <span className={cx('text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-medium', meta.cls)}>{meta.label}</span>;
}

/* ============================================================
   🔏 OfficialSeal — সিগনেচার এলিমেন্ট
   ============================================================ */
function OfficialSeal({ size = 80, dim = false, ring = true }) {
  const rid = useId().replace(/:/g, '');
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" width={size} height={size} className={dim ? 'opacity-40' : ''}>
      <defs>
        <path id={`circlePath-${rid}`} d="M 50,50 m -36,0 a 36,36 0 1,1 72,0 a 36,36 0 1,1 -72,0" />
      </defs>
      {ring && <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="46" fill="none" stroke="#9c7a1f" strokeWidth="1.2" />}
      <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#9c7a1f" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeDasharray="1.4 2.6" />
      <text fontSize="5.8" fill="#8a6a18" letterSpacing="1.3">
        <textPath href={`#circlePath-${rid}`} startOffset="1%">
          ✦ শিক্ষক রেজিস্ট্রি ✦ আব্দুর রাজ্জাক দাখিল মাদরাসা ✦
        </textPath>
      </text>
      <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="22" fill="none" stroke="#9c7a1f" strokeWidth="0.8" />
      <circle cx="48.5" cy="50" r="9" fill="#9c7a1f" />
      <circle cx="53" cy="46.5" r="7.6" fill="#fffdf6" />
    </svg>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   📊 StatCard
   ============================================================ */
function StatCard({ icon: Icon, label, value, accent = 'emerald' }) {
  const ring = {
    emerald: 'text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200',
    amber: 'text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border-amber-200',
    rose: 'text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 border-rose-200',
  }[accent];
  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-lg p-4 flex items-center gap-3 shadow-sm">
      <div className={cx('w-10 h-10 rounded-full border flex items-center justify-center shrink-0', ring)}>
        <Icon className="w-5 h-5" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <p className="text-2xl font-semibold text-stone-800 leading-none" style={{ fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif" }}>{value}</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 mt-1">{label}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   🗂️ TeacherCard — রোস্টার আইটেম (ইনডেক্স কার্ড স্টাইল)
   ============================================================ */
function TeacherCard({ teacher, isAdmin, onView, onEdit, onDelete }) {
  const subjCount = (teacher.subjects || []).length;
  return (
    <div className="relative bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-md shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-3 flex flex-col items-center justify-evenly bg-stone-50 border-r border-stone-200">
        {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => <span key={i} className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-stone-300" />)}
      </div>
      <div className="pl-6 pr-4 pt-4 pb-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono text-stone-400">ক্রমিক #{String(teacher.serial).padStart(3, '0')}</span>
          <StatusBadge status={teacher.status} />
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button onClick={() => onView(teacher)} className="shrink-0">
            {teacher.photo ? (
              <img src={teacher.photo} alt={teacher.nameBn} className="w-14 h-14 rounded-md object-cover border border-stone-200" />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-md bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-700 font-semibold text-lg"
                   style={{ fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif" }}>
                {teacher.nameBn?.[0] || '?'}
              </div>
            )}
          </button>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <button onClick={() => onView(teacher)} className="text-left block w-full">
              <p className="font-semibold text-stone-800 truncate" style={{ fontFamily: "'Noto Serif Bengali', serif" }}>{teacher.nameBn}</p>
            </button>
            <p className="text-xs text-stone-500 truncate">{teacher.designation}</p>
            {teacher.classTeacherOf && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 mt-1 text-xs text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                <BadgeCheck className="w-3 h-3" /> {teacher.classTeacherOf} শ্রেণি শিক্ষক
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-stone-500">
          <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {subjCount} টি বিষয় নিয়োগপ্রাপ্ত
        </div>
        <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-stone-100 flex items-center gap-2">
          <button onClick={() => onView(teacher)} className="flex-1 text-xs px-2 py-1.5 rounded border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-stone-600">
            <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> প্রোফাইল
          </button>
          {isAdmin && (
            <>
              <button onClick={() => onEdit(teacher)} className="text-xs px-2 py-1.5 rounded border border-stone-200 hover:bg-stone-50 text-stone-600">
                <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => onDelete(teacher)} className="text-xs px-2 py-1.5 rounded border border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50 text-rose-600">
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   📇 ClassRail — শ্রেণি সূচক (sidebar)
   ============================================================ */
function ClassRail({ active, onChange, counts }) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-md overflow-hidden">
      <div className="px-3 py-2 bg-stone-50 border-b border-stone-200">
        <Eyebrow>শ্রেণি সূচক</Eyebrow>
      </div>
      <button onClick={() => onChange('all')}
        className={cx('w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-sm border-b border-stone-100',
          active === 'all' ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 font-medium' : 'text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-50')}>
        <span>সকল শ্রেণি</span>
        <span className="text-xs text-stone-400">{counts.all || 0}</span>
      </button>
      {CLASSES.map((c) => (
        <button key={c} onClick={() => onChange(c)}
          className={cx('w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-sm border-b border-stone-100 last:border-b-0',
            active === c ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 font-medium' : 'text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-50')}>
          <span>{c} শ্রেণি</span>
          <span className="text-xs text-stone-400">{counts[c] || 0}</span>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   🔔 ToastHost
   ============================================================ */
function ToastHost({ toasts }) {
  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 max-w-sm">
      {toasts.map((t) => (
        <div key={t.id}
          className={cx('px-4 py-3 rounded-md shadow-lg border text-sm flex items-start gap-2 bg-white',
            t.type === 'error' ? 'border-rose-300 text-rose-800' : t.type === 'success' ? 'border-emerald-300 text-emerald-800' : 'border-stone-300 text-stone-700')}
          style={{ animation: 'fadeIn 0.2s ease' }}>
          {t.type === 'success' ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" /> : t.type === 'error' ? <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" /> : <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />}
          <span>{t.message}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   📚 SubjectAssignmentEditor — বিষয় ও শ্রেণি বণ্টন + কনফ্লিক্ট ভ্যালিডেশন
   ============================================================ */
function SubjectAssignmentEditor({ subjects, onChange, conflictMap, allSubjects }) {
  const [draftSubject, setDraftSubject] = useState('');
  const [draftClass, setDraftClass] = useState('');
  const [customInput, setCustomInput] = useState('');
  const [showCustom, setShowCustom] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const addRow = () => {
    setError('');
    const subjectName = (showCustom ? customInput : draftSubject).trim();
    if (!subjectName || !draftClass) { setError('বিষয় ও শ্রেণি দুটোই নির্বাচন করুন।'); return; }
    if (subjects.some((s) => s.classBn === draftClass && s.subjectName === subjectName)) {
      setError('এই বিষয়টি এই শিক্ষকের তালিকায় আগেই যুক্ত আছে।'); return;
    }
    const key = `${draftClass}__${subjectName}`;
    if (conflictMap[key]) {
      setError(`"${subjectName}" বিষয়টি ${draftClass} শ্রেণিতে ইতোমধ্যে ${conflictMap[key].teacherName}-কে দেওয়া আছে।`);
      return;
    }
    onChange([...subjects, { subjectName, classBn: draftClass }]);
    setDraftSubject(''); setDraftClass(''); setCustomInput(''); setShowCustom(false);
  };

  const removeRow = (idx) => onChange(subjects.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));

  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const g = {};
    subjects.forEach((s) => { (g[s.classBn] = g[s.classBn] || []).push(s.subjectName); });
    return g;
  }, [subjects]);

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-md p-3 mb-3">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          <select value={draftClass} onChange={(e) => setDraftClass(e.target.value)} className="text-sm border border-stone-300 rounded px-2 py-2 bg-white">
            <option value="">শ্রেণি নির্বাচন</option>
            {CLASSES.map((c) => <option key={c} value={c}>{c} শ্রেণি</option>)}
          </select>
          {!showCustom ? (
            <select value={draftSubject} onChange={(e) => setDraftSubject(e.target.value)} className="text-sm border border-stone-300 rounded px-2 py-2 bg-white">
              <option value="">বিষয় নির্বাচন</option>
              {allSubjects.map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
            </select>
          ) : (
            <input value={customInput} onChange={(e) => setCustomInput(e.target.value)} placeholder="নতুন বিষয়ের নাম"
              className="text-sm border border-stone-300 rounded px-2 py-2 bg-white" />
          )}
          <button type="button" onClick={addRow} className="text-sm bg-emerald-800 text-white rounded px-3 py-2 hover:bg-emerald-900 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> যুক্ত করুন
          </button>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => { setShowCustom((v) => !v); setDraftSubject(''); setCustomInput(''); }}
          className="text-xs text-amber-700 mt-2 underline">
          {showCustom ? 'তালিকা থেকে নির্বাচন করুন' : '+ নতুন বিষয় যুক্ত করুন'}
        </button>
        <FieldError>{error}</FieldError>
      </div>

      {Object.keys(grouped).length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-stone-400 text-center py-4">এখনো কোনো বিষয় নিয়োগ দেওয়া হয়নি।</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {CLASSES.filter((c) => grouped[c]).map((c) => (
            <div key={c} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm">
              <span className="shrink-0 w-20 text-stone-500">{c} শ্রেণি</span>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {grouped[c].map((sName) => {
                  const idx = subjects.findIndex((s) => s.classBn === c && s.subjectName === sName);
                  return (
                    <span key={sName} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full">
                      {sName}
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => removeRow(idx)} className="hover:text-rose-700"><X className="w-3 h-3" /></button>
                    </span>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   🏷️ ClassTeacherPicker — একটি ক্লাসে একজনই শ্রেণি শিক্ষক
   ============================================================ */
function ClassTeacherPicker({ value, onChange, classTeacherMap, selfId }) {
  const [pendingConflict, setPendingConflict] = useState(null);

  const handlePick = (cls) => {
    if (cls === value) { onChange(null); return; }
    if (classTeacherMap[cls] && classTeacherMap[cls].teacherId !== selfId) {
      setPendingConflict({ cls, name: classTeacherMap[cls].teacherName });
      return;
    }
    onChange(cls);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <p className="text-sm text-stone-600 mb-2">একজন শিক্ষক সর্বোচ্চ একটি শ্রেণির শ্রেণি শিক্ষক হতে পারেন।</p>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {CLASSES.map((c) => {
          const taken = classTeacherMap[c] && classTeacherMap[c].teacherId !== selfId;
          const isSelf = value === c;
          return (
            <button key={c} type="button" onClick={() => handlePick(c)}
              className={cx('text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border transition-colors',
                isSelf ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white border-amber-600' :
                  taken ? 'bg-stone-50 text-stone-400 border-stone-200' :
                    'bg-white text-stone-600 border-stone-300 hover:border-emerald-400')}>
              {c} {taken && <span>({classTeacherMap[c].teacherName})</span>}
              {isSelf && <Check className="w-3 h-3 inline ml-1" />}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {pendingConflict && (
        <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-md text-sm">
          <p className="text-amber-800 mb-2 flex items-start gap-1.5">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <span><strong>{pendingConflict.cls}</strong> শ্রেণির বর্তমান শ্রেণি শিক্ষক <strong>{pendingConflict.name}</strong>। তাকে অপসারণ করে এই শিক্ষককে নিয়োগ দিতে চান?</span>
          </p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => { onChange(pendingConflict.cls); setPendingConflict(null); }}
              className="text-xs bg-amber-700 text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded">হ্যাঁ, পরিবর্তন করুন</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setPendingConflict(null)} className="text-xs border border-stone-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded">বাতিল</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   📝 TeacherForm — Add / Edit drawer
   ============================================================ */
const BLANK_TEACHER = () => ({
  id: null, nameBn: '', nameEn: '', designation: '', phone: '', email: '', nid: '',
  address: '', qualification: '', joiningDate: '', bloodGroup: '', photo: '',
  status: 'active', subjects: [], classTeacherOf: null,
});

function TeacherForm({ teacher, teachers, allSubjects, onSave, onClose, pushToast }) {
  const isEdit = !!teacher;
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(() => (teacher ? { ...teacher } : BLANK_TEACHER()));
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('basic');
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [photoLoading, setPhotoLoading] = useState(false);
  const fileRef = useRef(null);

  const subjectMap = useMemo(() => buildSubjectMap(teachers, draft.id), [teachers, draft.id]);
  const classTeacherMap = useMemo(() => buildClassTeacherMap(teachers, draft.id), [teachers, draft.id]);

  const set = (field, value) => setDraft((d) => ({ ...d, [field]: value }));

  const validate = () => {
    const e = {};
    if (!draft.nameBn.trim()) e.nameBn = 'বাংলা নাম আবশ্যক।';
    if (!draft.designation) e.designation = 'পদবি নির্বাচন করুন।';
    if (!draft.phone.trim()) e.phone = 'মোবাইল নম্বর আবশ্যক।';
    else if (!PHONE_RE.test(draft.phone.trim())) e.phone = 'সঠিক মোবাইল নম্বর দিন (যেমনঃ 017xxxxxxxx)।';
    else if (teachers.some((t) => t.id !== draft.id && t.phone === draft.phone.trim())) e.phone = 'এই মোবাইল নম্বর অন্য একজন শিক্ষকের নামে নিবন্ধিত।';
    if (draft.email && !EMAIL_RE.test(draft.email.trim())) e.email = 'সঠিক ইমেইল ঠিকানা দিন।';
    if (draft.nid && !NID_RE.test(draft.nid.trim())) e.nid = 'NID নম্বর ১০, ১৩ বা ১৭ ডিজিটের হতে হবে।';
    else if (draft.nid && teachers.some((t) => t.id !== draft.id && t.nid === draft.nid.trim())) e.nid = 'এই NID অন্য একজন শিক্ষকের নামে নিবন্ধিত।';
    if (!draft.joiningDate) e.joiningDate = 'যোগদানের তারিখ আবশ্যক।';
    setErrors(e);
    return Object.keys(e).length === 0;
  };

  const handlePhoto = async (file) => {
    if (!file) return;
    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) { pushToast('শুধুমাত্র ছবি ফাইল নির্বাচন করুন।', 'error'); return; }
    if (file.size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) { pushToast('ছবির আকার ৮MB এর কম হতে হবে।', 'error'); return; }
    setPhotoLoading(true);
    try {
      const compressed = await compressImage(file);
      set('photo', compressed);
      try {
        const url = await uploadToCloudinary(compressed);
        set('photo', url);
      } catch {
        pushToast('ক্লাউড আপলোড ব্যর্থ হয়েছে — সাময়িকভাবে লোকাল ছবি ব্যবহৃত হচ্ছে।', 'error');
      }
    } catch {
      pushToast('ছবি প্রসেস করা যায়নি।', 'error');
    } finally {
      setPhotoLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const submit = () => {
    if (!validate()) { setTab('basic'); pushToast('ফর্মে কিছু ভুল আছে, দয়া করে ঠিক করুন।', 'error'); return; }
    onSave(draft);
  };

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'basic', label: 'মৌলিক তথ্য', icon: Users },
    { id: 'contact', label: 'যোগাযোগ', icon: Phone },
    { id: 'subjects', label: 'বিষয় বণ্টন', icon: BookOpen },
    { id: 'classteacher', label: 'শ্রেণি শিক্ষক', icon: BadgeCheck },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-end">
      <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(28,25,23,0.55)' }} onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-stone-50 h-full overflow-y-auto shadow-2xl flex flex-col" style={{ animation: 'slideIn 0.25s ease' }}>
        <div className="sticky top-0 bg-emerald-900 text-white px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between z-10">
          <div>
            <Eyebrow tone="dark">{isEdit ? 'এন্ট্রি সম্পাদনা' : 'নতুন ভুক্তি'}</Eyebrow>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold" style={{ fontFamily: "'Noto Serif Bengali', serif" }}>
              {isEdit ? (draft.nameBn || 'শিক্ষক সম্পাদনা') : 'নতুন শিক্ষক নিবন্ধন'}
            </h3>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1.5 hover:bg-emerald-800 rounded"><X className="w-5 h-5" /></button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex border-b border-stone-200 bg-white overflow-x-auto">
          {tabs.map((t) => (
            <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
              className={cx('flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-3 text-sm whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 transition-colors',
                tab === t.id ? 'border-emerald-700 text-emerald-800 font-medium' : 'border-transparent text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-700')}>
              <t.icon className="w-4 h-4" /> {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="p-5 flex-1">
          {tab === 'basic' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()} className="relative shrink-0">
                  {photoLoading ? (
                    <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-md bg-stone-100 border border-stone-300 flex items-center justify-center">
                      <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-emerald-700" />
                    </div>
                  ) : draft.photo ? (
                    <img src={draft.photo} alt="" className="w-20 h-20 rounded-md object-cover border border-stone-300" />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-md bg-stone-100 border border-dashed border-stone-300 flex items-center justify-center text-stone-400">
                      <Camera className="w-6 h-6" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <span className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 bg-emerald-800 text-white rounded-full p-1"><Pencil className="w-3 h-3" /></span>
                </button>
                <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept="image/*" className="hidden" onChange={(e) => handlePhoto(e.target.files?.[0])} />
                <div className="text-xs text-stone-500">শিক্ষকের পরিচয়পত্রের ছবি আপলোড করুন (স্পষ্ট, সম্মুখ থেকে তোলা)।</div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">নাম (বাংলা) *</label>
                <input value={draft.nameBn} onChange={(e) => set('nameBn', e.target.value)}
                  className={cx('w-full mt-1 border rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm', errors.nameBn ? 'border-rose-400' : 'border-stone-300')} />
                <FieldError>{errors.nameBn}</FieldError>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">নাম (English)</label>
                <input value={draft.nameEn} onChange={(e) => set('nameEn', e.target.value)} className="w-full mt-1 border border-stone-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">পদবি *</label>
                  <select value={draft.designation} onChange={(e) => set('designation', e.target.value)}
                    className={cx('w-full mt-1 border rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white', errors.designation ? 'border-rose-400' : 'border-stone-300')}>
                    <option value="">নির্বাচন করুন</option>
                    {DESIGNATIONS.map((d) => <option key={d} value={d}>{d}</option>)}
                  </select>
                  <FieldError>{errors.designation}</FieldError>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">অবস্থা</label>
                  <select value={draft.status} onChange={(e) => set('status', e.target.value)} className="w-full mt-1 border border-stone-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white">
                    {Object.entries(STATUS_META).map(([k, v]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{v.label}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">যোগদানের তারিখ *</label>
                  <input type="date" value={draft.joiningDate} onChange={(e) => set('joiningDate', e.target.value)}
                    className={cx('w-full mt-1 border rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm', errors.joiningDate ? 'border-rose-400' : 'border-stone-300')} />
                  <FieldError>{errors.joiningDate}</FieldError>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">রক্তের গ্রুপ</label>
                  <select value={draft.bloodGroup} onChange={(e) => set('bloodGroup', e.target.value)} className="w-full mt-1 border border-stone-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm bg-white">
                    <option value="">নির্বাচন করুন</option>
                    {BLOOD_GROUPS.map((b) => <option key={b} value={b}>{b}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা</label>
                <input value={draft.qualification} onChange={(e) => set('qualification', e.target.value)} placeholder="যেমনঃ কামিল, ইসলামিক স্টাডিজ"
                  className="w-full mt-1 border border-stone-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {tab === 'contact' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">মোবাইল নম্বর *</label>
                <input value={draft.phone} onChange={(e) => set('phone', e.target.value)} placeholder="01XXXXXXXXX"
                  className={cx('w-full mt-1 border rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm', errors.phone ? 'border-rose-400' : 'border-stone-300')} />
                <FieldError>{errors.phone}</FieldError>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">ইমেইল</label>
                <input value={draft.email} onChange={(e) => set('email', e.target.value)}
                  className={cx('w-full mt-1 border rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm', errors.email ? 'border-rose-400' : 'border-stone-300')} />
                <FieldError>{errors.email}</FieldError>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্র নম্বর (NID)</label>
                <input value={draft.nid} onChange={(e) => set('nid', e.target.value)}
                  className={cx('w-full mt-1 border rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm', errors.nid ? 'border-rose-400' : 'border-stone-300')} />
                <FieldError>{errors.nid}</FieldError>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-sm text-stone-600">ঠিকানা</label>
                <textarea value={draft.address} onChange={(e) => set('address', e.target.value)} rows={3} className="w-full mt-1 border border-stone-300 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {tab === 'subjects' && (
            <SubjectAssignmentEditor subjects={draft.subjects} onChange={(s) => set('subjects', s)} conflictMap={subjectMap} allSubjects={allSubjects} />
          )}

          {tab === 'classteacher' && (
            <ClassTeacherPicker value={draft.classTeacherOf} onChange={(c) => set('classTeacherOf', c)} classTeacherMap={classTeacherMap} selfId={draft.id} />
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="sticky bottom-0 bg-white border-t border-stone-200 p-4 flex gap-3">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 border border-stone-300 rounded py-2.5 text-sm text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-50">বাতিল</button>
          <button onClick={submit} className="flex-1 bg-emerald-800 text-white rounded py-2.5 text-sm hover:bg-emerald-900 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <Stamp className="w-4 h-4" /> {isEdit ? 'হালনাগাদ করুন' : 'নিবন্ধন সম্পন্ন করুন'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

              <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-lg bg-emerald-800 border-2 border-amber-300 flex items-center justify-center text-3xl" style={{ fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif" }}>{teacher.nameBn?.[0]}</div>
            )}

              <Eyebrow tone="dark">ক্রমিক #{String(teacher.serial).padStart(3, '0')} · {teacher.designation}</Eyebrow>

            <div className="ml-auto hidden sm:block"><OfficialSeal size={64} dim /></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-6 grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-stone-600"><Phone className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700" /> {teacher.phone || '—'}</div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-stone-600"><Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700" /> {teacher.email || '—'}</div>

            <Eyebrow>নিয়োগপ্রাপ্ত বিষয় ও শ্রেণি</Eyebrow>
            <StatusBadge status={teacher.status} />
          </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

}

/* ============================================================
   🔐 AdminGateModal
   ============================================================ */
function AdminGateModal({ onSuccess, onClose }) {
  const [secret, setSecret] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const tryEnter = () => {
    if (secret === ADMIN_SECRET) onSuccess();
    else setError('পাসকোড সঠিক নয়। আবার চেষ্টা করুন।');
  };
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(28,25,23,0.6)' }} onClick={onClose} />
      <div className="relative bg-white rounded-xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full">
        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 flex items-center justify-center mb-3">
          <Lock className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-800" />
        </div>
        <h3 className="font-semibold text-stone-800 mb-1">অ্যাডমিন যাচাইকরণ</h3>
        <p className="text-sm text-stone-500 mb-4">শিক্ষক রেজিস্ট্রি সম্পাদনার জন্য অ্যাডমিন পাসকোড দিন।</p>
        <input type="password" value={secret} onChange={(e) => { setSecret(e.target.value); setError(''); }}
          onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && tryEnter()}
          className={cx('w-full border rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm', error ? 'border-rose-400' : 'border-stone-300')} placeholder="পাসকোড" />
        <FieldError>{error}</FieldError>
        <div className="flex gap-3 mt-4">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 border border-stone-300 rounded py-2.5 text-sm hover:bg-stone-50">বাতিল</button>
          <button onClick={tryEnter} className="flex-1 bg-emerald-800 text-white rounded py-2.5 text-sm hover:bg-emerald-900">প্রবেশ করুন</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   🏛️ MAIN APP
   ============================================================ */
export default function TeacherRegistry() {
  const [teachers, setTeachers] = useLocalState(LS_KEYS.teachers, []);
  const [customSubjects, setCustomSubjects] = useLocalState(LS_KEYS.subjects, []);
  const [nextSerial, setNextSerial] = useLocalState(LS_KEYS.serial, 1);

  // অ্যাডমিন স্ট্যাটাস ইচ্ছাকৃতভাবে localStorage-এ রাখা হয়নি — প্রতি সেশনে যাচাই আবশ্যক
  const [isAdmin, setIsAdmin] = useState(false);

  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [classFilter, setClassFilter] = useState('all');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('all');

  const [formState, setFormState] = useState(null); // null | 'new' | teacherObj
  const [profileTeacher, setProfileTeacher] = useState(null);
  const [idCardTeacher, setIdCardTeacher] = useState(null);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState(null);
  const [showAdminGate, setShowAdminGate] = useState(false);
  const [stampFlash, setStampFlash] = useState(false);
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);

  const pushToast = useCallback((message, type = 'info') => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    setToasts((t) => [...t, { id, message, type }]);
    setTimeout(() => setToasts((t) => t.filter((x) => x.id !== id)), 3500);
  }, []);

  const allSubjects = useMemo(() => [...new Set([...DEFAULT_SUBJECTS, ...customSubjects])], [customSubjects]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    return teachers.filter((t) => {
      if (classFilter !== 'all') {
        const inClass = (t.subjects || []).some((s) => s.classBn === classFilter) || t.classTeacherOf === classFilter;
        if (!inClass) return false;
      }
      if (statusFilter !== 'all' && t.status !== statusFilter) return false;
      if (search.trim()) {
        const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
        const hay = `${t.nameBn} ${t.nameEn} ${t.phone} ${t.designation}`.toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    }).sort((a, b) => a.serial - b.serial);
  }, [teachers, classFilter, statusFilter, search]);

  const classCounts = useMemo(() => {
    const counts = { all: teachers.length };
    CLASSES.forEach((c) => {
      counts[c] = teachers.filter((t) => (t.subjects || []).some((s) => s.classBn === c) || t.classTeacherOf === c).length;
    });
    return counts;
  }, [teachers]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const totalAssignments = teachers.reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.subjects || []).length, 0);
    const classesWithTeacher = new Set(teachers.filter((t) => t.classTeacherOf).map((t) => t.classTeacherOf)).size;
    const possibleSlots = CLASSES.length * allSubjects.length;
    return {
      total: teachers.length,
      assignments: totalAssignments,
      classesWithTeacher,
      vacant: Math.max(possibleSlots - totalAssignments, 0),
    };
  }, [teachers, allSubjects]);

  const handleSave = (draft) => {
    const isNew = !draft.id;
    let saved;
    if (isNew) {
      saved = { ...draft, id: genId(), serial: nextSerial, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      setTeachers((prev) => [...prev, saved]);
      setNextSerial((n) => n + 1);
    } else {
      saved = { ...draft, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
      setTeachers((prev) => prev.map((t) => (t.id === saved.id ? saved : t)));
    }
    const usedNames = (saved.subjects || []).map((s) => s.subjectName);
    const newOnes = usedNames.filter((n) => !allSubjects.includes(n));
    if (newOnes.length) setCustomSubjects((prev) => [...new Set([...prev, ...newOnes])]);

    setFormState(null);
    setStampFlash(true);
    setTimeout(() => setStampFlash(false), 1000);

  };

  const handleDelete = () => {
    setTeachers((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== deleteTarget.id));
    pushToast('এন্ট্রি মুছে ফেলা হয়েছে।', 'success');
    setDeleteTarget(null);
  };

  const requireAdmin = (action) => {
    if (isAdmin) { action(); return; }
    setShowAdminGate(true);
  };

  return (

      fontFamily: "'Noto Sans Bengali','Inter',sans-serif",

              </button>

                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" /> অ্যাডমিন মোড সক্রিয়
              </button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <button onClick={() => setShowAdminGate(true)} className="text-sm border border-emerald-300 text-emerald-800 rounded px-3 py-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 hover:bg-emerald-50">
              <Lock className="w-4 h-4" /> অ্যাডমিন প্রবেশ
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-5">
          <div className="md:col-span-3 md:sticky md:top-4 self-start">
            <ClassRail active={classFilter} onChange={setClassFilter} counts={classCounts} />
          </div>

          <div className="md:col-span-9">
            {filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="bg-white border border-dashed border-stone-300 rounded-md py-16 text-center">
                <Users className="w-10 h-10 text-stone-300 mx-auto mb-3" />
                <p className="text-stone-500 text-sm">কোনো শিক্ষক পাওয়া যায়নি। {isAdmin && 'নতুন এন্ট্রি যুক্ত করুন।'}</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                {filtered.map((t) => (
                  <TeacherCard key={t.id} teacher={t} isAdmin={isAdmin}
                    onView={setProfileTeacher}
                    onEdit={(tt) => requireAdmin(() => setFormState(tt))}
                    onDelete={(tt) => requireAdmin(() => setDeleteTarget(tt))} />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>

      {formState && (
        <TeacherForm
          teacher={formState === 'new' ? null : formState}
          teachers={teachers}
          allSubjects={allSubjects}
          onSave={handleSave}
          onClose={() => setFormState(null)}
          pushToast={pushToast}
        />
      )}
      {profileTeacher && (
        <ProfileView teacher={profileTeacher} isAdmin={isAdmin}
          onClose={() => setProfileTeacher(null)}
          onEdit={(t) => { setProfileTeacher(null); requireAdmin(() => setFormState(t)); }}
          onShowId={(t) => setIdCardTeacher(t)} />
      )}
      {idCardTeacher && <IDCardModal teacher={idCardTeacher} onClose={() => setIdCardTeacher(null)} />}
      {deleteTarget && <DeleteConfirmModal teacher={deleteTarget} onConfirm={handleDelete} onClose={() => setDeleteTarget(null)} />}
      {showAdminGate && (
        <AdminGateModal onClose={() => setShowAdminGate(false)}
          onSuccess={() => { setIsAdmin(true); setShowAdminGate(false); pushToast('অ্যাডমিন মোড সক্রিয় হয়েছে।', 'success'); }} />
      )}

      {stampFlash && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
          <div style={{ animation: 'stampIn 0.7s ease-out' }} className="bg-white rounded-full p-4 shadow-2xl">
            <OfficialSeal size={140} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <ToastHost toasts={toasts} />
    </div>
  );
}

const parseSheetName = (name) => {
  const parts = String(name).split('][').map(s => s.replace('[', '').replace(']', ''));
  return {
    className: parts[0] || 'অজানা',
    examName: parts[1] || 'অজানা',
    year: parts[2] || 'অজানা',
    date: parts[3] || 'অজানা',
    timestamp: parts[4] ? parseInt(parts[4]) : null
  };
};

// Helper for Level Text based on range (Updated with Strict Rules)
const getLevelText = (fromClass, toClass) => {
    const fromIdx = CLASS_HIERARCHY.indexOf(fromClass);
    const toIdx = CLASS_HIERARCHY.indexOf(toClass);
    
    if (fromIdx === 0 && toIdx === 2) return "প্রাক-প্রাথমিক স্তর";
    if (fromIdx === 3 && toIdx === 7) return "ইবতেদায়ী স্তর";
    if (fromIdx === 8 && toIdx === 12) return "দাখিল স্তর";
    if (fromIdx <= 3 && toIdx === 12) return "পুরো মাদ্রাসা";
    
    const fromLabel = classOptions.find(c => c.val === fromClass)?.label.split(' ')[0] || fromClass;
    const toLabel = classOptions.find(c => c.val === toClass)?.label.split(' ')[0] || toClass;
    return `${fromLabel} থেকে ${toLabel}`;
};

const SelectField = ({ label, icon: Icon, value, onChange, options, placeholder, error, errorMessage }) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const selectedOption = options.find(opt => opt.val === String(value));

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full" ref={dropdownRef}>
      <label className={`text-[12px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest pl-1 mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors duration-300 text-slate-500`}>
        <Icon className="w-4 h-4" /> {label}
      </label>
      
      <div 
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className={`w-full p-4 border rounded-xl font-bold flex justify-between items-center transition-all duration-300 ${
          error
            ? 'bg-red-50/50 border-red-400 text-red-700 shadow-[0_0_0_4px_rgba(248,113,113,0.15)] cursor-pointer'
            : isOpen 
              ? 'bg-teal-50/40 border-teal-500 shadow-[0_0_0_4px_rgba(20,184,166,0.15)] text-teal-800 cursor-pointer' 
              : 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:shadow-sm cursor-pointer'
        }`}
      >
        <span className={`${!selectedOption ? (error ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-slate-400') : ''}`}>
          {selectedOption ? selectedOption.label : placeholder}
        </span>
        <ChevronRight className={`w-5 h-5 transition-transform duration-300 ${isOpen ? '-rotate-90 text-teal-600' : (error ? 'text-red-400' : 'text-slate-400')}`} />
      </div>

      <div className={`overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 ${error ? 'max-h-10 opacity-100 mt-1.5' : 'max-h-0 opacity-0 mt-0'}`}>
         <div className="text-red-500 text-[12px] font-bold pl-1 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {errorMessage}
         </div>
      </div>

      <div 
        className={`absolute z-50 w-full mt-2 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_20px_50px_-10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)] overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 origin-top ${
          isOpen ? 'opacity-100 scale-y-100 translate-y-0' : 'opacity-0 scale-y-95 -translate-y-2 pointer-events-none'
        }`}
        style={{ top: '100%', left: 0 }}
      >
        <div className="max-h-[260px] overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-1 custom-scrollbar">
          {options.map((opt, i) => {
            const isSelected = String(value) === String(opt.val);

              <div 
                key={i}
                onClick={() => {
                  onChange({ target: { value: opt.val } });

                }}
                className={`px-4 py-3.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 ${

                    : 'text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900'

// 3. MAIN TOPPER FINDER COMPONENT

export default function TopperFinder() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [isAdmin, setIsAdmin] = useState(false);
  const [authLoading, setAuthLoading] = useState(true);
  
  const [publishedExams, setPublishedExams] = useState([]);
  const [isFetchingExams, setIsFetchingExams] = useState(false);
  
  // Search Form State
  const [examName, setExamName] = useState('1st Terminal');
  const [year, setYear] = useState('2026');
  const [fromClass, setFromClass] = useState('Class Six');
  const [toClass, setToClass] = useState('Class Ten');
  const [topCount, setTopCount] = useState('3');
  
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState('');
  const [showValidation, setShowValidation] = useState(false);
  const [toppersResult, setToppersResult] = useState(null);

  const [toast, setToast] = useState({ show: false, message: '', type: 'success' });

  const showToast = (message, type = 'success', duration = 3000) => {
    setToast({ show: true, message, type });
    if (type !== 'loading') {
      setTimeout(() => setToast({ show: false, message: '', type: 'success' }), duration);
    }
  };
  const hideToast = () => setToast({ show: false, message: '', type: 'success' });

  // 1. Check Auth
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = onAuthStateChanged(auth, (user) => {
      if (user && USER_ROLES[user.email]?.role === 'Admin') {
        setIsAdmin(true);
        fetchAllExams();
      } else {
        alert("শুধুমাত্র এডমিনদের এই পেজে এক্সেস রয়েছে।");
        navigate("/"); 
      }
      setAuthLoading(false);
    });
    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, [navigate]);

  // 2. Fetch All Exams List
  const fetchAllExams = async () => {
    setIsFetchingExams(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL + '?role=admin');
      const text = await response.text();
      const result = JSON.parse(text);
      
      if (result.status === 'success') {
        const validExams = (result.data || []).filter(sheet => String(sheet.sheetName).startsWith('['));
        setPublishedExams(validExams);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to fetch exam list", error);
    } finally {
      setIsFetchingExams(false);
    }
  };

  // Helper to fetch student images
  const fetchStudentDetails = async (id) => {
      try {
          // কেন্দ্রীয় সার্ভারের পাবলিক ভেরিফাই এন্ডপয়েন্ট (লগইন লাগে না)
          const doc = await studentApi.publicVerify(String(id).trim());
          if (!doc) return null;
          return {
              ImageURL: doc.profilePicture?.url || '',
              StudentNameEn: doc.fullNameEng || ''
          };
      } catch(e) {
          console.error("Failed to fetch image for", id);
          return null;
      }
  }

  // 3. CORE LOGIC: Find Toppers
  const handleFindToppers = async () => {
    setShowValidation(true);
    setErrorMessage('');
    setToppersResult(null);

    if (!examName || !year || !fromClass || !toClass || !topCount) {
      setErrorMessage("অনুগ্রহ করে সবগুলো তথ্য সঠিকভাবে দিন।");
      return;
    }

    const fromIdx = CLASS_HIERARCHY.indexOf(fromClass);
    const toIdx = CLASS_HIERARCHY.indexOf(toClass);

    if (fromIdx === -1 || toIdx === -1) {
      setErrorMessage("ক্লাস সিলেকশনে ভুল আছে।");
      return;
    }

    if (fromIdx > toIdx) {
      setErrorMessage("'থেকে (From)' ক্লাস অবশ্যই 'পর্যন্ত (To)' ক্লাসের সমান বা ছোট হতে হবে।");
      return;
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);
    showToast(`ডাটা সংগ্রহ করা হচ্ছে...`, 'loading');

    try {
      // Step A: Filter relevant sheets
      const targetSheets = publishedExams.filter(exam => {
        const info = parseSheetName(exam.sheetName);
        if (info.examName !== examName || info.year !== year) return false;
        
        const classIdx = CLASS_HIERARCHY.indexOf(info.className);
        return classIdx >= fromIdx && classIdx <= toIdx;
      });

      if (targetSheets.length === 0) {
        throw new Error("এই রেঞ্জের মধ্যে কোনো রেজাল্ট শিট সার্ভারে পাওয়া যায়নি।");
      }

      // Step B: Fetch sheets
      const fetchPromises = targetSheets.map(async (sheetObj) => {
        const response = await fetch(GOOGLE_SCRIPT_URL, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            action: 'search',
            sheetName: sheetObj.sheetName,
            key: ADMIN_SECRET 
          })
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (result.status === 'success') {
          return { sheetInfo: parseSheetName(sheetObj.sheetName), data: result.data };
        }
        return null;
      });

      const sheetsData = (await Promise.all(fetchPromises)).filter(Boolean);
      
      if (sheetsData.length === 0) {
        throw new Error("ডাটাবেজ থেকে ডাটা পড়তে ব্যর্থ হয়েছে।");
      }

      // Step C: Process Students
      let allPassedStudents = [];

      sheetsData.forEach(({ sheetInfo, data }) => {
        if (!data || data.length < 2) return;
        
        const headers = data[0].map(h => String(h).toLowerCase().trim());
        
        const idIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h.includes('id') && !h.includes('name'));
        const nameIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h.includes('namebn')) !== -1 
                      ? headers.findIndex(h => h.includes('namebn')) 
                      : headers.findIndex(h => h.includes('name'));
        const nameEnIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h === 'name' || h.includes('name en'));
        const rollIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h.includes('roll'));
        const gpaIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h === 'gpa');
        const avgIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h.includes('average'));
        const statusIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h === 'status');

        if (nameIdx === -1 || gpaIdx === -1 || statusIdx === -1) return;

        for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
          const row = data[i];
          const status = String(row[statusIdx]).toLowerCase();
          
          if (status.includes('pass') || status === 'pass' || status === '-') {
            allPassedStudents.push({
              id: idIdx !== -1 ? row[idIdx] : null,
              name: row[nameIdx],
              nameEn: nameEnIdx !== -1 ? row[nameEnIdx] : row[nameIdx],
              className: sheetInfo.className,
              roll: row[rollIdx],
              gpa: parseFloat(row[gpaIdx]) || 0,
              avg: avgIdx !== -1 ? (parseFloat(row[avgIdx]) || 0) : 0
            });
          }
        }
      });

      // Step D: Apply STRICT Tie-Breaker Logic
      allPassedStudents.sort((a, b) => {
        if (b.gpa !== a.gpa) return b.gpa - a.gpa;
        if (b.avg !== a.avg) return b.avg - a.avg;
        return parseInt(a.roll || 999) - parseInt(b.roll || 999);
      });

      const maxToppers = parseInt(topCount) || 3;
      const finalToppers = allPassedStudents.slice(0, maxToppers);

      // Set Toppers instantly so Form hides and UI updates quickly
      setToppersResult({
        totalAnalyzed: allPassedStudents.length,
        classesInvolved: sheetsData.map(s => s.sheetInfo.className).join(', '),
        levelText: getLevelText(fromClass, toClass),
        toppers: finalToppers
      });
      
      hideToast();
      showToast("টপার তালিকা সফলভাবে প্রস্তুত হয়েছে!", "success");

      // Fetch images in background asynchronously without blocking UI
      finalToppers.forEach(async (student, index) => {
          if(student.id) {
              const details = await fetchStudentDetails(student.id);
              if(details) {
                  setToppersResult(prev => {
                      if (!prev) return prev; // In case user cleared result already
                      const newToppers = [...prev.toppers];
                      if (newToppers[index]) {
                         newToppers[index] = {
                             ...newToppers[index],
                             imageUrl: details.ImageURL,
                             nameEn: details.StudentNameEn || newToppers[index].nameEn
                         };
                      }
                      return { ...prev, toppers: newToppers };
                  });
              }
          }
      });

    } catch (err) {
      hideToast();
      setErrorMessage(err.message || "সার্ভারে সমস্যা হয়েছে। পুনরায় চেষ্টা করুন।");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  if (authLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="h-screen w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-gray-50 font-sans">
        <Loader2 className="animate-spin text-teal-600 mb-4" size={48} />
        <p className="text-slate-600 font-bold text-lg">অ্যাডমিন এক্সেস যাচাই করা হচ্ছে...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isAdmin) return null;

  return (
    <div className="w-full min-h-screen bg-slate-50 font-sans text-slate-800 overflow-x-hidden pb-10">
      {toast.show && (
        <div className="fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[9999] animate-fade-in">
          <div className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl font-bold text-white
            ${toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-green-600' : ''}
            ${toast.type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-600' : ''}
            ${toast.type === 'loading' ? 'bg-slate-800' : ''}
          `}>
            {toast.type === 'loading' && <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white/40 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin"></div>}
            {toast.type === 'success' && "✔"}
            {toast.type === 'error' && "✖"}
            <span>{toast.message}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <nav className="fixed top-0 w-full bg-white/30 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-slate-200/60 shadow-[0_8px_30px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] z-50 transition-all duration-300">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center h-[72px]">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
              <div className="w-11 h-11 bg-gradient-to-tr from-teal-500 to-emerald-500 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-teal-500/30 shrink-0">
                <Trophy className="w-6 h-6 text-white" />
              </div>
              <div className="leading-tight mt-0.5">
                <h1 className="text-[20px] font-black text-slate-800 tracking-tight">মেধা তালিকা নির্ধারণ</h1>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-teal-600 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mt-0.5">অ্যাডমিন সুপার প্যানেল</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            <button 
              onClick={() => navigate("/")}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-white text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-lg font-bold text-[13px] shadow-sm transition-all"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> <span className="hidden sm:inline">মূল ড্যাশবোর্ডে ফিরুন</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </nav>

      <main className="w-full max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 md:py-10 pt-28">
        
        <div className="relative mb-8 md:mb-12 flex flex-col items-center text-center z-10">
          <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-64 h-64 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400/10 via-orange-400/10 to-amber-400/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none -z-10 animate-[pulse_5s_infinite]"></div>
          
          <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-[42px] font-black tracking-tight mb-2 leading-tight group relative overflow-hidden pb-2 px-4">
            <span className="text-slate-800 drop-shadow-sm">সেরাদের </span>
            <span className="bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 via-orange-500 to-amber-600 drop-shadow-sm">
              খুঁজে বের করুন
            </span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-[14px] md:text-[16px] text-slate-500 font-bold max-w-xl mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            একাধিক ক্লাসের মধ্যে কম্পেয়ার করে নিখুঁতভাবে টাই-ব্রেকার লজিক (GPA ও Average) প্রয়োগ করে টপারদের তালিকা তৈরি করুন।
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* SEARCH FORM SECTION - HIDDEN WHEN RESULT IS READY */}
        {!toppersResult && (
          <div className="bg-white p-6 md:p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 space-y-6 md:space-y-8 relative overflow-hidden mb-10 animate-fade-in">
            {isFetchingExams && (
              <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 m-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-teal-600 bg-teal-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full">
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> ডাটাবেজ সিঙ্ক হচ্ছে...
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5 md:gap-6">
              <SelectField 
                label="পরীক্ষা" icon={BookOpen} value={examName} 
                onChange={e => { setExamName(e.target.value); setShowValidation(false); setErrorMessage(''); }} 
                options={examOptions} placeholder="পরীক্ষা নির্বাচন করুন"
                error={showValidation && !examName} errorMessage="পরীক্ষা নির্বাচন করুন"
              />
              <SelectField 
                label="সাল" icon={Calendar} value={year} 
                onChange={e => { setYear(e.target.value); setShowValidation(false); setErrorMessage(''); }} 
                options={yearOptions} placeholder="সাল"
                error={showValidation && !year} errorMessage="সাল নির্বাচন করুন"
              />
              <SelectField 
                label="টপার সংখ্যা (কতজন)" icon={Users} value={topCount} 
                onChange={e => { setTopCount(e.target.value); setShowValidation(false); setErrorMessage(''); }} 
                options={[
                  {val: '3', label: 'টপ ৩ জন (Top 3)'},
                  {val: '5', label: 'টপ ৫ জন (Top 5)'},
                  {val: '10', label: 'টপ ১০ জন (Top 10)'}
                ]} 
                placeholder="কতজন টপার"
                error={showValidation && !topCount} errorMessage="সংখ্যা নির্বাচন করুন"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="p-5 bg-slate-50/80 border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5 md:gap-6 relative">
              <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-8 h-8 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-full hidden md:flex items-center justify-center z-10 shadow-sm text-slate-400 font-black text-xs">TO</div>
              <SelectField 
                label="এই ক্লাস থেকে (From)" icon={Filter} value={fromClass} 
                onChange={e => { setFromClass(e.target.value); setShowValidation(false); setErrorMessage(''); }} 
                options={classOptions} placeholder="শুরুর ক্লাস"
                error={showValidation && !fromClass} errorMessage="শুরুর ক্লাস দিন"
              />
              <SelectField 
                label="এই ক্লাস পর্যন্ত (To)" icon={Filter} value={toClass} 
                onChange={e => { setToClass(e.target.value); setShowValidation(false); setErrorMessage(''); }} 
                options={classOptions} placeholder="শেষ ক্লাস"
                error={showValidation && !toClass} errorMessage="শেষ ক্লাস দিন"
              />
            </div>

            {errorMessage && (
              <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 p-4 md:p-5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold flex gap-3 shadow-sm animate-fade-in">
                <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0" /> <p>{errorMessage}</p>
              </div>
            )}

            <button 
              onClick={handleFindToppers}
              disabled={isProcessing || isFetchingExams}
              className="w-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-900 disabled:bg-slate-500 text-white py-4 md:py-5 rounded-xl font-bold text-base md:text-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-3 transition-all shadow-lg shadow-slate-900/20"
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <><Loader2 className="w-5 md:w-6 h-5 md:h-6 animate-spin" /> প্রসেস করা হচ্ছে...</>
              ) : (
                <><Search className="w-5 md:w-6 h-5 md:h-6" /> টপার তালিকা তৈরি করুন</>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* RESULTS SECTION - ULTRA PREMIUM DESIGN */}
        {toppersResult && (
          <div className="animate-slide-up">
            
            {/* Back to Form Button */}
            <button 
              onClick={() => setToppersResult(null)}
              className="mb-6 flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm shadow-sm transition-all"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> নতুন করে খুঁজুন
            </button>

            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-center mb-8 bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-amber-50 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center border border-amber-100">
                    <Award className="w-7 h-7 text-amber-500" /> 
                </div>
                <div>
                    <h3 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black text-slate-800">চূড়ান্ত মেধা তালিকা</h3>
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                    মোট <span className="text-teal-600">{toBn(toppersResult.totalAnalyzed)}</span> জন পাস করা শিক্ষার্থীর মধ্যে বিশ্লেষণ করা হয়েছে।
                    </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 md:mt-0 px-5 py-2 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-full text-sm font-bold border-2 border-slate-700 shadow-md">
                 ক্যাটাগরি: {toppersResult.levelText}
              </div>
            </div>

            {toppersResult.toppers.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="bg-white border border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-3xl p-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center shadow-sm">
                <Trophy className="w-16 h-16 text-slate-300 mb-4" />
                <h3 className="text-slate-700 font-bold text-xl mb-2">কাউকে পাওয়া যায়নি</h3>
                <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm font-medium">সিলেক্ট করা রেঞ্জে কোনো পাস করা শিক্ষার্থী পাওয়া যায়নি।</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 relative">
                {toppersResult.toppers.map((student, index) => {
                  const isFirst = index === 0;
                  const isSecond = index === 1;
                  const isThird = index === 2;
                  
                  let rankTitle = `${toBn(index + 1)}ম স্থান`;
                  let MedalIcon = Medal;
                  
                  // Premium Ranking Styles (Gold, Silver, Bronze)
                  let cardStyle = "bg-white border-slate-200 shadow-md hover:shadow-lg relative";
                  let rankBadge = "bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border-slate-200";
                  let imageRing = "border-slate-200";

                  if (isFirst) {
                    // 1st Place - Gold Theme
                    cardStyle = "bg-gradient-to-b from-[#FFFDF0] to-white border-amber-300 shadow-[0_10px_40px_rgba(245,158,11,0.15)] md:-translate-y-4 z-10 scale-100 md:scale-105 border-2 relative";
                    rankBadge = "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border-amber-300";
                    imageRing = "border-amber-400 ring-4 ring-amber-100";
                    rankTitle = "১ম স্থান (টপার)";
                  } else if (isSecond) {
                    // 2nd Place - Premium Silver Theme
                    cardStyle = "bg-gradient-to-b from-[#F8FAFC] to-[#F1F5F9] border-slate-400 shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(148,163,184,0.3)] md:-translate-y-2 border-2 relative";
                    rankBadge = "bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 border-slate-400";
                    imageRing = "border-slate-400 ring-4 ring-slate-200";
                    rankTitle = "২য় স্থান (সিলভার)";
                  } else if (isThird) {
                    // 3rd Place - Bronze Theme
                    cardStyle = "bg-gradient-to-b from-[#FFF7ED] to-[#FFEDD5] border-orange-300 shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(249,115,22,0.15)] border-2 relative";
                    rankBadge = "bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border-orange-300";
                    imageRing = "border-orange-400 ring-4 ring-orange-100";
                    rankTitle = "৩য় স্থান (ব্রোঞ্জ)";
                  }

                  return (
                    <div 
                      key={index}
                      className={`rounded-3xl p-6 border transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden group ${cardStyle}`}
                      style={{ animation: `slideUp 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) ${index * 0.15}s both` }}
                    >
                      {/* Decorative Background Elements */}
                      {isFirst && (
                          <>
                            <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-32 h-32 bg-amber-400/10 rounded-bl-full pointer-events-none -z-0"></div>
                            <div className="absolute -top-4 -left-4 w-16 h-16 bg-amber-400/20 rounded-full blur-xl pointer-events-none -z-0"></div>
                          </>
                      )}
                      {isSecond && (
                          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-24 h-24 bg-slate-400/10 rounded-bl-full pointer-events-none -z-0"></div>
                      )}
                      {isThird && (
                          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-24 h-24 bg-orange-400/10 rounded-bl-full pointer-events-none -z-0"></div>
                      )}

                      <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col h-full">
                          
                          {/* Top Row: Rank & Class (With Level Text added for each card) */}
                          <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-6">
                              <div className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-black border flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm ${rankBadge}`}>
                                  <MedalIcon className="w-4 h-4" /> {rankTitle}
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1.5">
                                <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 border border-teal-100 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest shadow-sm">
                                    {student.className}
                                </span>
                                <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-100 rounded-full text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest shadow-sm">
                                    {toppersResult.levelText}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                          </div>

                          {/* Profile Section */}
                          <div className="flex flex-col items-center mb-6 text-center">
                              <div className={`w-24 h-24 rounded-full mb-4 bg-slate-100 border-2 overflow-hidden shadow-md flex-shrink-0 ${imageRing} relative`}>
                                  {!student.imageUrl && (
                                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-100">
                                       <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-slate-400" />
                                    </div>
                                  )}
                                  <img 
                                      src={student.imageUrl || "https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/3135/3135715.png"} 
                                      alt={student.name}
                                      className="w-full h-full object-cover relative z-10"
                                      onError={(e) => {e.target.src = "https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/3135/3135715.png"}}
                                  />
                              </div>
                              <h4 className="text-[20px] font-black text-slate-800 leading-tight mb-1">{student.name}</h4>
                              {student.nameEn && student.nameEn !== student.name && (
                                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-2 uppercase">{student.nameEn}</p>
                              )}
                          </div>

                          {/* ID & Roll Info */}
                          <div className="flex justify-center gap-4 mb-6">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
                                  <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> রোল: {toBn(student.roll)}
                              </div>
                              {student.id && (
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
                                      <CreditCard className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> আইডি: {toBn(student.id)}
                                  </div>
                              )}
                          </div>

                          <div className="mt-auto"></div>

                          {/* Score Cards (GPA & AVG) */}
                          <div className="bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-100 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 shadow-[0_2px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] group-hover:shadow-[0_4px_15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-shadow">
                              <div className="text-center p-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-50 to-white border border-slate-100">
                                  <span className="block text-[10px] font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">GPA</span>
                                  <span className={`block text-[28px] font-black leading-none ${isFirst ? 'text-amber-600' : isSecond ? 'text-slate-600' : isThird ? 'text-orange-600' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>
                                      {student.gpa.toFixed(2)}
                                  </span>
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-center p-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-50 to-white border border-slate-100">
                                  <span className="block text-[10px] font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">গড় (%)</span>
                                  <span className={`block text-[28px] font-black leading-none ${isFirst ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-slate-700'}`}>
                                      {toBn(student.avg.toFixed(2))}
                                  </span>
                              </div>
                          </div>

                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

      </main>

      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: `
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;600;700&display=swap');
        .font-sans { font-family: 'Hind Siliguri', sans-serif; }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #cbd5e1; border-radius: 10px; }
        .animate-fade-in { animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease-out; }
        .animate-slide-up { animation: slideUp 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; }
        @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
        @keyframes slideUp { 
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); } 
          to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } 
        }
        @keyframes shimmer {
          100% { transform: translateX(100%); }
        }
      `}} />
    </div>
  );
}

// ==============================================
// ARDM Student Portal — System Configuration
// ==============================================

export const ONLY_ADMIN = true;
export const MAINTAINANCE_MODE = false;  // true হলে মেইনটেন্যান্স মোডে যাবে, false হলে নরমাল মোডে থাকবে

export const RESULT_PUBLISH_TIME = "2027-08-17T19:30:00+06:00";

// ---------- Centralized ERP backend ----------
export const API_BASE_URL =
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || "http://localhost:5000/api/v1";

// Shared with the Teacher ERP client so the session is common
export const TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY = "ardm_erp_jwt_token";
export const USER_STORAGE_KEY = "ardm_erp_auth_user";

// Roles allowed to enter the student portal

// ── vCard EXPORT HELPERS (ported from register→contact tool) ──
const CONTACT_CLASS_CODE = {
  "Play": "00", "Nursery": "0", "KG": "0K", "Kg": "0K",
  "One": "1", "Two": "2", "Three": "3", "Four": "4",
  "Five": "5", "Six": "6", "Seven": "7", "Eight": "8", "Nine": "9", "Ten": "10"
};

const vcardEscape = (str) => {
  if (str === undefined || str === null) return "";
  return String(str)
    .replace(/\\/g, "\\\\")
    .replace(/;/g, "\\;")
    .replace(/,/g, "\\,")
    .replace(/\n/g, "\\n");
};

const foldLine = (line) => {
  if (line.length <= 75) return line;
  let out = "";
  let count = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
    if (count === 75) { out += "\r\n "; count = 0; }
    out += line[i];
    count++;
  }
  return out;
};

const fetchAsBase64 = async (url) => {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, { mode: "cors" });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error("bad status");
    const blob = await res.blob();
    const type = blob.type || "image/jpeg";
    const buf = await blob.arrayBuffer();
    let binary = "";
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.byteLength; i++) binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
    return { base64: btoa(binary), type };
  } catch (err) {
    return null;
  }
};

const buildContactAddress = (s) => {
  const street = [s.houseEn, s.villageEn].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
  return `;;${vcardEscape(street)};${vcardEscape(s.upazilaEn)};${vcardEscape(s.unionEn)};;${vcardEscape(s.districtEn)}`;
};

const buildContactNote = (s) => {
  const lines = [
    `নাম: ${s.nameBn}`,
    `Student ID: ${s.id}`,
    `Father: ${s.fatherEn}`,
    `পিতা: ${s.fatherBn ? ` ${s.fatherBn}` : ""}`,
    `Mother: ${s.motherEn}`,
    `মাতা: ${s.motherBn ? ` ${s.motherBn}` : ""}`,
    `Blood Group: ${s.blood || "N/A"}`,
    `BRN: ${s.brn || "N/A"}`,
    `Class: ${s.classEn} · Roll ${s.roll}`
  ];
  return lines.join("\n");
};

const normalizeForVCard = (data) => {
  const rawClass = (data.ClassEn || "").trim();
const code = CONTACT_CLASS_CODE[rawClass] || "0";  const nameEn = data.StudentNameEn || "";
  return {
    id: data.ID,
    code,
    classEn: data.ClassEn,
    roll: data.Roll,
    nameEn,
    nameBn: data.StudentNameBn,
    brn: data.BRN,
    dob: toISODate(data.DOB),
    session: data.Session,
    blood: data.BloodGroup,
    fatherEn: data.FatherNameEn, fatherBn: data.FatherNameBn,
    motherEn: data.MotherNameEn, motherBn: data.MotherNameBn,
    mobile: data.WhatsApp, emergency: data.EmergencyNo,
    houseEn: data.HouseNameEn, villageEn: data.VillageEn,
    unionEn: data.UnionEn, upazilaEn: data.UpazilaEn, districtEn: data.DistrictEn,
    imageUrl: data.ImageURL,
    vcardName: `${code} ${nameEn}`.trim()
  };
};

const buildContactVCard = async (data) => {
  const s = normalizeForVCard(data);
  let photoData = null;
  if (s.imageUrl) photoData = await fetchAsBase64(s.imageUrl);

  const lines = [];
  lines.push("BEGIN:VCARD");
  lines.push("VERSION:3.0");
  lines.push(foldLine(`FN:${vcardEscape(s.vcardName)}`));
  lines.push(foldLine(`N:${vcardEscape(s.vcardName)};;;;`));
  if (s.mobile) lines.push(foldLine(`TEL;TYPE=CELL,VOICE:${vcardEscape(s.mobile)}`));
  if (s.emergency && s.emergency !== s.mobile) lines.push(foldLine(`TEL;TYPE=HOME,VOICE:${vcardEscape(s.emergency)}`));
  lines.push(foldLine(`ADR;TYPE=HOME:${buildContactAddress(s)}`));
  if (s.dob) lines.push(`BDAY:${s.dob}`);
  lines.push(foldLine(`ORG:Class ${vcardEscape(s.classEn)} (Roll: ${vcardEscape(s.roll)}) Session: ${vcardEscape(s.session)}`));
  lines.push(foldLine(`TITLE:Student`));
  lines.push(foldLine(`CATEGORIES:ARDM,Class ${vcardEscape(s.classEn)}`));
  lines.push(foldLine(`NOTE:${vcardEscape(buildContactNote(s))}`));
  if (photoData) {
    const subtype = (photoData.type.split("/")[1] || "JPEG").toUpperCase();
    lines.push(foldLine(`PHOTO;ENCODING=b;TYPE=${subtype}:${photoData.base64}`));
  } else if (s.imageUrl) {
    lines.push(foldLine(`PHOTO;VALUE=URI:${s.imageUrl}`));
  }
  lines.push(`REV:${new Date().toISOString()}`);
  lines.push("END:VCARD");
  return lines.join("\r\n");
};

const handleCopyAllIds = async () => {
  const list = filteredList;
  if (!list || list.length === 0) {
    return showToast("কপি করার জন্য কোনো আইডি নেই", "error");
  }
  const idsText = list.map(s => s.ID).filter(Boolean).join(', ');
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(idsText);
    showToast(`${list.length}টি স্টুডেন্ট আইডি কপি হয়েছে`, "success");
  } catch (e) {
    showToast("কপি করা যায়নি", "error");
  }
};
  const checkExportPermission = () => {
  // যদি টগল 'false' (অফ) থাকে, তবে আগের মতই সবাই সব এক্সপোর্ট করতে পারবে
  if (!RESTRICT_EXPORT_BY_ROLE) return true;

  // ভিজিটরদের জন্য সম্পূর্ণ ব্লক
  if (currentUser?.role === 'Visitor') {
    showToast("ভিজিটরদের ডাটা ডাউনলোড করার অনুমতি নেই!", "error");
    return false;
  }

  // ক্লাস টিচারদের জন্য রেস্ট্রিকশন
  if (currentUser?.role === 'Class') {
    // চেক করা হচ্ছে ফিল্টার করা লিস্টে অন্য কোনো ক্লাসের স্টুডেন্ট আছে কিনা
    const hasOtherClassData = filteredList.some(s => s.ClassBn !== currentUser.classBn);
    
    if (hasOtherClassData) {
      showToast(`আপনি শুধুমাত্র আপনার ক্লাস (${currentUser.classBn}) এর ডাটা ডাউনলোড করতে পারবেন!`, "error");
      return false;
    }
  }

  // এডমিন বা সঠিক পারমিশন থাকলে true রিটার্ন করবে
  return true;
};

  setContactProgress({ show: true, current: 0, total: list.length, name: '' });

  try {

      setContactProgress({ show: true, current: i, total: list.length, name: s.StudentNameEn || s.StudentNameBn || '' });

    }
    setContactProgress({ show: true, current: list.length, total: list.length, name: '' });

    const vcfText = cards.join("\r\n");
    const blob = new Blob([vcfText], { type: "text/vcard;charset=utf-8" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `ARDM_Contacts_${list.length}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.vcf`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

    showToast(`${list.length} টি কন্টাক কার্ড ডাউনলোড হয়েছে`, "success");
  } catch (e) {
