/**
 * ARDM Student Portal — State & RBAC Controller (MVC "controller")
 * - ERP session (shared JWT with Teacher client) + role mapping
 * - student CRUD against the centralized backend
 * - search / class filter / sort (verbatim logic from the original Index.jsx)
 */
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { authApi, studentApi } from '../services/studentApiService';
import {
  clearAuthSessionStorage,
  extractApiErrorMessage,
  getStoredAuthToken,
  getStoredAuthUser
} from '../services/axiosClient';
import { extractFieldErrors } from '../services/apiErrors';
import { uploadSquarePhotoToCloudinary } from '../services/cloudinaryClient';
import { CLASS_ORDER, DEFAULT_IMAGE } from '../config/systemConfig';
import {
  canCreateStudent,
  canManageStudent,
  findSiblings,
  getDaysUntilBirthday,
  toUiStudents,
  toUiUser,
  toServerPayload
} from '../models/studentModel';
import { createExportController } from './exportController';

const STUDENTS_CACHE_KEY = 'ardm_students_cache_v2';

export default function useStudentController() {
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState(null);
  const [authLoading, setAuthLoading] = useState(true);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('home');
  const [students, setStudents] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [processing, setProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [viewerImg, setViewerImg] = useState(null);
  const [detailData, setDetailData] = useState(null);
  const [isEdit, setIsEdit] = useState(false);
  const [searchText, setSearchText] = useState('');
  const [isFilterOpen, setIsFilterOpen] = useState(false);
  const [advancedFilteredData, setAdvancedFilteredData] = useState(null);
  const [isPdfModalOpen, setIsPdfModalOpen] = useState(false);
  // যখন ডাটাবেস থেকে নতুন ডাটা লোড হবে, তখন ফিল্টার রিসেট করার জন্য:
  useEffect(() => {
    setAdvancedFilteredData(null);
  }, [students]);
  const [showAllExports, setShowAllExports] = useState(false);
  const [scrollPos, setScrollPos] = useState(0);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState({ show: false, msg: '', type: 'success' });

  const [contactProgress, setContactProgress] = useState({ show: false, current: 0, total: 0, name: '' });
  const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("sortConfig")) || { field: '', order: '' }; }
    catch { return { field: '', order: '' }; }
  });

  const [classFilter, setClassFilter] = useState('All');

  const showToast = (msg, type = 'success') => {
    setToast({ show: true, msg, type });
    // ৩ সেকেন্ড পর অটোমেটিক বন্ধ হবে
    setTimeout(() => setToast(prev => ({ ...prev, show: false })), 3000);
  };

  // ইউজার লগিন করার পর টিচারদের নিজস্ব ক্লাস (assignedClass) ডিফল্টভাবে সিলেক্ট হবে
  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentUser) {
      if (currentUser.role === "Class" && currentUser.classBn) {
        setClassFilter(currentUser.classBn); // টিচারের জন্য তার নিজের ক্লাস
      } else {
        setClassFilter(localStorage.getItem("classFilter") || 'All'); // এডমিন (বা ক্লাসবিহীন টিচার) — All
      }
    }
  }, [currentUser]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (classFilter) localStorage.setItem("classFilter", classFilter);
  }, [classFilter]);

  useEffect(() => {
    localStorage.setItem("sortConfig", JSON.stringify(sortConfig));
  }, [sortConfig]);

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 1. ERP SESSION CHECK ON BOOT  (GET /auth/me)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  useEffect(() => {
    // পুরনো গুগল-শিট ক্যাশ কখনোই নতুন ডাটার সাথে মিশবে না
    try { localStorage.removeItem('cachedStudents'); } catch (e) {}

    let cancelled = false;
    const token = getStoredAuthToken();
    if (!token) {
      setCurrentUser(null);
      setAuthLoading(false);
      return undefined;
    }

    // দ্রুত UI-র জন্য সংরক্ষিত ইউজার, তারপর সার্ভারে যাচাই
    const stored = getStoredAuthUser();
    if (stored) setCurrentUser(toUiUser(stored));

    authApi.me()
      .then((user) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        localStorage.setItem('ardm_erp_auth_user', JSON.stringify(user));
        setCurrentUser(toUiUser(user));
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        const status = err?.response?.status;
        if (status === 401 || status === 403 || !err?.response) {
          if (status === 401 || status === 403) clearAuthSessionStorage();
          if (!err?.response && stored) return; // অফলাইনে সংরক্ষিত সেশন দিয়েই চলবে
          setCurrentUser(null);
        } else {
          // Pending / নিষ্ক্রিয় / অননুমোদিত রোল
          clearAuthSessionStorage();
          setCurrentUser(null);
          alert(err.message || extractApiErrorMessage(err));
        }
      })
      .finally(() => { if (!cancelled) setAuthLoading(false); });

    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  const login = async (identifier, password) => {
    try {
      const { user } = await authApi.login(identifier, password);
      setCurrentUser(toUiUser(user));
      return { ok: true };
    } catch (err) {
      return { ok: false, message: extractApiErrorMessage(err, 'লগিন ব্যর্থ হয়েছে') };
    }
  };

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    if (window.confirm("আপনি কি লগআউট করতে চান?")) {
      await authApi.logout();
      setCurrentUser(null);
      setStudents([]);
      setDetailData(null);
      setTab('home');
    }
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 2. LOAD DATA ON LOGIN  (GET /students)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  const loadData = async (showLoader = true) => {
    setIsSyncing(true); // ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ড সিঙ্ক শুরু হলো (উপরের আইকন ঘুরবে)

    let cachedData = null;
    try { cachedData = localStorage.getItem(STUDENTS_CACHE_KEY); } catch (e) {}

    if (cachedData && students.length === 0) {
      try { setStudents(JSON.parse(cachedData)); } catch (e) {} // চোখের পলকে লিস্ট দেখাবে
    }

    if (!cachedData && showLoader) {
      setLoading(true); // কোনো ডাটা না থাকলে শুধু প্রথমবার বড় লোডার দেখাবে
    }

    try {
      const docs = await studentApi.list();
      const list = toUiStudents(docs);
      setStudents(list);
      try { localStorage.setItem(STUDENTS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list)); } catch (e) {}
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Data fetch error:", e);
      if (e?.response?.status === 401) {
        clearAuthSessionStorage();
        setCurrentUser(null);
        showToast("সেশন শেষ হয়েছে, আবার লগইন করুন", "error");
      } else if (!cachedData) {
        showToast(extractApiErrorMessage(e, "ইন্টারনেট সংযোগ চেক করুন!"), "error");
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false); // বড় লোডার বন্ধ
      setIsSyncing(false); // ব্যাকগ্রাউন্ড সিঙ্ক শেষ (উপরের আইকন থেমবে)
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentUser) loadData(true); // true মানে প্রথমবার লোডার কল হবে
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [currentUser?._id, currentUser?.teacherCode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!detailData) {
      window.scrollTo({
        top: scrollPos,
        behavior: "instant" // চাইলে "smooth"
      });
    }
  }, [detailData]);

  const roleFilteredStudents = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currentUser) return [];
    // সার্ভার যে ডাটা দেয় সেটাই দেখানো হবে; এডিট/এক্সপোর্ট RBAC আলাদাভাবে চেক হয়
    return students;
  }, [students, currentUser]);

  // যখনই ট্যাব পরিবর্তন হবে, তখন যদি সেটি 'search' ট্যাব না হয়, তবে সার্চ টেক্সট ক্লিয়ার করে দিবে
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== 'search') {
      setSearchText('');
    }
  }, [tab]);

useEffect(() => {
  const handleBack = () => {
// ✅ এটি সবার আগে যোগ করুন
    if (viewerImg) {
      setViewerImg(null);
      return;
    }
    if (isPdfModalOpen) {
  setIsPdfModalOpen(false);
  return;
    }
    // ১. যদি ফিল্টার মডাল ওপেন থাকে, তাহলে আগে সেটা ক্লোজ হবে
    if (isFilterOpen) {
      setIsFilterOpen(false);
      return;
    }

    // Edit → Detail
    if (isEdit) {
      setIsEdit(false);
      setTab('home');
      return;
    }

    // Detail → Home
    if (detailData) {
      setDetailData(null);
      return;
    }

    // Add → Home
    if (tab === 'add') {
      setTab('home');
      return;
    }

    // Search → Home
    if (tab !== 'home') {
      setTab('home');
      return;
    }

    // Home → Exit
    if (window.confirm("আপনি কি অ্যাপ থেকে বের হতে চান?")) {
      window.history.back();
    } else {
      window.history.pushState(null, "", window.location.href);
    }
  };

  window.addEventListener("popstate", handleBack);
  return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", handleBack);
}, [tab, detailData, isEdit, isFilterOpen, viewerImg, isPdfModalOpen]); // <--- এখানে isFilterOpen যুক্ত করা হয়েছে

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 3. CREATE / UPDATE  (POST /students, PATCH /students/:_id)
  //    returns { ok, fieldErrors?, message? } so FullForm can show inline errors
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleSave = async (formData, extra = {}) => {
    if (isEdit ? !canManageStudent(currentUser, detailData) : !canCreateStudent(currentUser)) {
      showToast("আপনার ডাটা অ্যাড বা এডিট করার অনুমতি নেই", "error");
      return { ok: false };
    }

    // রোল ডুপ্লিকেট চেক (সেশন + ক্লাস + রোল) — সার্ভারও আবার যাচাই করে
    const exists = students.find(s =>
      s.ClassBn === formData.classBn &&
      String(s.Session) === String(formData.sessionYear) &&
      String(s.Roll) === String(formData.roll) &&
      s.ID !== (isEdit ? detailData.ID : null) &&
      s.Status !== 'Deleted'
    );
    if (exists) {
      showToast("এই ক্লাসে এই রোল নম্বর আগে থেকেই আছে!", "error");
      return { ok: false, fieldErrors: [{ field: 'roll', message: `'${exists.StudentNameBn}'-এর রোল ইতিমধ্যে ${formData.roll}` }] };
    }

    if (currentUser.role === "Class" && formData.classBn !== currentUser.classBn) {
      alert("আপনি শুধু নিজের ক্লাসে ডাটা দিতে পারবেন");
      return { ok: false };
    }

    setProcessing(true);

    try {
      let imgUrl = formData.imageUrl || DEFAULT_IMAGE;
      let publicId;

      // নতুন ছবি (data URL) হলে ক্লাউডিনারিতে আপলোড, তারপর সার্ভারে সেভ
      if (imgUrl && imgUrl.startsWith('data:')) {
        const up = await uploadSquarePhotoToCloudinary(imgUrl, { publicId: `student_${Date.now()}` });
        imgUrl = up.url;
        publicId = up.publicId;
      }

      const payload = toServerPayload(formData, {
        isUpdate: isEdit,
        imageUrl: imgUrl,
        publicId,
        migration: extra.migration || null
      });

      const result = isEdit
        ? await studentApi.update(detailData._id, payload)
        : await studentApi.create(payload);

      if (!isEdit) {
        localStorage.removeItem("draftStudentForm");
      }
      await loadData(false);
      setTab('home');
      setDetailData(null);
      setIsEdit(false);
      showToast(result.message || "সফল হয়েছে", "success");
      return { ok: true };
    } catch (error) {
      const fieldErrors = extractFieldErrors(error);
      if (error?.response?.status === 401) {
        clearAuthSessionStorage();
        setCurrentUser(null);
      }
      showToast(extractApiErrorMessage(error, "Save failed"), "error");
      return { ok: false, fieldErrors };
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 4. SOFT DELETE  (DELETE /students/:_id)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleDelete = async (id) => {
    const target = students.find(s => s.ID === id) || detailData;
    if (!canManageStudent(currentUser, target)) {
      showToast("আপনার এই ডাটা ডিলিট করার অনুমতি নেই", "error");
      return;
    }

    if (!window.confirm("আপনি কি নিশ্চিত এই ডাটা ডিলিট করতে চান?")) return;

    setProcessing(true);
    try {
      const result = await studentApi.remove(target._id, 'পোর্টাল থেকে ডিলিট করা হয়েছে');
      setStudents(prev => prev.filter(s => s.ID !== id));
      setDetailData(null);
      showToast(result.message || "ডিলিট সফল হয়েছে", "success");
      loadData(false);
    } catch (error) {
      showToast(extractApiErrorMessage(error, "ডিলিট করা যায়নি"), "error");
    } finally {
      setProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 5. SIBLINGS + FILTER / SORT (verbatim original logic)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  const siblingsOfDetail = useMemo(
    () => findSiblings(roleFilteredStudents, detailData),
    [detailData, roleFilteredStudents]
  );

  const filteredList = useMemo(() => {
  // যদি অ্যাডভান্সড ফিল্টার করা থাকে, তবে সেটি নেবে, নাহলে রেগুলার ডাটা
  let list = advancedFilteredData !== null ? advancedFilteredData : roleFilteredStudents;
  
  // SEARCH FILTER
if (searchText) {
  const lower = searchText.toLowerCase();
  list = list.filter(s =>
    (s.StudentNameBn && s.StudentNameBn.toLowerCase().includes(lower)) ||
    (s.StudentNameEn && s.StudentNameEn.toLowerCase().includes(lower)) ||
    (s.ID && s.ID.toString().includes(lower)) ||
    (s.Roll && s.Roll.toString().includes(lower)) ||
    (s.WhatsApp && s.WhatsApp.includes(lower))
  );
}

  // শুধু Admin এর জন্য Class filter
  // সবার জন্যই Class filter কাজ করবে
  if (classFilter !== 'All') {
    list = list.filter(s => s.ClassBn === classFilter);
  }



  const { field, order } = sortConfig;
   if (field === 'family') {

  const clean = (name) =>
    (name || '')
      .replace(/মোঃ|মো\.?|মোহাম্মদ|মুহাম্মদ|md\.?|MD\.?/gi,'')
      .replace(/\s+/g,' ')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  const result = [];
  const familyKey = {};

  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {

    for (let j = i + 1; j < list.length; j++) {

      const a = list[i];
      const b = list[j];

      let score = 0;

      const fatherA = clean(a.FatherNameBn);
      const fatherB = clean(b.FatherNameBn);

      const motherA = clean(a.MotherNameBn);
      const motherB = clean(b.MotherNameBn);

      const phoneA = (a.WhatsApp || '').trim();
      const phoneB = (b.WhatsApp || '').trim();

      if (fatherA && fatherA === fatherB) score++;
      if (motherA && motherA === motherB) score++;
      if (phoneA && phoneA === phoneB) score++;

      if (score >= 2) {

        result.push(a);
        result.push(b);

        const key =
          fatherA || motherA || phoneA;

        familyKey[a.ID] = key;
        familyKey[b.ID] = key;
      }

    }
  }

  // duplicate remove
  list = result.filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) === i);

  // siblings together
  list.sort((a, b) => {
    const ka = familyKey[a.ID] || '';
    const kb = familyKey[b.ID] || '';
    return ka.localeCompare(kb);
  });

}
  if (field === 'name') {
    list = [...list].sort((a, b) =>
      order === 'asc'
        ? a.StudentNameEn.localeCompare(b.StudentNameEn)
        : b.StudentNameEn.localeCompare(a.StudentNameEn)
    );
  }

  if (field === 'roll') {
    list = [...list].sort((a, b) =>
      order === 'asc' ? a.Roll - b.Roll : b.Roll - a.Roll
    );
  }

 if (field === 'class') {
  list = [...list].sort((a, b) => {
    const classDiff =
      order === 'asc'
        ? (CLASS_ORDER[a.ClassBn] || 0) -
          (CLASS_ORDER[b.ClassBn] || 0)
        : (CLASS_ORDER[b.ClassBn] || 0) -
          (CLASS_ORDER[a.ClassBn] || 0);

    // যদি class আলাদা হয়
    if (classDiff !== 0) return classDiff;

    // class same হলে সবসময় roll ascending
    return (a.Roll || 0) - (b.Roll || 0);
  });
  }

  if (field === 'time') {
    list = [...list].sort((a, b) =>
      order === 'asc'
        ? new Date(a.Time) - new Date(b.Time)
        : new Date(b.Time) - new Date(a.Time)
    );
  }
   if (field === 'dob') {
    list = [...list].sort((a, b) => {
      const dA = getDaysUntilBirthday(a.DOB);
      const dB = getDaysUntilBirthday(b.DOB);
      if (dA === null && dB === null) return 0;
      if (dA === null) return 1;   // DOB না থাকলে নিচে
      if (dB === null) return -1;
      return dA - dB; // আজ (0) সবার আগে, তারপর কাল (1), তারপর ক্রমান্বয়ে
    });
  }
  return list;
}, [roleFilteredStudents, searchText, sortConfig, classFilter, currentUser, advancedFilteredData]); // <--- এখানে classFilter হবে

  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  // 6. EXPORTS (templates are verbatim — see exportController.js)
  // ------------------------------------------------------------------
  const exportsApi = createExportController({ filteredList, currentUser, showToast, setContactProgress });

  return {
    // auth
    currentUser, authLoading, login, handleLogout,
    // data
    students, loading, processing, isSyncing, loadData,
    // ui state
    tab, setTab, detailData, setDetailData, isEdit, setIsEdit,
    searchText, setSearchText, classFilter, setClassFilter, sortConfig, setSortConfig,
    isFilterOpen, setIsFilterOpen, advancedFilteredData, setAdvancedFilteredData,
    isPdfModalOpen, setIsPdfModalOpen, showAllExports, setShowAllExports,
    viewerImg, setViewerImg, scrollPos, setScrollPos,
    toast, setToast, showToast, contactProgress,
    // derived
    filteredList, siblingsOfDetail,
    // crud
    handleSave, handleDelete,
    // exports
    ...exportsApi
  };
}

/**
 * ARDM Student Portal — Student Model (MongoDB <-> original UI adapter)
 * Server docs use fullNameBng / studentCode / ... ; the original UI (DetailView, exports,
 * filters, ID cards) uses StudentNameBn / ID / ... — this file converts both ways.
 */
import { CLASS_ORDER } from '../config/systemConfig';

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
// Original helpers (verbatim)
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
export const getDaysUntilBirthday = (dobStr) => {
  if (!dobStr) return null;
  const dob = new Date(dobStr);
  if (isNaN(dob.getTime())) return null;

  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  let next = new Date(today.getFullYear(), dob.getMonth(), dob.getDate());
  next.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  if (next < today) {
    next = new Date(today.getFullYear() + 1, dob.getMonth(), dob.getDate());
  }

  return Math.round((next - today) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
};
export const formatDate = (dateStr) => {
  if (!dateStr) return 'N/A';

  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return dateStr;

  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    year: 'numeric'
  });
};

export const REGEX = {
  BANGLA: /^[\u0980-\u09FF\s.]+$/,
  ENGLISH: /^[a-zA-Z\s.]+$/,
  MOBILE: /^01[3-9]\d{8}$/,
  NUMBER: /^\d+$/
};

export const toISODate = (dStr) => {
  if (!dStr) return '';
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dStr)) return dStr;
  const d = new Date(dStr);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
// Class name normalisation
// Server stores "২য়"/"৩য়" with য + ় (U+09AF U+09BC); the original UI uses the
// single character য় (U+09DF). UI form is canonical inside the client.
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
export const toUiClass = (s) => String(s || '').replace(/\u09AF\u09BC/g, '\u09DF');
export const toServerClass = (s) => String(s || '').replace(/\u09DF/g, '\u09AF\u09BC');

export const CLASS_LIST_BN = ['প্লে', 'নার্সারি', 'কেজি', '১ম', '২য়', '৩য়', '৪র্থ', '৫ম', '৬ষ্ঠ', '৭ম', '৮ম', '৯ম', '১০ম'];

export const CLASS_EN_MAP = {
  'প্লে': 'Play', 'নার্সারি': 'Nursery', 'কেজি': 'KG',
  '১ম': 'One', '২য়': 'Two', '৩য়': 'Three', '৪র্থ': 'Four', '৫ম': 'Five',
  '৬ষ্ঠ': 'Six', '৭ম': 'Seven', '৮ম': 'Eight', '৯ম': 'Nine', '১০ম': 'Ten'
};

export const CLASS_CODE_MAP = {
  'প্লে': '99', 'নার্সারি': '00', 'কেজি': '98',
  '১ম': '01', '২য়': '02', '৩য়': '03', '৪র্থ': '04', '৫ম': '05',
  '৬ষ্ঠ': '06', '৭ম': '07', '৮ম': '08', '৯ম': '09', '১০ম': '10'
};

export const isSeniorClass = (classBn) => ['৯ম', '১০ম'].includes(toUiClass(classBn));

// Server -> UI

const dateOnly = (v) => {
  if (!v) return '';
  const s = String(v);
  return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(s) ? s.slice(0, 10) : s;
};

export const toUiStudent = (doc) => {
  if (!doc) return null;
  const addr = doc.presentAddress || {};
  return {
    _id: doc._id,
    ID: doc.studentCode,
    Time: doc.createdAt || doc.admissionDate || '',
    Session: doc.session || '',
    StudentNameBn: doc.fullNameBng || '',
    StudentNameEn: doc.fullNameEng || '',
    Roll: doc.roll,
    ClassBn: toUiClass(doc.classBn),
    ClassEn: doc.classEn || CLASS_EN_MAP[toUiClass(doc.classBn)] || '',
    Group: doc.group || '',
    Gender: doc.gender || '',
    BRN: doc.brnNumber || '',
    DOB: dateOnly(doc.dateOfBirth),
    BloodGroup: doc.bloodGroup && doc.bloodGroup !== 'N/A' ? doc.bloodGroup : '',
    FatherNameBn: doc.fathersNameBng || '',
    FatherNameEn: doc.fathersNameEng || '',
    MotherNameBn: doc.mothersNameBng || '',
    MotherNameEn: doc.mothersNameEng || '',
    WhatsApp: doc.phone || '',
    EmergencyNo: doc.emergencyContact?.phone || '',
    HouseNameBn: addr.houseNameBn || '',
    HouseNameEn: addr.houseNameEn || '',
    VillageBn: addr.villageBn || '',
    VillageEn: addr.villageEn || '',
    UnionBn: addr.unionBn || '',
    UnionEn: addr.unionEn || '',
    WardNo: addr.wardNo || '',
    UpazilaBn: addr.upazilaBn || '',
    UpazilaEn: addr.upazilaEn || '',
    DistrictBn: addr.districtBn || '',
    DistrictEn: addr.districtEn || '',
    ImageURL: doc.profilePicture?.url || '',
    Status: doc.status || 'Active',
    LastUpdated: doc.updatedAt ? new Date(doc.updatedAt).toLocaleString() : ''
  };
};

export const toUiStudents = (docs) => (Array.isArray(docs) ? docs.map(toUiStudent) : []);

// UI form -> Server payload (only fields the strict server schema knows)
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
const clean = (v) => String(v ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

export const buildAddress = (f) => ({
  houseNameBn: clean(f.houseNameBn),
  houseNameEn: clean(f.houseNameEn),
  villageBn: clean(f.villageBn),
  villageEn: clean(f.villageEn),
  unionBn: clean(f.unionBn),
  unionEn: clean(f.unionEn),
  wardNo: clean(f.wardNo),
  upazilaBn: clean(f.upazilaBn),
  upazilaEn: clean(f.upazilaEn),
  districtBn: clean(f.districtBn),
  districtEn: clean(f.districtEn),
  ...(f.divisionBn ? { divisionBn: clean(f.divisionBn) } : {}),
  ...(f.divisionEn ? { divisionEn: clean(f.divisionEn) } : {})
});

export const toServerPayload = (form, { isUpdate = false, imageUrl, publicId, migration = null } = {}) => {
  const classBn = toUiClass(form.classBn);
  const payload = {
    session: clean(form.sessionYear),
    fullNameBng: clean(form.studentNameBn),
    fullNameEng: clean(form.studentNameEn),
    gender: form.gender,
    classBn: toServerClass(classBn),
    classEn: CLASS_EN_MAP[classBn],
    roll: Number(form.roll),
    group: isSeniorClass(classBn) ? form.group || '' : '',
    brnNumber: clean(form.brn),
    dateOfBirth: form.dob,
    bloodGroup: form.bloodGroup || 'N/A',
    fathersNameBng: clean(form.fatherNameBn),
    fathersNameEng: clean(form.fatherNameEn),
    mothersNameBng: clean(form.motherNameBn),
    mothersNameEng: clean(form.motherNameEn),
    phone: clean(form.whatsappNumber),
    emergencyContact: {
      contactName: clean(form.fatherNameBn),
      relationship: 'Father',
      phone: clean(form.emergencyNumber)
    },
    presentAddress: buildAddress(form),
    profilePicture: { url: imageUrl, ...(publicId ? { publicId } : {}) }
  };

  if (!isUpdate) {
    // নতুন ভর্তিতে ১০ ডিজিটের আইডি সার্ভার নিজেই বানায় (একই অ্যালগরিদম)।
    // শিট থেকে মাইগ্রেশনে পুরনো আইডি অবিকৃত রাখা হয়।
    if (migration?.studentCode) {
      payload.studentCode = migration.studentCode;
      payload.migratedFromSheet = true;
      if (migration.admissionDate) payload.admissionDate = migration.admissionDate;
    }
  }
  return payload;
};

export const generateStudentId = (sessionYear, dob, classBn, roll) => {
  if (!sessionYear || !dob || !classBn || !roll) return '';
  const dobYear = new Date(dob).getFullYear().toString().slice(-2);
  const classCode = CLASS_CODE_MAP[toUiClass(classBn)] || '00';
  const rollCode = String(roll).padStart(2, '0').slice(-2);
  return `${sessionYear}${dobYear}${classCode}${rollCode}`;
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sibling detection (verbatim logic from original Index)
// ------------------------------------------------------------------
export const cleanFamilyName = (name) =>
  (name || '')
    .replace(/মোঃ|মো\.?|মোহাম্মদ|মুহাম্মদ|md\.?|MD\.?/gi, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();

export const findSiblings = (list, detailData) => {
  if (!detailData) return [];

  const father = cleanFamilyName(detailData.FatherNameBn);
  const mother = cleanFamilyName(detailData.MotherNameBn);
  const phone = (detailData.WhatsApp || '').trim();

  return list
    .filter(s => {
      if (s.ID === detailData.ID) return false;
      let score = 0;
      if (father && cleanFamilyName(s.FatherNameBn) === father) score++;
      if (mother && cleanFamilyName(s.MotherNameBn) === mother) score++;
      if (phone && (s.WhatsApp || '').trim() === phone) score++;
      return score >= 2;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => {
      // বড় থেকে ছোট (জন্ম তারিখ অনুযায়ী), DOB না থাকলে ক্লাস অনুযায়ী
      const da = a.DOB ? new Date(a.DOB) : null;
      const db = b.DOB ? new Date(b.DOB) : null;
      if (da && db) return da - db;
      return (CLASS_ORDER[b.ClassBn] || 0) - (CLASS_ORDER[a.ClassBn] || 0);
    });
};

// Auth user (ERP) -> legacy UI user shape used by the original views
//   SuperAdmin/Admin -> role "Admin"      Teacher -> role "Class"

export const toUiUser = (user) => {
  if (!user) return null;
  const isAdmin = user.role === 'SuperAdmin' || user.role === 'Admin';
  const classBn = toUiClass(user.assignedClass);
  return {
    ...user,
    role: isAdmin ? 'Admin' : 'Class',
    erpRole: user.role,
    classBn,
    classEn: CLASS_EN_MAP[classBn] || '',
    canEditAssignedClass: user.canEditAssignedClass === true,
    displayName: user.fullNameEng || user.fullNameBng || user.name || user.teacherCode || ''
  };
};

// RBAC (spec §4)
export const canManageStudent = (uiUser, student) => {
  if (!uiUser) return false;
  if (uiUser.role === 'Admin') return true;
  return (
    uiUser.role === 'Class' &&
    uiUser.canEditAssignedClass === true &&
    !!uiUser.classBn &&
    (!student || student.ClassBn === uiUser.classBn)
  );
};

export const canCreateStudent = (uiUser) =>
  !!uiUser && (uiUser.role === 'Admin' || (uiUser.role === 'Class' && uiUser.canEditAssignedClass === true && !!uiUser.classBn));

  ['presentAddress.wardNo', 'wardNo', 3],
  ['presentAddress.upazilaBn', 'upazilaBn', 3], ['presentAddress.upazilaEn', 'upazilaEn', 3],
  ['presentAddress.districtBn', 'districtBn', 3], ['presentAddress.districtEn', 'districtEn', 3],
  ['profilePicture.url', 'imageUrl', 4], ['profilePicture', 'imageUrl', 4]
];
const SERVER_FIELD_MAP = Object.fromEntries(FIELD_ROWS.map(([s, f, step]) => [s, { field: f, step }]));

export const mapServerFieldErrors = (fieldErrors = []) => {
  const errors = {};
  let firstStep = null;
  const unmapped = [];
  fieldErrors.forEach(({ field, message }) => {
    const hit = SERVER_FIELD_MAP[field] || SERVER_FIELD_MAP[String(field || '').replace(/\.\d+/g, '')];
    if (!hit) { unmapped.push(message); return; }
    if (!errors[hit.field]) errors[hit.field] = message;
    if (firstStep === null || hit.step < firstStep) firstStep = hit.step;
  });
  return { errors, firstStep, unmapped };
};

/**
 * Server validation error helpers.
 * Server shape (error.middleware.js): { success:false, message, errors:[{ field, message }] }
 */
export function extractFieldErrors(error) {
    const list = error?.response?.data?.errors;
    if (!Array.isArray(list)) return [];
    return list
        .filter((e) => e && (e.field || e.path))
        .map((e) => ({ field: e.field || e.path, message: e.message || e.msg || 'তথ্য সঠিক নয়' }));
}

export function isValidationError(error) {
    const status = error?.response?.status;
    return status === 400 || status === 409 || status === 404;
}

/**
 * ARDM Student Portal — Shared ERP Axios Client
 * Mirrors D:\ardm_teacher\client\src\api\axiosClient.js so that the JWT session
 * (localStorage keys below) is shared seamlessly with the Teacher ERP client.
 */
import axios from 'axios';
import {
    API_BASE_URL,
    TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY,
    USER_STORAGE_KEY
} from '../config/systemConfig';

export { API_BASE_URL, TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY, USER_STORAGE_KEY };

export function getStoredAuthToken() {
    try { return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY); } catch (e) { return null; }
}

export function getStoredAuthUser() {
    try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_STORAGE_KEY);
        return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    } catch (e) { return null; }
}

export function setAuthSessionStorage(token, user) {
    try {
        if (token) localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY, token);
        if (user) localStorage.setItem(USER_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
    } catch (e) {}
}

export function clearAuthSessionStorage() {
    try {
        localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY);
        localStorage.removeItem(USER_STORAGE_KEY);
    } catch (e) {}
}

export function extractApiErrorMessage(error, fallbackMessage = 'সার্ভারের সাথে সংযোগে সমস্যা হয়েছে।') {
    if (!error) return fallbackMessage;
    const data = error?.response?.data;
    if (data?.message || (Array.isArray(data?.errors) && data.errors.length > 0)) {
        const details = Array.isArray(data.errors)
            ? data.errors.map((item) => item.message || item.msg).filter(Boolean)
            : [];
        return [data.message, ...details.filter((detail) => detail !== data.message)]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join(' ');
    }
    if (error.code === 'ECONNABORTED') {
        return 'সার্ভার থেকে উত্তর পেতে দেরি হচ্ছে। কিছুক্ষণ পরে আবার চেষ্টা করুন।';
    }
    if (error.request || error.code === 'ERR_NETWORK') {
        return 'সার্ভারের সঙ্গে সংযোগ করা যাচ্ছে না। ইন্টারনেট বা সার্ভার চালু আছে কি না যাচাই করুন।';
    }
    if (!error.isAxiosError && error.message) return error.message;
    return fallbackMessage;
}

const axiosClient = axios.create({
    baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
    timeout: 15000,
    withCredentials: true,
    headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Accept: 'application/json'
    }
});

axiosClient.interceptors.request.use(
    (config) => {
        const token = getStoredAuthToken();
        if (token && token !== 'ardm_dev_session_token') {
            config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
        }
        return config;
    },
    (error) => Promise.reject(error)
);

axiosClient.interceptors.response.use(
    (response) => response,
    (error) => Promise.reject(error)
);

// /auth/me একসাথে একাধিকবার কল হলে একটাই রিকোয়েস্ট যাবে (teacher client-এর মতোই)
let __authMeCache = null;
const __origGet = axiosClient.get.bind(axiosClient);

axiosClient.get = function (url, config) {
    if (typeof url === 'string' && url.includes('/auth/me')) {
        const token = getStoredAuthToken();
        if (__authMeCache?.token === token) {
            return __authMeCache.promise;
        }
        const cacheEntry = { token, promise: null };
        cacheEntry.promise = __origGet(url, config).finally(() => {
            if (__authMeCache === cacheEntry) {
                __authMeCache = null;
            }
        });
        __authMeCache = cacheEntry;
        return cacheEntry.promise;
    }
    return __origGet(url, config);
};

export async function checkBackendHealth() {
    try {
        const start = performance.now();
        await axiosClient.get('/system/settings', { timeout: 4000 });
        return { isOnline: true, status: 'connected', latencyMs: Math.round(performance.now() - start) };
    } catch (err) {
        if (err?.response) return { isOnline: true, status: 'connected', latencyMs: 10 };
        return { isOnline: false, status: 'disconnected', latencyMs: null };
    }
}

export default axiosClient;

const BD_API_BASE_URL = 'https://bdapis.pro.bd/geo/v2.0';

async function fetchAddressData(path, signal) {
    let response;
    try {
        response = await fetch(`${BD_API_BASE_URL}${path}`, {
            headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
            signal
        });
    } catch (error) {
        if (error.name === 'AbortError') throw error;
        throw new Error('BD APIs-এ সংযোগ করা যায়নি। ইন্টারনেট সংযোগ যাচাই করে আবার চেষ্টা করুন।');
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`BD APIs থেকে ঠিকানার তথ্য লোড করা যায়নি (${response.status})।`);
    }

    let payload;
    try {
        payload = await response.json();
    } catch {
        throw new Error('BD APIs-এর response পড়া যায়নি। পরে আবার চেষ্টা করুন।');
    }

    if (!payload || payload.success !== true || !Array.isArray(payload.data)) {
        throw new Error(payload?.message || 'BD APIs থেকে অপ্রত্যাশিত ঠিকানার তথ্য পাওয়া গেছে।');
    }

    return payload.data
        .filter((item) => item?.id != null && item?.name && item?.bn_name)
        .map((item) => ({
            id: String(item.id),
            nameEn: item.name,
            nameBn: item.bn_name
        }));
}

function requireLocationId(id) {
    const value = String(id ?? '').trim();
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(value)) {
        throw new Error('ঠিকানার তালিকা লোড করতে একটি বৈধ এলাকা নির্বাচন করুন।');
    }
    return encodeURIComponent(value);
}

export function fetchDivisions(signal) {
    return fetchAddressData('/divisions', signal);
}

export function fetchDistricts(divisionId, signal) {
    return fetchAddressData(`/districts/${requireLocationId(divisionId)}`, signal);
}

export function fetchUpazilas(districtId, signal) {
    return fetchAddressData(`/upazilas/${requireLocationId(districtId)}`, signal);
}

export function fetchUnions(upazilaId, signal) {
    return fetchAddressData(`/unions/${requireLocationId(upazilaId)}`, signal);
}

/**
 * ARDM Student Portal — Client-side 500x500 square image processor & Cloudinary uploader.
 * Mirrors D:\ardm_teacher\client\src\api\cloudinaryClient.js (cloud "djjnoclzp", preset "student_db"),
 * with student-specific defaults (folder + file names) and an optional `squareTolerance`
 * that keeps the original student form rule: non-square photos are rejected, not cropped.
 */
import axios from 'axios';

const CLOUD_NAME = import.meta.env.VITE_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME || 'djjnoclzp';
const UPLOAD_PRESET = import.meta.env.VITE_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET || 'student_db';
const DEFAULT_FOLDER = import.meta.env.VITE_CLOUDINARY_STUDENT_FOLDER || 'ardm/students';

/**
 * ছবিকে ৫০০×৫০০ স্কয়ার JPEG-এ রূপান্তর (Canvas)।
 * options: { targetSize = 500, quality = 0.92, enforceStrictSquareInput = false, squareTolerance = null }
 *  - squareTolerance: সংখ্যা দিলে |width - height| তার চেয়ে বেশি হলে ছবি বাতিল (মূল ফর্মে ২০)
 */
export function processImageToSquare500(file, options = {}) {
    const {
        targetSize = 500,
        quality = 0.92,
        enforceStrictSquareInput = false,
        squareTolerance = null
    } = options;

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        if (!file) return reject(new Error('কোনো ছবির ফাইল নির্বাচন করা হয়নি।'));

        if (!/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/i.test(file.type)) {
            return reject(new Error('শুধুমাত্র JPG, PNG অথবা WEBP ফরম্যাটের ছবি গ্রহণযোগ্য।'));
        }
        if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
            return reject(new Error('ছবির সাইজ সর্বোচ্চ ১০ মেগাবাইট (10MB) হতে পারবে।'));
        }

        const reader = new FileReader();

        reader.onload = (event) => {
            const img = new Image();

            img.onload = () => {
                const origW = img.naturalWidth || img.width;
                const origH = img.naturalHeight || img.height;

                if (origW < 150 || origH < 150) {
                    return reject(new Error(`ছবির রেজোলিউশন অত্যন্ত কম (${origW}×${origH})। কমপক্ষে 300×300 পিক্সেলের স্পষ্ট ছবি দিন।`));
                }
                if (enforceStrictSquareInput && origW !== origH) {
                    return reject(new Error(`ছবিটি বর্গাকার (Square) নয় (${origW}×${origH})। প্রস্থ এবং উচ্চতা সমান হতে হবে।`));
                }
                if (typeof squareTolerance === 'number' && Math.abs(origW - origH) > squareTolerance) {
                    return reject(new Error('দুঃখিত! ছবিটি অবশ্যই স্কয়ার হতে হবে'));
                }

                const minSide = Math.min(origW, origH);
                const cropX = Math.floor((origW - minSide) / 2);
                const cropY = Math.floor((origH - minSide) / 2);

                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                canvas.width = targetSize;
                canvas.height = targetSize;

                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, targetSize, targetSize);
                ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
                ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
                ctx.drawImage(img, cropX, cropY, minSide, minSide, 0, 0, targetSize, targetSize);

                const previewDataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);

                canvas.toBlob(
                    (blob) => {
                        if (!blob) {
                            return reject(new Error('ছবি প্রসেস করতে সমস্যা হয়েছে। অন্য একটি ছবি দিয়ে চেষ্টা করুন।'));
                        }
                        const processedFile = new File([blob], 'student_photo_500x500.jpg', {
                            type: 'image/jpeg',
                            lastModified: Date.now()
                        });
                        resolve({
                            blob,
                            file: processedFile,
                            dataUrl: previewDataUrl,
                            originalWidth: origW,
                            originalHeight: origH,
                            wasAutoCropped: origW !== origH,
                            outputWidth: targetSize,
                            outputHeight: targetSize,
                            sizeKB: Math.round(blob.size / 1024)
                        });
                    },
                    'image/jpeg',
                    quality
                );
            };

            img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('ছবির ফাইলটি পড়া যাচ্ছে না বা ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হয়েছে।'));
            img.src = event.target.result;
        };

        reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('ফাইল রিড করতে ব্রাউজারে সমস্যা হয়েছে।'));
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
}

/**
 * ক্লাউডিনারিতে সরাসরি আপলোড (প্রোগ্রেস কলব্যাকসহ)।
 * imageBlob: Blob/File অথবা data:image/... URL string (500×500 প্রসেস করা)
 */
export async function uploadSquarePhotoToCloudinary(imageBlob, options = {}) {
    const {
        publicId = `student_${Date.now()}`,
        folder = DEFAULT_FOLDER,
        onProgress = null
    } = options;

    if (!imageBlob) throw new Error('আপলোড করার জন্য কোনো ছবি পাওয়া যায়নি।');

    const formData = new FormData();
    if (typeof imageBlob === 'string') {
        formData.append('file', imageBlob);
    } else {
        formData.append('file', imageBlob, `${publicId}.jpg`);
    }
    formData.append('upload_preset', UPLOAD_PRESET);
    formData.append('folder', folder);
    if (publicId) formData.append('public_id', String(publicId));

    const uploadUrl = `https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/${CLOUD_NAME}/image/upload`;

    try {
        const response = await axios.post(uploadUrl, formData, {
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
            timeout: 45000,
            onUploadProgress: (progressEvent) => {
                if (typeof onProgress === 'function' && progressEvent.total) {
                    onProgress(Math.round((progressEvent.loaded * 100) / progressEvent.total));
                }
            }
        });

        return {
            success: true,
            url: response.data.secure_url,
            publicId: response.data.public_id,
            width: response.data.width,
            height: response.data.height,
            format: response.data.format,
            bytes: response.data.bytes
        };
    } catch (err) {
        const errMsg = err.response?.data?.error?.message || 'ক্লাউডিনারিতে ছবি আপলোড ব্যর্থ হয়েছে। ইন্টারনেট সংযোগ যাচাই করুন।';
        throw new Error(errMsg);
    }
}

/**
 * ARDM Student Portal — API Service (Centralized ERP backend)
 * Endpoints: /auth/login, /auth/me, /auth/logout, /students, /students/:id,
 *            /students/public/verify/:studentCode, /students/metadata, /students/legacy-lookup/:code
 * Returns RAW server documents. Conversion to the original UI field names
 * (ID, StudentNameBn, ...) is done in models/studentModel.js.
 */
import axiosClient, {
    clearAuthSessionStorage,
    setAuthSessionStorage
} from './axiosClient';
import { ALLOWED_ROLES } from '../config/systemConfig';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Portal access guard (spec §3): block Pending / inactive / other roles
// ---------------------------------------------------------------
export function assertPortalAccess(user) {
    if (!user || !(user._id || user.teacherCode)) {
        throw new Error('সার্ভার থেকে বৈধ ইউজার তথ্য পাওয়া যায়নি।');
    }
    if (user.registrationStatus === 'Pending') {
        throw new Error('আপনার রেজিস্ট্রেশন এখনও অনুমোদনের অপেক্ষায় আছে। অ্যাডমিনের সাথে যোগাযোগ করুন।');
    }
    if (user.registrationStatus === 'Rejected') {
        throw new Error('আপনার রেজিস্ট্রেশন বাতিল করা হয়েছে। অ্যাডমিনের সাথে যোগাযোগ করুন।');
    }
    if (user.isActive === false) {
        throw new Error('আপনার অ্যাকাউন্টটি নিষ্ক্রিয় করা হয়েছে।');
    }
    if (!ALLOWED_ROLES.includes(user.role)) {
        throw new Error('এই পোর্টালে প্রবেশের অনুমতি আপনার নেই।');
    }
    return true;
}

const unwrapUser = (res) =>
    res?.data?.data?.teacher || res?.data?.data?.user || res?.data?.data;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Auth
// ---------------------------------------------------------------
export const authApi = {
    /** POST /auth/login  { identifier, password } → { user, token } */
    async login(identifier, password) {
        const res = await axiosClient.post('/auth/login', {
            identifier: String(identifier || '').trim(),
            password: String(password || '').trim()
        });
        const body = res.data?.data || res.data || {};
        const token = body.token || body.accessToken;
        const user = body.teacher || body.user;
        if (!token || !user) {
            throw new Error('সার্ভার থেকে বৈধ লগইন সেশন পাওয়া যায়নি।');
        }
        assertPortalAccess(user); // সেশন সেভ করার আগেই ব্লক
        setAuthSessionStorage(token, user);
        return { user, token, message: res.data?.message };
    },

    /** GET /auth/me  (Bearer token) → user */
    async me() {
        const res = await axiosClient.get('/auth/me');
        const user = unwrapUser(res);
        assertPortalAccess(user);
        return user;
    },

    async logout() {
        try {
            await axiosClient.post('/auth/logout');
        } catch (e) {
            /* সার্ভার অফলাইন হলেও লোকাল সেশন মুছবে */
        } finally {
            clearAuthSessionStorage();
        }
    }
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Students

export const studentApi = {
    /** GET /students → raw Mongo docs (Deleted বাদে) */
    async list(params = {}) {
        const res = await axiosClient.get('/students', { params });
        return res.data?.data?.students || [];
    },

    /** GET /students/:id (ObjectId অথবা studentCode) → { student, siblings } */
    async getById(id) {
        const res = await axiosClient.get(`/students/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
        return res.data?.data || null;
    },

    /** POST /students */
    async create(payload) {
        const res = await axiosClient.post('/students', payload);
        return { student: res.data?.data, message: res.data?.message };
    },

    /** PATCH /students/:_id */
    async update(id, payload) {
        const res = await axiosClient.patch(`/students/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, payload);
        return { student: res.data?.data, message: res.data?.message };
    },

    /** DELETE /students/:_id  (soft delete → status = 'Deleted') */
    async remove(id, statusReason = '') {
        const res = await axiosClient.delete(`/students/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
            data: statusReason ? { statusReason } : {}
        });
        return { message: res.data?.message };
    },

    /** GET /students/public/verify/:studentCode  — লগইন ছাড়া (QR ভেরিফিকেশন) */
    async publicVerify(studentCode) {
        const res = await axiosClient.get(
            `/students/public/verify/${encodeURIComponent(studentCode)}`
        );
        return res.data?.data || null;
    },

    /** GET /students/metadata */
    async metadata() {
        const res = await axiosClient.get('/students/metadata');
        return res.data?.data || {};
    },

    /** GET /students/legacy-lookup/:studentCode  — পুরনো গুগল শিট থেকে মাইগ্রেশনের জন্য */
    async legacyLookup(studentCode) {
        const res = await axiosClient.get(
            `/students/legacy-lookup/${encodeURIComponent(studentCode)}`
        );
        return { ...(res.data?.data || {}), message: res.data?.message };
    }
};

export default studentApi;

    <div class="section">

    </div>`;

  const academic = section('Academic Information', 'একাডেমিক তথ্য', [

    row('Roll Number', data.Roll),
    row('Session', data.Session),
    row('Status', data.Status === 'Active' ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'),

    const dob = new Date(dobStr);
    if (isNaN(dob.getTime())) return '\u2014';
    const now = new Date();
    let age = now.getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear();
    const m = now.getMonth() - dob.getMonth();
    if (m < 0 || (m === 0 && now.getDate() < dob.getDate())) age--;
    return `${age}`;

// ---- Validation rules (mirror the server: validators/student.validator.js) ----
const RX = {
  BN_NAME: /^[\u0980-\u09FF][\u0980-\u09FF\s.'-]{1,59}$/,
  EN_NAME: /^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z\s.'-]{2,59}$/,
  MOBILE: /^01[3-9]\d{8}$/,
  BRN: /^\d{17}$/,
  BN_PLACE: /^[\u0980-\u09FF\s.'-]{2,80}$/,
  EN_PLACE: /^[A-Za-z\s.'-]{2,80}$/,
  BN_HOUSE: /^[\u0980-\u09FF0-9\s.,'-]{2,80}$/,
  EN_HOUSE: /^[A-Za-z0-9\s.,'-]{2,80}$/,
  WARD: /^\d{1,3}$/
};
const FAKE = [/^(\d)\1+$/, /^123456789/, /^987654321/, /^0123456789/];
const isFake = (v) => FAKE.some((r) => r.test(String(v)));
const collapse = (v) => String(v ?? '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

const FIELD_STEP = {

const FullForm = ({ initialData, currentUser, onSave, onCancel, showToast, isAdmin }) => {
  const isUpdate = !!initialData;
  const defaultState = {
    sessionYear: (() => {
      const now = new Date();
      const currentYear = now.getFullYear();
      const currentMonth = now.getMonth(); // 0 = January, 9 = October
      return (currentMonth >= 9 ? currentYear + 1 : currentYear).toString();
    })(),
    studentId: '',
    studentNameBn: '', studentNameEn: '', gender: '', roll: '', classBn: '', group: '', brn: '', dob: '', bloodGroup: '',
    fatherNameBn: '', motherNameBn: '', whatsappNumber: '', emergencyNumber: '',
    fatherNameEn: '', motherNameEn: '',
    houseNameBn: '', villageBn: 'মীরেরখীল', unionBn: 'সরফভাটা', wardNo: '', upazilaBn: 'রাঙ্গুনিয়া', districtBn: 'চট্টগ্রাম',
    imageUrl: '',
    villageEn: 'Mirerkhil',
    unionEn: 'Sarfbhata',
    upazilaEn: 'Rangunia',
    districtEn: 'Chattogram',
    houseNameEn: '',
    divisionBn: '', divisionEn: ''
  };

  const [form, setForm] = useState(defaultState);
  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  const [imgPreview, setImgPreview] = useState(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [migration, setMigration] = useState(null); // { studentCode, admissionDate }
  const [legacyId, setLegacyId] = useState('');
  const [legacyBusy, setLegacyBusy] = useState(false);
  const formRef = useRef(null);

  // ---- BD geo cascade (Division → District → Upazila → Union) ----
  const [geo, setGeo] = useState({ divisions: [], districts: [], upazilas: [], unions: [] });
  const [geoSel, setGeoSel] = useState({ division: '', district: '', upazila: '', union: '' });
  const [geoLoading, setGeoLoading] = useState('');
  const [geoError, setGeoError] = useState('');

  const geoFail = (e) => { if (e?.name !== 'AbortError') setGeoError(e.message || 'ঠিকানার তালিকা লোড করা যায়নি'); };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (step !== 3 || geo.divisions.length > 0) return undefined;
    const ac = new AbortController();
    setGeoLoading('division');
    fetchDivisions(ac.signal)
      .then((list) => { setGeo((g) => ({ ...g, divisions: list })); setGeoError(''); })
      .catch(geoFail)
      .finally(() => setGeoLoading(''));
    return () => ac.abort();
  }, [step]);

  const pickGeo = async (level, id) => {
    const order = ['division', 'district', 'upazila', 'union'];
    const keyOf = { division: 'divisions', district: 'districts', upazila: 'upazilas', union: 'unions' };
    const item = geo[keyOf[level]].find((x) => x.id === id);
    const idx = order.indexOf(level);

    // নিচের লেভেলগুলো রিসেট
    const resetSel = { ...geoSel, [level]: id };
    const resetGeo = { ...geo };
    order.slice(idx + 1).forEach((lv) => { resetSel[lv] = ''; resetGeo[keyOf[lv]] = []; });
    setGeoSel(resetSel);
    setGeo(resetGeo);

    if (!item) return;
    const fieldsOf = {
      division: ['divisionBn', 'divisionEn'],
      district: ['districtBn', 'districtEn'],
      upazila: ['upazilaBn', 'upazilaEn'],
      union: ['unionBn', 'unionEn']
    };
    const [bnKey, enKey] = fieldsOf[level];
    setForm((p) => ({ ...p, [bnKey]: item.nameBn, [enKey]: item.nameEn }));
    setErrors((p) => ({ ...p, [bnKey]: '', [enKey]: '' }));

    const next = order[idx + 1];
    if (!next) return;
    const fetcher = { district: fetchDistricts, upazila: fetchUpazilas, union: fetchUnions }[next];
    setGeoLoading(next);
    try {
      const list = await fetcher(id);
      setGeo((g) => ({ ...g, [keyOf[next]]: list }));
      setGeoError('');
    } catch (e) { geoFail(e); } finally { setGeoLoading(''); }
  };

  // ---- Draft (only for brand-new admission) ----
  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem("draftStudentForm");
    if (!initialData && saved) {
      try { setForm({ ...defaultState, ...JSON.parse(saved) }); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialData) {
      localStorage.setItem("draftStudentForm", JSON.stringify(form));
    }
  }, [form]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialData) {
      const parseDate = (dStr) => {
        if (!dStr) return '';

        // যদি already YYYY-MM-DD হয়
        if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dStr)) {
          return dStr;
        }

        // অন্য সব কিছুর জন্য safe parse
        const d = new Date(dStr);
        if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';

        // লোকাল ডেট বানিয়ে string
        const y = d.getFullYear();
        const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');

        return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
      };

      setForm({
        sessionYear: initialData.Session || '',
        studentId: initialData.ID || '',
        studentNameBn: initialData.StudentNameBn || '',
        studentNameEn: initialData.StudentNameEn || '',
        gender: initialData.Gender || '',
        roll: initialData.Roll || '',
        classBn: toUiClass(initialData.ClassBn || ''),
        group: initialData.Group || '',
        brn: initialData.BRN || '',
        dob: parseDate(initialData.DOB),
        bloodGroup: initialData.BloodGroup || '',
        fatherNameBn: initialData.FatherNameBn || '',
        fatherNameEn: initialData.FatherNameEn || '',
        motherNameBn: initialData.MotherNameBn || '',
        motherNameEn: initialData.MotherNameEn || '',
        whatsappNumber: initialData.WhatsApp || '',
        emergencyNumber: initialData.EmergencyNo || '',
        houseNameBn: initialData.HouseNameBn || '',
        houseNameEn: initialData.HouseNameEn || '',
        villageBn: initialData.VillageBn || '',
        villageEn: initialData.VillageEn || '',
        unionBn: initialData.UnionBn || '',
        unionEn: initialData.UnionEn || '',
        wardNo: initialData.WardNo || '',
        upazilaBn: initialData.UpazilaBn || '',
        upazilaEn: initialData.UpazilaEn || '',
        districtBn: initialData.DistrictBn || '',
        districtEn: initialData.DistrictEn || '',
        divisionBn: '', divisionEn: '',
        imageUrl: initialData.ImageURL || ''
      });
      setImgPreview(initialData.ImageURL || null);
    } else {
      setForm((f) => (f.studentNameBn || f.brn ? f : defaultState));
      setImgPreview(null);
    }
  }, [initialData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialData && currentUser?.role === "Class") {
      setForm(f => ({ ...f, classBn: currentUser.classBn }));
    }
  }, [initialData, currentUser]);

  // SMART ID GENERATION (same algorithm as server — server's ID is final)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialData && !migration && form.sessionYear && form.dob && form.classBn && form.roll) {
      try {
        const id = generateStudentId(form.sessionYear, form.dob, form.classBn, form.roll);
        setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, studentId: id }));
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }, [form.sessionYear, form.dob, form.classBn, form.roll, initialData, migration]);

  // গ্রুপ শুধু ৯ম/১০ম শ্রেণির জন্য — অন্য ক্লাসে নিজে থেকে ফাঁকা হবে
  useEffect(() => {
    if (form.classBn && !isSeniorClass(form.classBn) && form.group) {
      setForm((p) => ({ ...p, group: '' }));
    }
  }, [form.classBn]);

  // ---- field-level validation (live) ----
  const fieldError = (f, v, all = form) => {
    const val = collapse(v);
    switch (f) {
      case 'studentNameBn':
        if (!val) return 'নাম আবশ্যক';
        return RX.BN_NAME.test(val) ? '' : 'শুধু বাংলা (২-৬০ অক্ষর)';
      case 'studentNameEn':
        if (!val) return 'English name required';
        return RX.EN_NAME.test(val) ? '' : 'English only (3-60)';
      case 'fatherNameBn': case 'motherNameBn':
        if (!val) return f === 'fatherNameBn' ? 'পিতার নাম আবশ্যক' : 'মাতার নাম আবশ্যক';
        return RX.BN_NAME.test(val) ? '' : 'বাংলায় লিখুন (২-৬০ অক্ষর)';
      case 'fatherNameEn': case 'motherNameEn':
        if (!val) return f === 'fatherNameEn' ? 'Father name required' : 'Mother name required';
        return RX.EN_NAME.test(val) ? '' : 'English only (3-60)';
      case 'whatsappNumber': case 'emergencyNumber':
        if (!val) return f === 'whatsappNumber' ? 'Mobile number required' : 'Emergency number required';
        return RX.MOBILE.test(val) ? '' : 'Invalid mobile (01XXXXXXXXX)';
      case 'roll': {
        if (!val) return 'Roll required';
        const n = Number(val);
        return Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 500 ? '' : 'Roll must be 1-500';
      }
      case 'classBn': return val ? '' : 'Class required';
      case 'gender': return val ? '' : 'Gender required';
      case 'group':
        if (isSeniorClass(all.classBn) && !val) return 'গ্রুপ আবশ্যক (৯ম/১০ম)';
        return '';
      case 'brn':
        if (!val) return 'BRN required';
        if (!RX.BRN.test(val)) return '17 digit BRN';
        if (isFake(val)) return 'বৈধ BRN দিন';
        if (all.dob && String(new Date(all.dob).getFullYear()) !== val.slice(0, 4)) return 'BRN-এর প্রথম ৪ সংখ্যা জন্মসালের সাথে মিলছে না';
        return '';
      case 'dob': {
        if (!val) return 'Date of birth required';
        const d = new Date(val);
        if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return 'সঠিক তারিখ দিন';
        if (d > new Date()) return 'ভবিষ্যতের তারিখ হবে না';
        const age = (new Date() - d) / (365.25 * 24 * 3600 * 1000);
        return age < 2.5 || age > 22 ? 'Age must be 2.5-22' : '';
      }
      case 'sessionYear': return /^20\d{2}$/.test(val) ? '' : 'সঠিক সেশন (যেমন 2026)';
      case 'houseNameBn':
        if (!val) return 'বাড়ির নাম আবশ্যক';
        return RX.BN_HOUSE.test(val) ? '' : 'বাংলায় লিখুন (২-৮০ অক্ষর)';
      case 'houseNameEn':
        return RX.EN_HOUSE.test(val) ? '' : 'House Name English required';
      case 'villageBn': case 'unionBn': case 'upazilaBn': case 'districtBn': {
        const label = { villageBn: 'গ্রাম', unionBn: 'ইউনিয়ন', upazilaBn: 'উপজেলা', districtBn: 'জেলা' }[f];
        if (!val) return `${label} আবশ্যক`;
        return RX.BN_PLACE.test(val) ? '' : 'বাংলায় লিখুন (২-৮০ অক্ষর)';
      }
      case 'villageEn': case 'unionEn': case 'upazilaEn': case 'districtEn': {
        const label = { villageEn: 'Village', unionEn: 'Union', upazilaEn: 'Upazila', districtEn: 'District' }[f];
        return RX.EN_PLACE.test(val) ? '' : `${label} Name English required`;
      }
      case 'wardNo':
        if (!val) return 'Ward Number required';
        return RX.WARD.test(val) ? '' : 'Ward 1-999 (number only)';
      default: return '';
    }
  };

  const update = (f, v) => {
    if (f === "roll") {
      v = parseInt(v) || "";
      if (v > 500) v = 500;
    }
    if (f === "whatsappNumber" || f === "emergencyNumber") {
      v = String(v).replace(/[^0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 11); // শুধু সংখ্যা রাখবে
    }
    if (f === "brn") {
      v = String(v).replace(/[^0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 17);
    }
    if (f === "wardNo") {
      v = String(v).replace(/[^0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 3);
    }

    const next = { ...form, [f]: v };
    setForm(next);

    // লাইভ এরর (ডিপেন্ডেন্ট ফিল্ডসহ)
    const upd = { [f]: fieldError(f, v, next) };
    if (f === 'dob' && next.brn) upd.brn = fieldError('brn', next.brn, next);
    if (f === 'classBn') upd.group = fieldError('group', next.group, next);
    setErrors(prev => ({ ...prev, ...upd }));
  };

  // ---- step validation ----
  const stepFields = {
    1: ['sessionYear', 'studentNameBn', 'studentNameEn', 'roll', 'classBn', 'group', 'gender', 'brn', 'dob'],
    2: ['fatherNameBn', 'fatherNameEn', 'motherNameBn', 'motherNameEn', 'whatsappNumber', 'emergencyNumber'],
    3: ['houseNameBn', 'villageBn', 'unionBn', 'wardNo', 'upazilaBn', 'districtBn', 'houseNameEn', 'villageEn', 'unionEn', 'upazilaEn', 'districtEn'],
    4: []
  };

  const focusField = (name) => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const el = formRef.current?.querySelector(`[name="${name}"]`) || document.querySelector(`[name="${name}"]`);
      if (el) {
        el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        el.focus?.();
      }
    }, 60);
  };

  const validate = (targetStep = step) => {
    let e = {};
    (stepFields[targetStep] || []).forEach((f) => {
      const msg = fieldError(f, form[f]);
      if (msg) e[f] = msg;
    });
    if (Object.keys(e).length > 0) {
      focusField(Object.keys(e)[0]);
    }
    setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...e }));
    return Object.keys(e).length === 0;
  };

  const handleNext = () => { if (validate()) setStep(s => s + 1); };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    // সব ধাপ একসাথে যাচাই — প্রথম ভুল ধাপে ফিরে যাবে
    for (const s of [1, 2, 3]) {
      if (!validate(s)) { setStep(s); return; }
    }
    setSaving(true);
    const res = await onSave(form, { migration });
    setSaving(false);

    if (res && res.ok === false && res.fieldErrors?.length) {
      const { errors: srvErr, firstStep, unmapped } = mapServerFieldErrors(res.fieldErrors);
      if (Object.keys(srvErr).length) {
        setErrors((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...srvErr }));
        if (firstStep) setStep(firstStep);
        focusField(Object.keys(srvErr)[0]);
      }
      if (unmapped.length && showToast) showToast(unmapped[0], 'error');
    }
  };

  // ---- Photo: square check (tolerance 20px) → 500×500 JPEG ----
  const handleImage = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      const out = await processImageToSquare500(file, { squareTolerance: 20, quality: 0.85 });
      setImgPreview(out.dataUrl);
      update('imageUrl', out.dataUrl);
      setErrors((p) => ({ ...p, imageUrl: '' }));
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.message, "error");
      e.target.value = "";
    }
  };

  // ---- Migration from the old Google Sheet (admin, new admission only) ----
  const handleLegacyLookup = async () => {
    const code = legacyId.trim();
    if (!/^\d{10}$/.test(code)) return showToast('১০ ডিজিটের পুরনো স্টুডেন্ট আইডি দিন', 'error');
    setLegacyBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await studentApi.legacyLookup(code);
      if (res.alreadyMigrated) {
        showToast(`এই আইডি আগেই মাইগ্রেট হয়েছে (${res.existingStudent?.fullNameBng || code})`, 'error');
        return;
      }
      const f = legacyToFormState(res.autoFillData);
      setForm((p) => ({ ...defaultState, ...f, divisionBn: '', divisionEn: '' }));
      setImgPreview(f.imageUrl || null);
      setMigration({ studentCode: res.autoFillData.studentCode, admissionDate: res.autoFillData.admissionDate });
      setErrors({});
      showToast(res.message || 'পুরনো তথ্য পাওয়া গেছে — যাচাই করে সংরক্ষণ করুন', 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(extractApiErrorMessage(err, 'পুরনো শিট থেকে তথ্য আনা যায়নি'), 'error');
    } finally {
      setLegacyBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const classLocked = currentUser?.role === "Class";

  return (
    <div ref={formRef} className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 min-h-[70vh] flex flex-col">
      <div className="flex justify-between mb-8 px-2">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4].map(s => <div key={s} className={`h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${step >= s ? 'w-full bg-slate-900 mx-1' : 'w-full bg-gray-100 mx-1'}`} />)}
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1">
        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-right-8 duration-300">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">Step 1: Basic Info</h3>

            {!isUpdate && isAdmin && (
              <div className="p-4 bg-amber-50 rounded-xl border border-amber-100">
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">
                  {migration ? `পুরনো শিট থেকে আনা হয়েছে (ID: ${migration.studentCode})` : 'পুরনো শিট থেকে মাইগ্রেট (ঐচ্ছিক)'}
                </p>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <input
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    maxLength={10}
                    value={legacyId}
                    onChange={(e) => setLegacyId(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''))}
                    placeholder="পুরনো ১০ ডিজিটের আইডি"
                    className="flex-1 p-3 bg-white rounded-xl font-bold outline-none border border-amber-100 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-400 text-sm"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleLegacyLookup}
                    disabled={legacyBusy}
                    className="px-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold text-sm flex items-center gap-1 disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    {legacyBusy ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <Search size={16} />} আনুন
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <Input name="sessionYear" label="Session" type="number" val={form.sessionYear} set={v => update('sessionYear', v)} error={errors.sessionYear} />

            {/* STACKED INPUTS (One per line) */}
            <Input name="studentNameBn" label="নাম (বাংলা)" val={form.studentNameBn} set={v => update('studentNameBn', v)} error={errors.studentNameBn} />
            <Input name="studentNameEn" label="Name (English)" val={form.studentNameEn} set={v => update('studentNameEn', v)} error={errors.studentNameEn} />

            <Input name="roll" label="Roll" type="number" min="1" max="500" val={form.roll} set={v => update('roll', v)} error={errors.roll} />

            <div className="relative pt-1 w-full">
              <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase ml-1 block">Class</label>
              <select
                name="classBn"
                disabled={classLocked}
                className={`w-full p-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl font-bold outline-none border ${errors.classBn ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-transparent'} ${classLocked ? 'opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed bg-gray-200 text-gray-500' : ''}`}
                value={form.classBn}
                onChange={e => update('classBn', e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">Select...</option>
                {CLASS_LIST_BN.map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
              </select>
              {errors.classBn && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-xs font-bold mt-1">
                  {errors.classBn}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>

            {isSeniorClass(form.classBn) && (
              <div className="relative pt-1 w-full">
                <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase ml-1 block">Group</label>
                <select
                  name="group"
                  className={`w-full p-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl font-bold outline-none border ${errors.group ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-transparent'}`}
                  value={form.group}
                  onChange={e => update('group', e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="">Select...</option>
                  <option value="General">General</option>
                  <option value="Science">Science</option>
                  <option value="Muzabbid">Muzabbid</option>
                </select>
                {errors.group && (
                  <p className="text-red-500 text-xs font-bold mt-1">{errors.group}</p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="relative pt-1 w-full">
              <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase ml-1 block">
                Gender
              </label>
              <select
                name="gender"
                className={`w-full p-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl font-bold outline-none border 
      ${errors.gender ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-transparent'}`}
                value={form.gender}
                onChange={e => update('gender', e.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">Select...</option>
                <option value="Male">Male</option>
                <option value="Female">Female</option>
              </select>
              {errors.gender && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-xs font-bold mt-1">
                  {errors.gender}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
            <Input name="brn" label="BIRTH REGISTRATION NUMBER" inputMode="numeric" maxLength={17} type="text" val={form.brn} set={v => update('brn', v)} error={errors.brn} />
            <Input name="dob" label="DATE OF BIRTH" type="date" val={form.dob} set={v => update('dob', v)} error={errors.dob} />

            <div className="relative pt-1 w-full">
              <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase ml-1">Blood Group</label>
              <select
                name="bloodGroup"
                className={`w-full p-4 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl font-bold outline-none border ${errors.bloodGroup ? 'border-red-500' : 'border-transparent'
                  }`}
                value={form.bloodGroup}
                onChange={e => update('bloodGroup', e.target.value)}
              >

                <option value="">N/A</option>
                {['A+', 'B+', 'O+', 'AB+', 'A-', 'B-', 'O-', 'AB-'].map(c => <option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
              </select>
              {errors.bloodGroup && (
                <p className="text-red-500 text-xs font-bold mt-1">
                  {errors.bloodGroup}
                </p>
              )}

            </div>

            <div className="mt-2 p-4 bg-blue-50 rounded-xl border border-blue-100">
              <Input disabled name="studentId" label="Student ID (Auto)" type="text" val={form.studentId} set={v => update('studentId', v)} error={errors.studentId} />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {step === 2 && (
          <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-right-8 duration-300">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">Step 2: Parents Info</h3>
            <Input name="fatherNameBn" label="পিতার নাম (বাংলা)" val={form.fatherNameBn} set={v => update('fatherNameBn', v)} error={errors.fatherNameBn} />

            <Input name="fatherNameEn" label="Father Name (English)"
              val={form.fatherNameEn}
              set={v => update('fatherNameEn', v)}
              error={errors.fatherNameEn} />

            <Input name="motherNameBn" label="মাতার নাম (বাংলা)" val={form.motherNameBn} set={v => update('motherNameBn', v)} error={errors.motherNameBn} />

            <Input name="motherNameEn" label="Mother Name (English)"
              val={form.motherNameEn}
              set={v => update('motherNameEn', v)}
              error={errors.motherNameEn} />

            <Input name="whatsappNumber" label="Mobile (WhatsApp)" type="tel" inputMode="numeric" maxLength={11} val={form.whatsappNumber} set={v => update('whatsappNumber', v)} error={errors.whatsappNumber} />
            <Input
              name="emergencyNumber"
              label="Emergency No"
              type="tel"
              inputMode="numeric"
              maxLength={11}
              val={form.emergencyNumber}
              set={v => update('emergencyNumber', v)}
              error={errors.emergencyNumber}
            />

          </div>
        )}

        {step === 3 && (
          <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-right-8 duration-300">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-4">Step 3: Address (Bangla Only)</h3>

            {/* বাংলাদেশ জিও-ঠিকানা: নির্বাচন করলে বাংলা ও ইংরেজি দুই ঘরই পূরণ হয় */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 rounded-xl border border-emerald-100 space-y-3">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 uppercase tracking-widest">ঠিকানা বাছাই (Division → Union)</p>
              {geoError && <p className="text-red-500 text-xs font-bold">{geoError}</p>}
              <SelectBox label="Division" value={geoSel.division} loading={geoLoading === 'division'} options={geo.divisions} onChange={(id) => pickGeo('division', id)} />
              <SelectBox label="District" value={geoSel.district} disabled={!geoSel.division} loading={geoLoading === 'district'} options={geo.districts} onChange={(id) => pickGeo('district', id)} />
              <SelectBox label="Upazila" value={geoSel.upazila} disabled={!geoSel.district} loading={geoLoading === 'upazila'} options={geo.upazilas} onChange={(id) => pickGeo('upazila', id)} />
              <SelectBox label="Union" value={geoSel.union} disabled={!geoSel.upazila} loading={geoLoading === 'union'} options={geo.unions} onChange={(id) => pickGeo('union', id)} />
            </div>

            <Input
              name="houseNameBn"
              label="বাড়ির নাম (বাংলা)"
              val={form.houseNameBn}
              set={v => update('houseNameBn', v)}
              error={errors.houseNameBn}
            />
            <Input name="villageBn" label="গ্রাম (বাংলা)" val={form.villageBn} set={v => update('villageBn', v)} error={errors.villageBn} />
            <Input name="unionBn" label="ইউনিয়ন (বাংলা)" val={form.unionBn} set={v => update('unionBn', v)} error={errors.unionBn} />

            <Input name="wardNo" label="Ward No" type="text" inputMode="numeric" maxLength={3} val={form.wardNo} set={v => update('wardNo', v)} error={errors.wardNo} />
            <Input name="upazilaBn" label="উপজেলা (বাংলা)" val={form.upazilaBn} set={v => update('upazilaBn', v)} error={errors.upazilaBn} />

            <Input name="districtBn" label="জেলা (বাংলা)" val={form.districtBn} set={v => update('districtBn', v)} error={errors.districtBn} />

            <>
              <Input name="houseNameEn" label="House Name (English)"
                val={form.houseNameEn}
                set={v => update('houseNameEn', v)}
                error={errors.houseNameEn}
              />

              <Input name="villageEn" label="Village (English)"
                val={form.villageEn}
                set={v => update('villageEn', v)}
                error={errors.villageEn}
              />

              <Input name="unionEn" label="Union (English)"
                val={form.unionEn}
                set={v => update('unionEn', v)}
                error={errors.unionEn}
              />

              <Input name="upazilaEn" label="Upazila (English)"
                val={form.upazilaEn}
                set={v => update('upazilaEn', v)}
                error={errors.upazilaEn}
              />

              <Input name="districtEn" label="District (English)"
                val={form.districtEn}
                set={v => update('districtEn', v)}
                error={errors.districtEn}
              />

            </>
          </div>
        )}

        {step === 4 && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center animate-in fade-in zoom-in duration-300 py-6">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-8">Step 4: Student Photo</h3>
            <div className={`relative w-56 h-56 bg-gray-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border-[6px] shadow-2xl ring-1 overflow-hidden ${errors.imageUrl ? 'border-red-500 ring-red-200' : 'border-white ring-gray-100'}`}>
              {imgPreview ? <img src={imgPreview} className="w-full h-full object-cover" /> : <Camera size={48} className="text-gray-300" />}
              <input name="imageUrl" type="file" onChange={handleImage} className="absolute inset-0 opacity-0 cursor-pointer" accept="image/*" />
            </div>
            {errors.imageUrl && <p className="text-red-500 text-xs font-bold mt-2">{typeof errors.imageUrl === 'string' && errors.imageUrl.length > 1 ? errors.imageUrl : 'ছবি আবশ্যক'}</p>}
            <p className="mt-8 text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium bg-gray-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-center">Tap photo to upload <br /><span className="text-xs text-gray-400">(Square Only)</span></p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-between mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100">
        {step > 1 ? <button id="formBackBtn" onClick={() => setStep(s => s - 1)} className="font-bold text-gray-400 px-6 py-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
          Back
        </button> : <button id="formBackBtn" onClick={onCancel} className="font-bold text-red-400 px-4 py-3">
          Cancel
        </button>
        }
        {step < 4 ? (
          <button onClick={handleNext} className="bg-slate-900 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">Next <ArrowRight size={18} /></button>
        ) : (
          <button onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={saving} className="bg-blue-600 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 shadow-xl shadow-blue-200 disabled:opacity-60">
            {saving ? <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" /> : <>Submit <Check size={18} /></>}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default FullForm;

import { useState } from 'react';
import { AlertCircle, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { CONFIG } from '../config/systemConfig';

const LoginView = ({ onLogin }) => {
  const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState('');
  const [pass, setPass] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleLogin = async () => {
    const id = identifier.trim();
    if (!id) return setError("ফোন নম্বর অথবা টিচার কোড দিন");
    if (!/^(\d{11}|\d{10})$/.test(id)) return setError("১১ ডিজিটের ফোন নম্বর অথবা ১০ ডিজিটের টিচার কোড দিন");
    if (!pass) return setError("পাসওয়ার্ড দিন");
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    const result = await onLogin(id, pass);
    if (result && result.ok === false) setError(result.message || "লগিন ব্যর্থ হয়েছে");
    setLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-900 px-6">
      <div className="bg-white p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-xl w-full max-w-sm">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-center mb-2 text-slate-800">
          স্বাগতম
        </h2>
        <p className="text-center text-gray-500 text-sm mb-6">{CONFIG.APP_NAME}</p>

        <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase ml-1">Phone / Teacher Code</label>
        <input 
          type="text"
          inputMode="numeric"
          maxLength={11}
          placeholder="01XXXXXXXXX / Teacher Code"
          className="w-full p-4 mb-4 bg-gray-50 border border-transparent focus:bg-white focus:border-slate-900 rounded-xl outline-none font-bold transition-all"
          value={identifier}
          onChange={e => setIdentifier(e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''))}
          onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && handleLogin()}
        />

        <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase ml-1">Password</label>
        <input 
          type="password"
          placeholder="******"
          className="w-full p-4 mb-4 bg-gray-50 border border-transparent focus:bg-white focus:border-slate-900 rounded-xl outline-none font-bold transition-all"
          value={pass}
          onChange={e => setPass(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && handleLogin()}
        />

        {error && (
          <div className="bg-red-50 text-red-500 text-sm font-bold p-3 rounded-lg mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertCircle size={16}/> {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <button 
          onClick={handleLogin}
          disabled={loading}
